content.original: The most notable of all Cyclops variants, introduced in 2750, fits the 'Mech with a Collapsible Command Module strapped to its rear torso, allowing a fully operational headquarters bunker to be set up in fifteen minutes. In order to make room for the module the Autocannon/20 and its ammunition was removed from this variant. Irreparable damages suffered during the Succession Wars means less than half of those Cyclopses with a working B-2000 have an operable command module. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14

content.original: The 2N variant of the Axman, introduced in the late 3040s, has been called a mistake by some and a stroke of genius by others. The 2N carries two LRM-15 launchers in place of the massive Autocannon/20 as the autocannon often jammed on early models. While this changes the 'Mech's role from a city fighter to a long-range bombardment 'Mech, it also allows the Axman to be a support 'Mech that can defend itself with its massive Hatchet at ranges where the LRMs are ineffective if an enemy closes. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: The Furillo manufactured 3S introduced in 3057 removes the XL Engine of the 1N and 2N variants and replaces it with a Light Fusion Engine. This exclusively Lyran variant of the Axman is armed with a massive LB-X Autocannon/20, which allows it to fire either solid rounds or cluster rounds that act like a 'Mech sized shotgun. The 'Mech also carries three ER Medium Lasers for close combat and a Guardian ECM Suite, which defends against enemy electronic warfare equipment. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: A full redesign of the Cyclops, the 11-G was built by Grumium Creations for the Second Star League Defense Force, Com Guards and Free Rasalhague Republic. Debuting in 3058 it redesigns the chassis to use Endo Steel construction and also replaces the standard armor with fifteen tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. For long range combat it retains the Gauss Rifle and LRM-10 missile launcher minus one ton of missile reloads, while the arm-mounted medium lasers and center-torso SRM launcher were also upgraded to ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-4 launcher. All ammunition for the weapons was also shifted to the right-side torso and uses CASE to protect itself from complete destruction in the event of an ammunition explosion. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

Built by Grumium and introduced in 3059, the 'Mech is armed with an Ultra Autocannon/10 for close to intermediate range combat. In place of the LRM launcher it carries an MRM-20 launcher, which compliments the Autocannon's range profile, while retaining two ER medium lasers and a Streak SRM-4 for for close ranges. The 'Mech is also armored with fourteen and a half tons of armor. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

content.original: As the knowledge of how to build OmniMechs spread throughout the clans although Coyote had tried to keep it for themselves, they quickly realized they needed to bolster their 'Mech forces and started the Pueblo Initiative to remodel older SLDF 'Mechs into OmniMechs. The Night Chanter was the first result of the initiative, using the Crab as its base. However, the rushed development led to a somewhat dubious design, and the 'Mech was easily beaten by other Omnis of the same size. Despite this compromise, the Night Chanter still spread through the clans quickly and became the most used of the Pueblo Initiative designs.

content.original: The No-Dachi was designed by Cosby as a test bed for two new technologies. The first was the Sword. The seven-meter long katana that the 'Mech wields was designed to counter the Hatchet used by some Federated Commonwealth 'Mechs. Because the samurai mindset had been so successfully drilled into the warriors of the Draconis Combine, they were loathe to use a ''barbaric'' ax. The second new technology was the Triple Strength Myomer that had been pioneered by the Federated Suns. The new melee weapon, combined with the improved myomers, make the No-Dachi a dangerous in-fighter. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

In order to make room for the module the Autocannon/20 and its ammunition was removed from this variant. Irreparable damages suffered during the Succession Wars means less than half of those Cyclopses with a working B-2000 have an operable command module. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14

content.original: The 2N variant of the Axman, introduced in the late 3040s, has been called a mistake by some and a stroke of genius by others. The 2N carries two LRM-15 launchers in place of the massive Autocannon/20 as the autocannon often jammed on early models. While this changes the 'Mech's role from a city fighter to a long-range bombardment 'Mech, it also allows the Axman to be a support 'Mech that can defend itself with its massive Hatchet at ranges where the LRMs are ineffective if an enemy closes. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: A full redesign of the Cyclops, the 11-G was built by Grumium Creations for the Second Star League Defense Force, Com Guards and Free Rasalhague Republic. Debuting in 3058 it redesigns the chassis to use Endo Steel construction and also replaces the standard armor with fifteen tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. For long range combat it retains the Gauss Rifle and LRM-10 missile launcher minus one ton of missile reloads, while the arm-mounted medium lasers and center-torso SRM launcher were also upgraded to ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-4 launcher. All ammunition for the weapons was also shifted to the right-side torso and uses CASE to protect itself from complete destruction in the event of an ammunition explosion. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

content.original: The No-Dachi was designed by Cosby as a test bed for two new technologies. The first was the Sword. The seven-meter long katana that the 'Mech wields was designed to counter the Hatchet used by some Federated Commonwealth 'Mechs. Because the samurai mindset had been so successfully drilled into the warriors of the Draconis Combine, they were loathe to use a ''barbaric'' ax. The second new technology was the Triple Strength Myomer that had been pioneered by the Federated Suns. The new melee weapon, combined with the improved myomers, make the No-Dachi a dangerous in-fighter. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The Awesome is traditionally used in a vanguard role when penetrating enemy defenses. The Awesome's massive firepower also lends it to defensive actions, acting as a mobile turret when necessary. Because of its reliance on PPCs, the Awesome is able to act independently for extended periods of time. This trait is also useful in siege situations where the 'Mech can keep up a constant barrage, allowing it to win battles of attrition through bleeding an enemy dry. The only downsides to the Awesome is its low maneuverability and lack of rear-facing weaponry, making it vulnerable to being outflanked and surrounded by lighter 'Mechs, although good intelligence and a well-deployed screening force can mitigate this issue.
content.prevOriginal: A 'Mech that truly lives up to its name! The Awesome 8Q mounts a frightening trio of PPCs that can destroy, knock down, or debilitate any target in no time. It's ungainly, but it can shrug off huge amounts of incoming fire.
content.content: «Потрясающий» традиционно используется в роли авангарда при прорыве вражеской обороны. Массивная огневая мощь Awesome также позволяет использовать его в оборонительных действиях, при необходимости выступая в роли мобильной турели. Благодаря использованию PPC, Awesome способен действовать автономно в течение длительного времени. Эта особенность также полезна в осадных ситуациях, когда мехи могут вести постоянный обстрел, позволяя выигрывать битвы на истощение за счет обескровливания противника. Единственным недостатком Awesome является низкая маневренность и отсутствие заднего оружия, что делает его уязвимым для захода и обстрела в спину более легкими мехами, хотя хорошая разведка и хорошо развернутые силы прикрытия могут смягчить эту проблему.

content.original: The Marauder was first built by General Motors in 2612 for use as an attack and direct fire support BattleMech. The first 'Mech to diverge from the traditional humanoid shape of previous machines, the Marauder was one of the most well-known 'Mechs in existence and originally meant to usher in a new generation of 'Mechs. Unfortunately, with the fall of the Star League, this new generation never quite materialized. On its own merits though, the Marauder was a devastatingly powerful 'Mech, outclassed only by larger machines like the Stalker and BattleMaster. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The Zeus 5T is an original model Zeus and makes use of Star League technology to make a much more deadly mech. Just as fast as the -6S, the -5T switches the autocannon for a devastating array of energy weapons which combined with the -5T's double heat sinks is a brutal combination. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: «Зевс» был впервые построен Лиранским Содружеством в 2787 году, как раз в начале Первой Наследной войны. Созданный по просьбе командования Вооружённых сил Лиранского Содружества в качестве нового лёгкого штурмового меха, «Зевс» достаточно быстр, чтобы не отставать от большинства тяжёлых мехов, и в равной степени способен побеждать их. Zeus 5T — это оригинальная модель Zeus, созданная с использованием технологий Звёздной Лиги, что позволило создать гораздо более смертоносный мех. Такой же быстрый, как -6S, -5T разменивает автопушку на опасный арсенал из энергетического оружия, что в сочетании с двойными охладителями -5T создаёт поистине брутальное сочетание. Особенность: Рука-пушка Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.16 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Khan Marthe Pryde decided to upgrade the 'Mechs her Clan fielded. Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. The design the scientists chose to modify was the Adder. Though the two 'Mechs are visually similar and share the same weight, the Cougar is slower and better armed.

Вместо того, чтобы тратить драгоценные ресурсы на разработку нового омнимеха с нуля, она поручила своим ученым усовершенствовать существующие конструкции. Ученые решили модифицировать Adder. Хотя эти два меха визуально похожи и имеют одинаковый вес, Cougar более медленный и лучше вооружен.

Diamond Shark politics limited the variant to a single unit, which fought and died on Tukayyid, covering the retreat of Alpha and Gamma galaxies. A Targeting Computer, Active Probe and an AMS fill out the remaining pod space. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: A prototype LAM, the Ajax was a next generation Star League design. Following relatively successful initial trials, the Amaris Civil War rendered the design extinct, with production and testing ceasing due to the war. Designed to be easy to maintain, the Ajax uses pod mounted weapons similar to the modular weapons designed for the Mercury scout 'Mech. Though able to switch modes faster than standard LAM designs, particularly heavy loadouts still hinder the Ajax's speed and versatility. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
content.prevOriginal: A prototype LAM, the Ajax was a next generation Star League design. Designed to be easy to maintain, the Ajax uses pod mounted weapons similar to the modular weapons designed for the Mercury scout Mech. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
content.content: Прототипный LAM, Ajax, был разработан Звёздной Лигой как модель нового поколения. После относительно успешных первых испытаний, гражданская война Амариса привела к прекращению производства и испытаний этой модели. Ajax был разработан с учетом простоты обслуживания и оснащён оружием, установленным в модулях, аналогичных модульному оружию, разработанному для развед меха Mercury. Несмотря на то, что Ajax может переключаться между режимами быстрее, чем стандартные модели LAM, тяжелый обвес все же снижает его скорость и универсальность. Особенность: Мех «земля-воздух» Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

The Albatross also uses a variety of weapons in an attempt to make the 'Mech effective at any range. The 'Mech has average mobility with a maximum speed of 64.8 km/h and also makes use of double heat sinks for their greater heat dissipation capability. content.original: The Albatross does not specialize in one role and is more of a workhorse design than anything else. The 'Mech carries an Irian Weapons Works V7 LRM-15 launcher which gives it long range and indirect fire support capabilities. This is backed up by an Oriente Model O LB-X Autocannon/10 and a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser which give the 'Mech a powerful long-range punch. The 'Mech carries a Tronel PPL-20 Large Pulse Laser which allows the 'Mech to engage an enemy at the edge of the medium to long-range envelope. Finally, for close combat, the 'Mech has an Irian Weapons Works 60mm SRM-6 and two Irian Weapons Works Super 6 Medium Lasers.

Finally, for close combat, the 'Mech has an Irian Weapons Works 60mm SRM-6 and two Irian Weapons Works Super 6 Medium Lasers.

content.original: The Arctic Fox is a light OmniMech reverse engineered by the Kell Hounds from the Clan Uller OmniMech with assistance in the final stages from Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The resulting OmniMech is a powerful light 'Mech that has a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is provided by a GM 180 XL engine, shaving off valuable weight from the Arctic Fox's base chassis while also making the 'Mech vulnerable to becoming a combat kill through the loss of one of its side torsos. The Arctic Fox has ten double heat sinks which are generally enough to handle the 'Mech's heat load, with the ability to add more if needed. To protect itself from enemy fire, the Arctic Fox has six tons of Royal-7 armor. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.94 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: «Арктическая лиса» — лёгкий омнимех, созданный Гончими Келла из кланового омнимеха «Уллер» при содействии на финальных стадиях клана Волка-в-Изгнании. Получившийся омнимех — мощный лёгкий мех, развивающий максимальную скорость 97,2 км/ч благодаря двигателю GM 180 XL, что значительно снижает вес базового шасси Arctic Fox, но при этом делает мех уязвимым к уничтожению в бою из-за потери одного из боковых торсов. Arctic Fox оснащён десятью двойными охладителями, которых обычно достаточно для отвода тепловой нагрузки меха, с возможностью добавления дополнительных при необходимости. Для защиты от вражеского огня Arctic Fox оснащён шестью тоннами брони Royal-7. Особенность: Узкий/низкий профиль Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.94 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: The Arctic Fox is a light OmniMech reverse engineered by the Kell Hounds from the Clan Uller OmniMech with assistance in the final stages from Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The resulting OmniMech is a powerful light 'Mech that has a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is provided by a GM 180 XL engine, shaving off valuable weight from the Arctic Fox's base chassis while also making the 'Mech vulnerable to becoming a combat kill through the loss of one of its side torsos. The Arctic Fox has ten double heat sinks which are generally enough to handle the 'Mech's heat load, with the ability to add more if needed. To protect itself from enemy fire, the Arctic Fox has six tons of Royal-7 armor. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.94 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: Еще один вариант мехов, которые раздобыл Синдикат Дракона, захватив Independence Weaponries на Квентине во время войны 3039. Atlas-C был одним из первых продуктов разработки Синдиката Дракона, в которых блоки C3 начали устанавливать на боевые мехи. Поскольку Атлас распологает широким арсеналом вооружения, удаление одного Medium Pulse Laser не причинило ему больших неудобств. Вместо него был установлен модуль ведомого C3 и дополнительный охладитель, чтобы помочь рассеять огромное количество выделяемого тепла.

content.original: When the Star League Defense Force left the Inner Sphere under Commanding General Aleksandr Kerensky during Operation Exodus, they brought with them many of the most common 'Mechs. As the SLDF-in-exile slowly started turning into the Clans, they started developing improved weapons, which they mounted on their existing armies of 'Mech. These weapons are commonly called Clan Early, and as such the Mech's using them got the -CE suffix added to their designation.

content.original: I've heard of these older refits and thankfully our Battalion never faced one. Facing a single Pilot in an Atlas is one thing, but going up against two pilots in one of these is something else altogether; an experienced Commander and MechWarrior is a force to be reckoned with. Its no wonder they were targeted so heavily targeted during the Early Succession Wars. The loss of ammo and medium lasers makes this design no less deadly.

content.original: A Combine upgrade of the Atlas that used rediscovered Star League technology, the K model was built with a Vlar 300 XL Engine. Carrying a Shigunga LRM-20 with two tons of ammo in the left torso the 'Mech was rearmed for long range combat with an Imperator Dragon's Fire Gauss Rifle in place of the autocannon, with two tons of gauss rounds carried in the right arm, backed up by a pair of Victory Nickel Alloy ER Large Lasers split between both arms. This armament allowed the AS7-K to keep an enemy at range, though the continued use of twenty single heat sinks caused swift heat buildup if both lasers are fired repeatedly. For close range defense, the K model carried two Victory Heartbeat Medium Pulse Lasers and a Yori Flyswatter Anti-Missile System in the left arm. To round off the AS7-K's defense, CASE was added to the side torsos to protect against an ammunition explosion. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18

После гражданской войны производство этой модели прекратилось, хотя гарнизонные войска с обеих сторон продолжали ее использовать, причем подразделения Федеративных Солнц использовали высокоточные боеприпасы для автопушек, а Содружество Лиры - специализированные боеприпасы для LRM, захваченные у Лиги Свободных Миров. Особенность: Боевые кулаки Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.18

content.original: A very basic FedCom upgrade of the standard Atlas introduced in 3050, the S model removed five heat sinks from the design, upgrading the rest to Double Heat Sinks. The weight savings are used to add two rear firing Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launchers, giving the Atlas increased protection in its rear arc of fire. After the civil war production of this model ceased, although garrison forces in both sundered states continued to use them, with AFFS units using Precision Ammunition for the autocannon and LAAF units making use of specialized LRM munitions captured from the Free Worlds League.

content.original: The S2 Atlas was a major upgrade of the design by the Lyran Alliance coming out of the Hesperus II facility in 3061. The 'Mech was built with a Light Fusion Engine and carried an Artemis IV Fire Control System enhanced LRM-15 launcher and two ER large lasers as its primary long range weapons. For close combat, the 'Mech was armed with a Heavy Gauss Rifle. The S2 mounted a Guardian ECM Suite in place of the AMS to protect against enemy electronic warfare equipment. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18

content.original: The Atlas is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.

content.content: «Атлас» - король на поле боя, способный поражать цели на любой дистанции с помощью умопомрачительного количества оружия. Он также примечателен тем, что обычно устанавливает на себя максимальное количество брони. Немногие противники могут выдержать даже кратковременный контакт с этим монстром.

content.original: First fielded in 2765, the Atlas II was designed by the Hegemony Research and Development Department, Weapons Division of the original Star League to maintain the technological edge over the other Great Houses. It was exclusively for the SLDF's Royal Regiments. In 2785, when General Aleksandr Kerensky put out his call for loyal forces to join him in his Exodus, every Atlas II pilot responded and left with him. The Atlas II is armed with an array of weaponry, including an LB-X Autocannon/10, a pair of ER Large Lasers, and a 20-tube Long Range Missile Launcher for long range attacks. For close range combat, the 'Mech is equipped with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Holly Six Pack. In addition, the 'Mech has been given CASEfor both sides of the torso in order to keep an ammunition cook-off from consuming the 'Mech. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18

content.content: Пройдя боевое крещение в 2765, изначальный дизайн Atlas II был спроектирован Департаментом исследований и разработок Терранской Гегемонии, а именно - Отделом вооружения оригинальной Звёздной Лиги, чтобы поддерживать технологическое превосходство над другими Великими Домами. Мех был эксклюзивом королевских войск СОЗЛ. Спустя 20 лет, когда генерал Александр Керенский, во время Исхода, отдал приказ лояльным ему соединениям присоединиться к нему, ни один пилот этой грозной машины не осмелился ему воспротивиться. Atlas II несет массу разнообразного вооружения, такого как LB 10-X, пара ER Large Lasers и одна LRM-20 для атак на дальние расстояния. Для ближнего боя он может похвастаться двумя Medium Pulse Laser и Holly SRM-6. Также в оба борта был установлен CASE для защиты от детонации боекомплекта. Особенность: Боевые кулаки Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.18

content.original: The Awesome is traditionally used in a vanguard role when penetrating enemy defenses. The Awesome's massive firepower also lends it to defensive actions, acting as a mobile turret when necessary. Because of its reliance on PPCs, the Awesome is able to act independently for extended periods of time. This trait is also useful in siege situations where the 'Mech can keep up a constant barrage, allowing it to win battles of attrition through bleeding an enemy dry. The only downsides to the Awesome is its low maneuverability and lack of rear-facing weaponry, making it vulnerable to being outflanked and surrounded by lighter 'Mechs, although good intelligence and a well-deployed screening force can mitigate this issue.
content.prevOriginal: The main benefit of this variant is its ability to lob indirect fire.  Otherwise this is a case where I prefer the original recipe.
content.content: «Потрясающий» традиционно используется в роли авангарда при прорыве вражеской обороны. Массивная огневая мощь Awesome также позволяет использовать его в оборонительных действиях, при необходимости выступая в роли мобильной турели. Благодаря использованию PPC, Awesome способен действовать автономно в течение длительного времени. Эта особенность также полезна в осадных ситуациях, когда мехи могут вести постоянный обстрел, позволяя выигрывать битвы на истощение за счет обескровливания противника. Единственным недостатком Awesome является низкая маневренность и отсутствие заднего оружия, что делает его уязвимым для захода и обстрела в спину более легкими мехами, хотя хорошая разведка и хорошо развернутые силы прикрытия могут смягчить эту проблему.

content.original: The Bandersnatch, named after the monster in Lewis Carroll's 'Wonderland' series, is the brainchild of Felifious Bander and is built around the concept of an affordable and effective BattleMech for sale to mercenary units. The Bandersnatch shares most of its components with the Marauder, making the 'Mech cheaper and easier to repair. The Bandersnatch uses double heat sinks for superior heat dissipation capabilities, allowing a heavier weapons payload. Further, the Bandersnatch carries a respectable eleven tons of armor. While not the maximum amount of armor that the chassis can handle, the 'Mech is still well protected. The primary armaments are for long to medium range combat, a trio of Holly LRM-5 missile launchers and a pair of Armstrong Class-B ClusterGuns LB-X Autocannon/10s that fire both solid and cluster rounds. In the event that an enemy does close to short ranges, the 'Mech carries six Magna Mk II Medium Lasers, two of which are rear mounted, giving it good close range protection. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: This is really a huge difference to the base -3E and its constant heat woes. The combination of the PPCs, with their signature long reach and solid damage, and the RAC-5, with its respectable range, massive damage potential and a decent three-ton supply of ammunition, makes for a powerful strike. The LRM10 launcher only has ammunition for two minutes worth of missile fire, but this is acceptable in light of the added Targeting Computer. There's even enough cooling to ensure this variant need never suffer from debilitating heat buildup of its cousins - the pilot can fire both ER PPCs while at a dead run and remain cool in the cockpit.

There's even enough cooling to ensure this variant need never suffer from debilitating heat buildup of its cousins - the pilot can fire both ER PPCs while at a dead run and remain cool in the cockpit.

content.original: Katherine Steiner-Davion decided during her reign over the Lyran Alliance that she wanted a four legged BattleMech that would evoke fear in its enemies in a similar vein to the classic Atlas and Banshee designs. To do this, the Barghest is built on an Earthwerk GRF Quad chassis that supports a Magna 350 XL engine that saves weight and allows the 'Mech to carry a heavy weapons payload. The Barghest is protected by thirteen tons of Durallex Heavy armor that protects it from all but the heaviest enemy fire. To handle the 'Mech's heat buildup from its weapons, the Barghest has ten double heat sinks.

content.original: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster is one of the best known 'Mechs in existence. Originally designed to be the largest and most powerful 'Mech for the Star League armies in the 27th century, the sheer size of the BattleMaster, combined with the cost and resources needed to build one, meant the 'Mech can only be manufactured on a few planets. Still, those lucky enough to pilot a BattleMaster can attest to some of the stories surrounding the 'Mech. With good reliability, firepower and armoring, the BattleMaster is equally adept anchoring an assault lance or serving as a command vehicle.

content.content: Универсальный и мощный, BattleMaster — один из самых известных мехов. Изначально разработанный как самый большой и мощный мех для армий Звёздной Лиги в 27 веке, BattleMaster в сочетании с его огромными размерами, стоимостью и необходимыми ресурсами для его постройки, означал, что этот мех можно производить лишь на нескольких планетах. Тем не менее, те, кому посчастливилось его пилотировать, могут подтвердить некоторые мифы, связанные с этим мехом. Благодаря высокой надёжности, огневой мощи и бронированию, BattleMaster одинаково хорошо подходит как для поддержки штурмового копья, так и в качестве командирской машины.

content.original: Originating as the heavily customized and personal 'Mech of General Gregor Tucker, the 1GT become a rare but favoured favourite of the Free Rasalhague Republic's elite MechWarriors. The weapons layout has been reworked almost from scratch, moving the medium Lasers to the arms and two PPC in the side torsos. A single SRM-4 launcher in the center torso can provide some unexpected close range damage. The 'Mech further utilizes both Ferro-Fibrous armor and an XL Engine, allowing increased armor and a total of 18 double heat sinks. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15

content.original: The 3M was a basic upgrade of the BattleMaster utilizing Star League technology. Introduced by Earthwerks Incorporated for the Free Worlds League in 3049, the 'Mech replaces the standard heat sinks with double heat sinks, upgrades its primary weapon to a Fusigon Longtooth ER PPC and removes one of the machine guns to add CASE to the design to protect itself in the event of an ammunition explosion. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15

content.original: This is the Free Worlds League official version of the Battlemaster from  Earthwerks factory on Keystone, the BLR-3M. It features Cellular Ammunition Storage Equipment to guard against an internal explosion, and double heat sinks, allowing it to dissipate great amounts of heat in a short time. The only change in weaponry is mounting the Fusigon Longtooth Extended-Range Particle Projection Cannon instead of the older Donal model and dropping one of the two machine guns.

content.original: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster is one of the best known 'Mechs in existence. Originally designed to be the largest and most powerful 'Mech for the Star League armies in the 27th century, the sheer size of the BattleMaster, combined with the cost and resources needed to build one, meant the 'Mech can only be manufactured on a few planets. Still, those lucky enough to pilot a BattleMaster can attest to some of the stories surrounding the 'Mech. With good reliability, firepower and armoring, the BattleMaster is equally adept anchoring an assault lance or serving as a command vehicle.

content.content: Универсальный и мощный, BattleMaster — один из самых известных мехов. Изначально разработанный как самый большой и мощный мех для армий Звёздной Лиги в 27 веке, BattleMaster в сочетании с его огромными размерами, стоимостью и необходимыми ресурсами для его постройки, означал, что этот мех можно производить лишь на нескольких планетах. Тем не менее, те, кому посчастливилось его пилотировать, могут подтвердить некоторые мифы, связанные с этим мехом. Благодаря высокой надёжности, огневой мощи и бронированию, BattleMaster одинаково хорошо подходит как для поддержки штурмового копья, так и в качестве командирской машины.

content.original: Another upgrade of the BattleMaster using lost technology from the Star League, the 3S was introduced in 3050 by Red Devil Industries for the Federated Commonwealth. Still using standard heat sinks it actually removes a half-ton of armor along with the PPC and one of the machine guns, although it still retains the SRM-6. These changes along with the inclusion of an 340 XL engine make room for a LRM-20 launcher as its primary weapon backed up by six Medium Pulse Lasers for fighting close in, with two of the lasers being rear facing. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15

content.original: The -3W is a full Clan conversion of the Battlemaster that sometimes can be spotted on the battlefield for Clan forces close the Inner Sphere. Mounting an impressive combined loadout of two ER PPC, a Large Pulse Laser, four Medium Pulse Lasers and three ER Medium Lasers - all of the Clan variety - means it can deliver a lot of damage if not dealt with, but it does suffer from heat management limiting factors like many other Clan designs. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19

content.original: The Battle Hawk was originally designed and built at a time when Defiance Industries felt threatened by the large amount of equipment being produced by, and imported from, the Free Worlds League. It was built to prove that Defiance Industries was still an industry leader in BattleMechs. This came from a 'Mech that, while slow for its weight class, is a force to be reckoned with on the modern battlefield. The Battle Hawk has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, which puts it on par with 'Mechs fifteen to twenty tons heavier than itself, but it also carries a powerful arsenal for its size. Its five and a half tons of armor give it good protection for a light 'Mech. Additionally, to make the Battle Hawk more maneuverable on the battlefield, it can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

content.original: Debuting soon after the Mackie, the Bellerophon was Defiance Industries attempt at creating their own Battlemech. Basing the prototype on an earlier generation Mackie prototype, the project would prove to be fundamentally flawed. While 20% faster than the Mackie, the Bellerophon BEL-1X only mounted 60% of the armor carried by the Mackie. Even worse, the Mech suffered from balance issues stemming from the early generation gyroscope and the concentration of firepower on the right of the Mech. Despite an attempt to market the Mech to the Terran Hegemony, the project was eventually abandoned and the fate of the original prototypes is unknown. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.86 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Upper

content.original: The Bishamon is a quad BattleMech designed by Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited, which uses a mix of advanced construction techniques and advanced weapons systems to both save weight and make it as effective as possible on the battlefield. Officials had approached Nimakachi Fusion after the success of the Venom to build a larger design with newer technologies that had been introduced at the time. Nimakachi engineers originally intended for the Bishamon to have jump jets, however with a heavier weapons load the tradeoffs were enough to satisfy DCMS officials. Intended as a heavy scout, the Bishamon is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a 315 XL engine that gives it a ground speed of 118.8 km/h. While the Bishamon's high ground speed makes it a hard target to hit, the 'Mech carries 10.5 tons of Nimakachi Type 3 armor that provides adequate protection for the 'Mech's size. The Bishamon also has an extremely stable frame due to its quadrupedal chassis, at the expense of space available for weapons and equipment.

content.original: The BJ-2 was introduced in 3052 by the Federated Suns as the new production model of the Blackjack, based on earlier experimental designs. It upgrades the 'Mech with two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers in place of the autocannons and removes the medium lasers for four Hovertec Streak SRM-2 launchers, two each in the left and right sides of the torso. One ton of ammo for the launchers is kept in the left torso while the standard heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks. content.original: The Black Hawk-KU is an Inner Sphere version of the Clan Black Hawk OmniMech. In order to make it possible to copy the Black Hawk, the Black Hawk-KU is built ten tons heavier than its Clan counterpart. The Black Hawk-KU is built on a sixty ton chassis and is powered by a Vlar 300 XL Engine which propels it to a top speed of 86.4 km/h.

content.original: The Black Python is similar in many ways to the Warhammer and Marauder BattleMechs. Though it is faster than those heavies, it has a similar weapons load-out with comparable damage, albeit with much more accurate damage potential. In order to achieve this, this expensive second-line 'Mech avails itself of all weight saving technologies that were at the disposal of the Clans, including an XL Engine, Endo Steel frame, and eleven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17

content.content: «Чёрный питон» во многом похож на боевые мехи «Вархаммер» и «Мародер». Хотя он быстрее этих тяжёлых машин, он имеет схожий арсенал вооружения и сопоставимый урон, но с гораздо большей точностью. Для достижения этой цели этот дорогой мех второй линии использует все доступные Кланам технологии снижения веса, включая двигатель XL, эндостальную раму и одиннадцать тонн ферроволоконной брони. Особенность: Улучшенное наведение - Short Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.17

content.original: The 10D variant of the Bombardier is a refit performed by Earthwerks Incorporated during the Succession Wars as many advanced components became lostech; while Wakazashi were content not to manufacture any more Bombardiers, the company was prepared to license Earthwerks to produce parts for existing 'Mechs, resulting in the 10D refit. While the Delphinius and Arrowlight launchers were swapped out for low-tech Doombud and Hovertech models, the AMS system was completely replaced with a Machine Gun. Perhaps the biggest difference was the replacement of VOX 325 XL engine with the smaller Magna 260, giving the design a top speed of 64.8 km/h and cruising speed of 43 km/h. In addition, the CASE that protected the vulnerable ammunition stores has been removed from the design, while the armor protection itself has not changed. As a part of the refit performed by Earthwerks in their Calloway VI plant the communications system was replaced with the Neil 5000 system and the targeting and tracking system was replaced with the RCA Instatrac Mark XII system. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

content.original: Continuing the trend toward specialized BattleMechs, the Bombardier was proposed to the Star League in 2735 by Wakazashi Enterprises as an "artillery 'Mech." The concept behind the design was to make a BattleMech that could replace less-mobile artillery vehicles, which might fall behind in an advance or be destroyed by counter-battery fire. It would be well-protected with twelve and a half tons of armor and use specialized missile racks which could carry diverse types of advanced missiles. Over years of testing and field exercises the Bombardier proved itself extremely effective at fulfilling the long-range fire support role, easily surpassing its vehicular counterparts and even inspiring talks of disbanding the SLDF's artillery arm once enough Bombardiers were operational. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: The -3R was built to do as much damage to an enemy at as great a stand-off range as possible. The 'Mech therefore carries primarily long-ranged armament. To save weight it also uses an 280-rated XL engine and sixteen double heat sinks, allowing the 'Mech to carry as many weapons and as much armor as possible. The primary long-ranged weapon on the Caesar is a Gauss rifle, supplied with two tons of reloads. This is backed up at long ranges by an ER PPC, which can do two-thirds of the damage of the Gauss rifle but is not dependent on limited ammunition. For close-range engagements, the Caesar carries four Medium Pulse Lasers, allowing it to put up a crippling defense against any enemies that can get close to the 'Mech. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: The longest ranged weapon carried by the CTF-3D Cataphract is a General Motors Nova-5 Ultra AC-5 in its right arm, boasting a rate of fire twice that of a standard autocannon. This is backed up by a Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10 in its right torso, capable of firing both solid and cluster rounds. It is a more popular weapon than the Ultra AC-5, especially for use in an anti-conventional and anti-aircraft role without the possibility of jamming. Finally, the 'Mech has four Intek Medium Lasers for close range defense, one in each arm firing forward and two in its torso covering the rear. With only two tons of ammo for the LB-X 10 and one ton for the Ultra, if it runs dry the Cataphract must fall back to be reloaded before continuing the fight. Eleven tons of armor combined with CASE allowed the Cataphract to easily absorb damage. Sixteen heat sinks keep it cool while four HildCo Model 12 jump jets gave it a jumping distance of one hundred and twenty meters. Room for these improvements was made by using a GM 280 XL Engine. While it is also armed with an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon this is instead matched with a Ceres Arms Warrior ER PPC for powerful striking capabilities at long range. Other differences include the use of four Medium Pulse Lasers and double heat sinks in place of the standard models. content.original: One of the best first generation ProtoMechs, the Centaur combines high speed, decent armor, and a varied weapons mix. These features make it a flexible combatant, able to keep up with scout 'Mechs while supporting them. The SRM and LRM missile launchers provide much of the striking power of the Centaur, backed up ER Micro Laser. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98

content.original: The D variant of the Centurion, introduced in 3049, is the first of many upgrades using Star League technology. The chassis was re-engineered to use Endo Steel construction techniques. Next the power plant was changed from the standard engine to an GM 300 extralight engine, increasing its maximum speed to 97.2 km/h. Finally, the weapons were upgraded. The Autocannon/10 was swapped for a Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10 and an Artemis IV fire control system was added to the LRM launcher. The two medium lasers were retained. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.content: Вариант -D «Центуриона», представленный в 3049 году, стал первой из многих модернизаций с использованием технологий Звёздной Лиги. Шасси было перепроектировано с использованием технологий создания каркасов из эндостали. Затем энергоснабжение заменили со стандартного двигателя на сверхлегкий двигатель GM 300, что увеличило максимальную скорость до 97,2 км/ч. Наконец, было модернизировано вооружение. Автопушка АС/10 была заменена на LB-X АС/10 от Mydron Excel, а к LRM добавили система управления огнем Artemis IV. Два средних лазера остались нетронутыми. content.original: The Chameleon carried a basic arsenal that allowed a MechWarrior-in-training to learn the skill of heat management. The 'Mech's reliable low-tech arsenal had proven effective when forced into combat. The primary weapon was a Cyclops Eye Large Laser. This was backed up by two Intek Medium Lasers and a trio of Defiance B3S Small Lasers. To make the threat of overheating more real to the new MechWarrior, the 'Mech carried two Scatter Gun Light Machine Guns that can be used for anti-infantry training.

content.original: The Chameleon was designed to help a new MechWarrior master the skills of maneuvering and heat management, with a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping distance of one hundred and eighty meters. The 'Mech also had an almost all energy weapons loadout, but cooled only by ten standard heat sinks. This paucity of freezers forces MechWarriors to concentrate on the 'Mech's heat levels. In some instances, the Chameleon had been forced into combat situations, notably during the Dragoon Civil War. Production of the Chameleon halted briefly in 3052 when Defiance Industries decided to switch its production to the Nightsky, but was quickly resumed when J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated purchased the rights to the design. J.B. BattleMechs also introduced two battle-worthy variants of the Chameleon. The Chameleon is a training 'Mech, intended to simulate a variety of opponents by mounting a wide variety of weapon systems. A Chameleon is a medium 'Mech, but it doesn't always look like one. It can be fitted out with extra plates to modify its appearance, and carries special electronics to falsify its signature; these special abilities let it look and scan as something other than what it is, hence the machine's name. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

The high speed for a mech its size remains as does the somewhat anemic armor, the main benefit the mech gets from Star League technology is found in the weaponry: a LB-10X Autocannon, a SRM-6 with an Artemis IV system, and a pair each of Medium and Small Lasers. Otherwise, the -1N is much the same as the -2N and performs the same in many ways. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Champion debuted in 2602 as a generalist combat 'Mech with a focus on heavy reconnaissance and fast strike capabilities. While definitely faster and more maneuverable than other heavy 'Mechs, it was criticized by many for being too large, underarmed and underarmored. The armament on the Champion is considered by many to be feeble for its size, especially after losing its advanced technology from the Star League. Carrying an AC/10, a SRM-6, and a pair each of Medium and Small Lasers, the Champion is woefully underarmed for its size. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The 3P is the newest variant of the Champion, introduced in 3061. The 'Mech's arsenal has been completely upgraded to modern standards with the complete removal of all of its weapons. In their place this version of the Champion carries four ER Medium Lasers, one in each arm. An Ultra Autocannon/10 replaces the LB-X Autocannon and the SRM-6 has been replaced by an improved Narc Missile Beacon. In addition, the ExtraLight engine used in the 3N has been retained and an improved C3 computer was added to allow the Champion to work as part of a 6-unit C3 network. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

Built in 2867 it uses an XL engine with the weight saved going into the addition of 5 jump jets that enable the 'Mech to jump up to 150 meters at a time. The medium lasers were upgraded to Medium Pulse Lasers and a pair of ER Medium Lasers were added. The small lasers are also upgraded to Small Pulse Lasers. The rest of the weaponry is upgraded to Clan standards and the remaining tonnage went to additional armor. content.original: The Charger is seen as an example of abject failure in BattleMech design. Wells Technologies originally wanted to produce an ultra-heavy scout 'Mech for the Star League Defense Force that was not only fast but could survive contact with the enemy. This was done by building the Charger on an 80-ton frame, making it the heaviest scout 'Mech in existence, and powering it with a massive LTV 400 fusion engine that took up almost sixty percent of the Charger's mass. With a top speed which allowed it to outrun most other 'Mechs the Charger was then given ten tons of Durallex Heavy armor, enough to survive repeated hits from a Class 20 Autocannon. However these features left very little room for offensive capability, an intentional deficiency on the part of the design team as they saw any task other than gathering data a distraction. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: Because the designers of the Charger wanted to discourage any activities that would put the 'Mech in danger, the engineers at Wells Technologies equipped the Charger with five Magna Mk I Small Lasers, mounted in its arms, torso and head. As these leave the 'Mech dangerously undergunned, arguably its most potent weapons are its fists; if the Charger is able to close the distance and get within hand-to-hand combat, it is more than capable of pounding to pieces other 'Mechs, especially lightweight ones.

content.original: The 1A5 variant of the Charger was one of the first variants of the Charger made to take it from the role of scout to assault 'Mech. A Capellan modification to the CGR-1Ls they received as part of the Kapteyn Accords, the engine was downgraded to a 320 version, which reduced the maximum speed of the 'Mech to 64.8 km/h, and four of the small lasers were removed. In their place was a Tomodzuru Autocannon/20 as its primary weapon, two Bical SRM-6 launchers and an Argra 3L Medium Laser, while the 'Mech's armor was increased by five tons. This made the CGR-1A5 extremely dangerous at close ranges and gave it a speed comparable to most 'Mechs in the heavy weight class, while carrying armor on par with other eighty-ton 'Mechs. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: A Combine-LAW attempt to make the Charger more effective at long ranges, the 1A9 used a reduced 320-rated engine, lowering its top speed to 64.8 km/h, and its arsenal was overhauled. All of the smaller lasers (except for the head mounted one) were replaced with medium lasers and a single LRM-20 launcher was mounted in the right torso, with two tons of reloads carried in the left torso. To make up for the lost mobility, four jump jets were also installed, two in each leg, to allow the Charger to jump up to one hundred and twenty meters. This variant was fielded in time to surprise the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns during the War of 3039, but in years since the design fell into the hands of the Outworlds Alliance thanks to a legal snafu which gave Ravenna Electronics a production license. content.original: An export model sold to the Capellan Confederation as part of the Kapteyn Accords, the CGR-1L was a simple modification of the Charger in an attempt to make it more effective following their disastrous use on Chara in 3023. In place of four and a half tons of armor and all five Small Lasers, the 1L mounts a Large Laser in its right arm and two medium lasers in either side torso. While more prone to overheating and less protected - mounting armor comparable to that of a traditional scout 'Mech - it was better capable of defending itself against other scout 'Mechs, and at the time that was good enough for the desperate warriors of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces. Since then, the CGR-1L has remained in Capellan service as a training 'Mech and, according to rumor, punishment assignment for dissident soldiers. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: Because the designers of the Charger wanted to discourage any activities that would put the 'Mech in danger, the engineers at Wells Technologies equipped the Charger with five Magna Mk I Small Lasers, mounted in its arms, torso and head. As these leave the 'Mech dangerously undergunned, arguably its most potent weapons are its fists; if the Charger is able to close the distance and get within hand-to-hand combat, it is more than capable of pounding to pieces other 'Mechs, especially lightweight ones.

content.original: Draconis Combine's 3K was an upgrade of the 1A9 that used an uprated XL engine to raise the Charger's top speed back to 86.4 km/h. The head-mounted small laser was removed, the medium lasers were swapped out for Medium Pulse Lasers, and the LRM-20 launcher was mated with an Artemis IV fire control system to improve accuracy. The addition of a fifth jump jet mounted in the rear torso gave the 'Mech a jumping distance of up to one hundred and fifty meters. This variant was confirmed to have been deployed on An Ting in the War of 3039 and may have been what Davion forces initially dubbed the Charger II; however, descriptions of the Charger II suggest that it was more likely a LRM-equipped variant of the Hatamoto-Chi (presumably the -Kaze). Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: A typical Periphery raider, the Cicada 2P is fast and hard hitting but lacks endurance and cannot survive long once it has delivered it's payload. 4 RL-20's make up the bulk of the mechs firepower, capable of threatening even an Assault mech if used correctly. The secondary weapons are a pair of medium chem lasers with a ton of ammo between them. Achieving almost identical speeds to its Inner Sphere counterparts, the 2P is designed as a heavy scout and head hunter with a nasty alpha strike capable of shredding most opponents regardless of the target. Designed to be easy to maintain and even easier to replace, the 2P is built with parts that can be salvaged from most battlefields or brought in any number of back street bazaars or disreputable arms markets. Indeed, most new 2P’s are often repurposed wrecks hauled off the battlefield and rebuilt as quickly as possible. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

Powered by a 320 rated XL Engine, the Cicada 3M is armed with a pair of Medium Lasers, a Small pulse Laser and a UAC/5.
content.content: Введенная в 2740 году, 40-тонная Cicada была разработана как конкурент Locust. Немного лучше вооруженная и столь же быстрая, Cicada благодаря более тяжелой броне и лучшим возможностям в ближнем бою может эффективно выполнять функции охотника за легкими мехами и разведчика. Оснащенная термоядерным реактором XL320, Cicada 3M вооружена парой средних лазеров, небольшим импульсным лазером и UAC/5.

content.original: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The 1-2R Clint was the original prototype variant that carried an Armstrong Buster Autocannon/10 with a single Medium Laser as a secondary weapon and no jump jets. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. Развивая максимальную скорость 97,2 км/ч и прыгая на 180 метров, «Клинт» легко поспевает за другими развед юнитами и маневрирует в горной и городской местности. Этот вариант «Клинта» оснащён двумя автопушками Autocannon/2 вместо одной AC/5, что обеспечивает ему одну из самых больших дальностей стрельбы для такого компактного шасси. Он также оснащён одним средним лазером в качестве вспомогательного оружия. Как и вариант 1-2R, вариант 2-4T не имеет возможности совершать прыжки.

content.original: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. Produced by the Taurian Concordat at the outbreak of the Jihad, the 3-3T modifies the original 2-3T. It adds Ferro-Fibrous armor to the design and swaps out the AC/5 with a Light AC/5, presumably supplied to them by the Word of Blake. This lighter weapon makes room for the inclusion of CASE and two tons of ammunition, ensuring it is able to carry various types of munitions.

content.original: When General Aleksandr Kerensky led most of the Star League Defense Force into exile in 2784, they brought prototypes of the Clint BattleMech with them. After the annihilation of Clan Wolverine, Clan Snow Raven revisited these prototypes and was able to begin mass-production of the 'Mech in 2830 and introduced 2842. They ensured that it kept up with advances in Clan technology, eventually becoming the design that is now known as the Clint IIC. This speedy medium 'Mech is armed with a Type KOV LB-10X Autocannon and a pair of Series 2d ER Medium Lasers. This makes the Clint IIC an effective light 'Mech killer. It is capable of ranging far beyond supply lines thanks to its four tons of ammunition, though it only uses ten standard heat sinks and seven tons of standard armor. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: During the Amaris Civil War, several Lyran MechWarriors joined the SLDF in defiance of their government's policy of neutrality. With this came the coup that the Star League Defense Force had attempted to pull off for decades: the acquisition of the Lyran Commando. Long considered one of the better scout 'Mechs in the Inner Sphere, at least one of these Commandos accompanied Kerensky into exile and several of them appeared in the forces assigned to Operation Klondike. As newer weapons and 'Mechs made their way into the Clan arsenal, these Commandos began to show their age, so Clan Goliath Scorpion began a program to upgrade theirs. Dubbed the Commando IIC, this upgrade used newer technologies to outperform its venerable cousin. With the proliferation of OmniMechs, most Commando IICs were relegated to second line status, though the Scorpions still continue to outfit some of their pirate hunters with these 'Mechs. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Conjurer is a fast, inexpensive medium BattleMech that excels at medium to short range. As befitting its status as a second-line 'Mech, the Conjurer uses a standard engine, though it is constructed on an Endo Steel chassis and uses eight and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Its jump jets enable it to leap up to 180 meters at a time. Armed with a Large Pulse Laser, the Conjurer can fall back on paired ER Medium Lasers and Streak SRM-2s for closer range combat. Ten double heat sinks are able to keep heat under control. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: First produced in late fall of 3054, the Copperhead is a finely honed arena 'Mech. The design rose to fame when Silver Dragons Stables MechWarrior Brendon Frazer piloted his Copperhead, the Silver Snake, into the Solaris Top Twenty prior to his untimely death. The Silver Dragons commissioned Solaris Arms to develop a new exclusive variant to try and repeat the feat, but the new model's expensive experimental weaponry forced them to allow sales to other interested parties. The Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery snapped up a number of the original CPR-HD-002 models. While not increasing the original model's meager four and half tons of armor coverage, Solaris Arms chose to replace the original Durallex plating with ArcShield Reflective Armor to enhance its endurance against the large volume of energy weapons carried by Arena 'Mechs. Already a relatively speedy design, the addition of a Supercharger enhanced its ground speed. Its extremely short jumping distance was neither improved nor removed; instead it was retained to expand a pilot's options in tight terrain. An extra Double Heat Sink, bringing the total to thirteen, is still not enough to keep up with the increased heat produced by the CPR-HD-003's advanced laser weaponry. Allowing the designers to squeeze in the new systems, a cramped Small Cockpit is used, which is less of a liability in the short duration arena battles than on an actual battlefield. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

Silver Dragons заказали Solaris Arms разработку нового эксклюзивного варианта, чтобы попытаться повторить подвиг, но дорогостоящее экспериментальное вооружение новой модели заставило их разрешить продавать его и другим заинтересованным сторонам. content.original: The Corona is a battle armor design that was created by Clan Star Adder following the Trials to determine which Clans would take part in Operation REVIVAL. The idea was to build the battlesuit around a weapon that could threaten 'Mechs from a distance. The mass necessary to mount such a heavy weapon resulted in a twenty percent armor decrease and the removal of the jump pack, despite a fifty percent overall increase in mass. Quirk: Elemental Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.875 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

Идея заключалась в том, чтобы создать боекостюм с оружием, способным поражать мехи на расстоянии. content.original: The Cossack is named after the mercenary unit Khorsakov's Cossacks in honor of their faithful service to the St Ives Compact. The Cossack is a practice in compromise. Originally requested as the fastest 'Mech that Ceres Metals Industries could produce, the emphasis of the design changed throughout its development to a slow moving, heavily armored light 'Mech. The final design that was accepted became the current incarnation of the Cossack. The Cossack is built on a Taijian Series X Endo Steel chassis to save weight. More weight was cut from the design by using a lightweight Hermes 120 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 97.2 km/h. Six Pitban LFT-65 jump jets allow the Cossack to jump up to hundred and eighty meters, allowing the 'Mech to easily handle most rough terrain. For protection, the Cossack has three tons of armor and has ten heat sinks to handle the heat produced by the weapons payload carried by the 'Mech. Overall, the compromise that created the Cossack has turned it into a light trooper 'Mech that works well as part of a team but alone excels at no one role. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97

Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. Вместо того, чтобы тратить драгоценные ресурсы на разработку нового омнимеха с нуля, она поручила своим ученым усовершенствовать существующие конструкции. Ученые решили модифицировать Adder. content.original: The Coyotl has the honor of being the first OmniMech. Developed by Clan Coyote with some help from Clan Sea Fox, the Coyotl was first fielded in 2854. By using an XL Engine and Endo Steel chassis, the scientists were able to create a medium 'Mech that could carry a great deal of equipment. In addition, the high ground speed of the Coyotl allowed it to rush from one area of a battlefield to another, providing support for its teammates. The A configuration was introduced during a conflict against Clan Cloud Cobra. Seven Jump Jets gave the Coyotl A much greater maneuverability, while the long range weapons were traded for a Large Pulse Laser, Small Pulse Laser, and an additional Streak SRM-4 launcher. This version also dropped the Medium Pulse Laser of the original. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: A Star League era training mech, the Crockett was introduced in 2735. An 85-ton mech with a mix of weapon types alongside double heat sinks, the Crockett would go on to see frontline service as a command mech and assault mech. The CRK-5003-0 is a downgrade resulting from the Succession War’s decline in technology and features a 255-rated engine alongside a trio of Jump Jets. A pair of Large Lasers and an AC/10 form the bulk of the mechs weapons, with paired SRM-6's Lasers and Small Lasers surprising opponents at close range. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Cronus was designed by Angus Gilmour to be a cost-effective 'Mech for use by mercenaries and small Periphery units using scrapped military equipment. After retiring from service with the Free Worlds League Military in the 3rd Succession War, Gilmour and many ex-technicians he recruited began working for the family business, Gilmour MilTech, on his home planet Talitha. While Gilmour MilTech would spend much of its time rebuilding/restoring wrecked equipment, technicians with free time constructed small numbers of the Cronus. An inexpensive, hand-built design, the Cronus combines design aspects of many different 55-ton BattleMechs seen on the modern battlefield. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.content: «Хронос» был разработан Ангусом Гилмуром как бюджетный мех для наемников и небольших подразделений Периферии, где в ходу была списанная в утиль техника. Уволившись со службы в вооруженных силах Лиги Свободных Миров во время 3-й Наследной войны, Гилмур и многие набранные им бывшие техники стали работать в семейном бизнесе Gilmour MilTech на его родной планете, Талита. В то время как Gilmour MilTech проводили большую часть своего времени, восстанавливая разбитое оборудование, техники, у которых было свободное время, собирали небольшие партии Cronus. Недорогая конструкция ручной сборки, Cronus сочетает в себе конструктивные особенности многих 55-тонных боевых мехов, встречающихся на современном поле боя. Особенность: Прост в обслуживании Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.03

content.original: The upgraded Cronus is built on a lightweight Earthwerk SHD II Endo Steel chassis that carries a VOX 330 XL engine, providing a top speed of 97.2 km/h. The Cronus has enhanced mobility with six Northrup 12000 jump jets that allow the 'Mech to jump up to one hundred and eighty meters. It is protected with ten and a half tons of Maximillian 43 armor, with CASE. The Cronus is able to handle the heat from its weapons with fourteen double heat sinks and is fitted with a C3 slave unit, allowing it to be integrated into a C3 unit. The Cronus has a Magna Sunspot ER PPC as its primary long ranged weapon. The ER PPC is capable of delivering consistent damage at all of its range brackets. For close combat, the Cronus has two Diverse Optics Type ER Medium Lasers and a single Diverse Optics Type ER Small Laser. Finally, to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor, the Cronus carries a Harpoon-4S Streak SRM-4.

As was the case with the Coventry Defense Conglomerate, Arcturan Arms’ engineers initially failed to make their prototype Crossbow live up to expectations, but as the techniques for producing BattleMechs grew more refined, the Crossbow received an upgrade worthy of its original concept. Как и в случае с Coventry Defense Conglomerate, инженеры Arcturan Arms сначала не смогли сделать свой прототип «Кроссбоу» соответствующим ожиданиям, но по мере совершенствования технологий производства боевых мехов «Кроссбоу» получил модернизацию, достойную его первоначальной концепции. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

content.original: After the discovery of the Helm Memory Core and the development of several additional key technologies, Magna Metals Inc. revisited the Cyclone design in 3058. The B2 variant features an Endo-Steel chassis paired with a 180L Fusion Engine to make room for a pair of experimental Hellcat Class 5 Thunderbolt 5 launchers with a ton of ammunition each and a pair of Magna Mk VI ER Medium Lasers. Further differences from the previous A3 variant come in the form of Double Heat Sinks, lower arm and hand actuators, and the reintroduction of the Guardian ECM Suite. The Cyclone B2 found only a tepid response from military buyers as the Thunderbolt missiles are susceptible to being rendered ineffectual by Anti-Missile Systems. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

content.original: The original version of the Dervish that was produced in 2520 was not up to the same standards as contemporary Terran Hegemony designs. The use of comparatively "primitive" parts resulted in a heavier cockpit, engine, and less efficient armor. Consequently, the 1S had a top speed of 64 km/h and could only jump ninety meters. While the missile launchers were the same as the 6M, it did not have that version's lasers. 1S variants continued to exist in militias, but were raided for parts during the Succession Wars. It was not intended for front line use, but for Militia units. Though there were few, if any, remaining by the end of the 2990s, they once again began to be produced on low-tech worlds during the Jihad due to that conflict's disruption of supply lines. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.83 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: Первоначальный вариант «Дервиша», выпущенный в 2520 г., не соответствовал эталонным образцам Гегемонии Терры. Использование сравнительно «примитивных» деталей привело к утяжелению кабины, двигателя и снижению эффективности брони. В результате максимальная скорость 1S составила 64 км/ч, а прыжок достигал лишь 90 метров. Хотя пусковые установки были такими же, как у 6М, лазеры на этой версии отсутствовали. Варианты 1S продолжали существовать в ополчениях, но во время Наследных войн растаскивались рейдерами на запчасти. Хотя к концу 2990-х годов их осталось мало, если вообще остались, они вновь стали производиться на низкотехнологичных мирах во время Джихада. content.original: The Dervish carries as its main weapons two Federated 10-Shot LRM launchers. These missile launchers give the Dervish the long-range capability needed to provide fire support to friendly units and are safely embedded in the torso as opposed to the exposed launchers on other 'Mechs. A ton of ammunition per launcher provides sufficient endurance for any but the most prolonged battles. For close combat, the Dervish carries two Federated 2-Shot SRM launchers and two ChisComp 39 Medium Lasers. The SRM launchers are completely self-contained within the forearms, allowing them to be aimed quickly, and fed by a ton of ammunition each. The lasers are placed just above the launchers and ensure the 'Mech is still capable of fighting should it run out of missiles. The Dervish is capable of jumping 150 meters and is protected by seven and a half tons of armor. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

Later Clan Wolverine would overhaul the weapons completely, leaving the Improved Gauss Rifles in place (adding CASE to the arms for protection), but trading the PPCs for Enhanced ER PPCs and the medium lasers for ER medium lasers. content.original: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: «Лютоволк» - один из тех омнимехов, которых стали бояться во Внутренней Сфере во время первого вторжения Кланов, и вполне заслуженно. «Лютоволк» весит внушительные сто тонн и имеет относительно невысокую крейсерскую скорость 54 км/ч, обеспечиваемую двигателем 300 XL. По скорости и бронезащите он не уступает «Атласу», но обладает более высокой потенциальной огневой мощью с 55,5 тонн свободного пространства для оружия и оборудования. Именно за эти качества в криминальных кругах Синдиката Дракона мех окрестили Daishi (псевдояпонское название «Великая смерть»), и это название раз за разом подтверждало свою мрачную правоту. Особенность: Улучшенное наведение - Long Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.19 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: The S configuration is intended for the close confines of urban and jungle warfare. The S configurations primary weapon is a massive LB-X Autocannon/20 which is capable of disabling most light and medium 'Mechs in a single blast. This is backed up by a single Large Pulse Laser to provide some long range firepower should the Dire Wolf S be caught in the open. Additional short range firepower is provided by five Medium Pulse Lasers and two Streak SRM-4 launchers. Two Anti-Personnel Pods and two Machine Guns provide exceptional anti-infantry capabilities. The S configuration has added mobility with three jump jets allowing it to jump up to ninety meters. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The brainchild of Stefan Amaris, the Dragoon BattleMech was envisioned as part of Amaris's ambitious plan to create a family of 'modular' multi-mission combat units for his Amaris Empire Armed Forces. In the year following the Amaris Coup, now-Emperor Amaris would have a means to make his dream into reality, and he began swiftly issuing contracts which would lead to the creation of the Dragoon. Originally built by Krupp Stellar Technologies Inc., the Dragoon was designed with a similar modular subsystem akin to the Mercury. With this system, the 'Mech's maintenance loads would be eased. Its modular nature would allow repair depots and factories to be able to reconfigure the design's weapons systems and its power plant for any needed mission-specific specs.

content.original: The brainchild of Stefan Amaris, the Dragoon BattleMech was envisioned as part of Amaris's ambitious plan to create a family of 'modular' multi-mission combat units for his Amaris Empire Armed Forces. In the year following the Amaris Coup, now-Emperor Amaris would have a means to make his dream into reality, and he began swiftly issuing contracts which would lead to the creation of the Dragoon. Originally built by Krupp Stellar Technologies Inc., the Dragoon was designed with a similar modular subsystem akin to the Mercury. With this system, the 'Mech's maintenance loads would be eased. Its modular nature would allow repair depots and factories to be able to reconfigure the design's weapons systems and its power plant for any needed mission-specific specs.

content.original: The standard against which all battle armor is measured, the Elemental battle armor was first introduced in 2868 by Clan Wolf in a Trial of Possession against the Nova Cats. It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential. Quirk: Elemental Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня Elemental, являющаяся стандартом, по которому измеряется вся боевая броня, была впервые представлена в 2868 году кланом Волка в ходе испытания владения против Нова Котов. Это было чудо инженерной мысли Кланов, позволившее небольшой группе воинов в броне уничтожить большие мехи и выжить. Хотя боевая броня может использоваться и людьми нормального роста, их конструкция разработана специально для гигантских воинов-элементалей Кланов, и только они могут раскрыть их потенциал в полной мере. Особенность: Elemental Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.87 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

Quirk: Elemental Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
content.content: Боевая броня Elemental, являющаяся стандартом, по которому измеряется вся боевая броня, была впервые представлена в 2868 году кланом Волка в ходе испытания владения против Нова Котов. Это было чудо инженерной мысли Кланов, позволившее небольшой группе воинов в броне уничтожить большие мехи и выжить. Хотя боевая броня может использоваться и людьми нормального роста, их конструкция разработана специально для гигантских воинов-элементалей Кланов, и только они могут раскрыть их потенциал в полной мере. Особенность: Elemental Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.87 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Enfield was originally designed to replace the Wyvern as an urban combat 'Mech, but the design never made it to mass production. The plans for the Enfield were lost during the Succession Wars and were recovered by the Federated Suns on the world of Achernar in 2870. Knowledge of the design was kept hidden until the 3050s, when the NAIS selected the Enfield as a companion 'Mech to the Enforcer. The Enfield began production in 3055 and has seen heavy deployment to the Lyran Alliance because of the constant threat presented by the Clans. The 'Mech carries eleven tons of StarGuard III armor with CASE to protect against ammunition explosions. The Enfield is built on a Blackstone MD2E Endo Steel chassis and uses a Magna 250 XL engine which gives the 'Mech a top speed of 86.4 km/h to save weight, allowing it to carry a heavy arsenal. Due its extra-light engine, however, the 'Mech developed an undeserved reputation for being fragile in heavy combat. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

The saved weight is used to add five jump jets, allowing the Enfield to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. This variant of the Enfield is very reliable, and although it loses some firepower and accuracy in the Large Laser, the addition of the jump jets gives it a high degree of mobility and survivability.

The Enfield began production in 3055 and has seen heavy deployment to the Lyran Alliance because of the constant threat presented by the Clans. The 'Mech carries eleven tons of StarGuard III armor with CASE to protect against ammunition explosions. The Enfield is built on a Blackstone MD2E Endo Steel chassis and uses a Magna 250 XL engine which gives the 'Mech a top speed of 86.4 km/h to save weight, allowing it to carry a heavy arsenal. Due its extra-light engine, however, the 'Mech developed an undeserved reputation for being fragile in heavy combat. content.original: First walking off the production line in late 3050, the 5D Enforcer is a major upgrade to the standard 'Mech, meeting many of its pilots' desire for something faster, better-protected and with more endurance. The Nissan 200 engine has been removed and replaced with a Magna 250 Extralight Engine, increasing the Enforcer's top speed to 86.4 km/h and the amount of space available for other additions. The armor has been stripped from the 'Mech and replaced with StarGuard CIV Ferro-Fibrous armor with CASE to protect against an ammunition explosion while the weapons payload has also been changed. Retaining the small laser both the Autocannon/10 and the Large Laser were replaced for a new Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10, fed by two tons of ammunition, and a BlazeFire Sweetshot ER Large Laser. Finally, an additional jump jet was added, increasing the jumping distance by thirty meters to keep up with the Enforcer's new speed profile. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The aging Enforcer was commissioned to be redesigned by then First Prince Victor Steiner-Davion in an effort to rebuild his image within the sundered Federated Commonwealth. The resulting Enforcer III is built on a Endo Steel chassis, with further weight savings achieved through the use of a 250 XL Engine. Five jump jets grants a jumping capability of one hundred and fifty meters. The Enforcer III is armored with ten tons of standard armor that gives it good armor protection for its size. The Enforcer III carries as its primary weapon a UAC/10, backed up by an ER Large Laser and an ER Small Laser. This balanced mix of weapons makes the Enforcer III a powerful medium 'Mech. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
