content.original: The Shadow Hawk IIC is a second-line Clan BattleMech based upon the Shadow Hawk that was first fielded by the Star League. The first version of the Shadow Hawk IIC is meant for close-range fighting, and appears to be designed with urban warfare in mind. It is armed with a Medium Pulse Laser in each arm, two Streak SRM-2 launchers in each side torso, an ER Medium Laser in the head, and an ER Small Laser in the torso. Ten double heat sinks take care of most heat, especially since the Streaks will build no heat if they do not achieve a lock and fire. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

content.original: Allied Aerospace won the SLDF's contract to produce a series of Land-Air mechs with a design based on the venerable Shadow HawkBattleMech. Allied gave their new Land-Air 'Mech the ability to convert directly into an Aerospace Fighter. While construction was completed in 2680, thanks to the chassis' numerous flaws, lackluster performance and a number of ill-fated and publicly witnessed test-flights disasters during SLDF reviews in 2682, Allied Aerospace was forced to go back to the drawing board. The more refined X2 variant faced considerable scrutiny by SLDF evaluators in 2684, successfully meeting the SLDF's requirements but still rejected thanks to its high fuel consumption and the bad press generated by the earlier X1. Twenty SHD-X2 were built for trials with potential customers, but failed to attract any interest. Ultimately Allied scrapped the Shadow Hawk LAM program in favor of what became the considerably more successful Phoenix Hawk LAM. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: The 5M Shadow Hawk is the first complete overhaul and upgrade of the design, unveiled in 3048 by Earthwerks for the Free Worlds League. The chassis has been upgraded to an Earthwerks SHD II Endo Steel frame, an additional ton of armor was added, two additional jump jets were fitted for a total jumping distance of 150 meters, the engine replaced with an extralight version of the Hermes 275, and the weapons load has undergone an almost complete renovation. The original autocannon has been updated to an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5, the LRM launcher to a Doombud LRM-20, and the head-mounted SRM launcher to a Hovertec Streak SRM-2. The amount of ammunition carried and the left-arm medium laser are maintained, and while the number of heat sinks was reduced to ten these were upgrade to double-strength models. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Shogun began production before the Star League fell and eventually was thought to be lost to the Succession Wars. The 'Mech suddenly reappeared when Wolf's Dragoons showed up in 3005, bringing a sizable number of Shoguns with them. The 'Mech was intended to be used as an urban combat 'Mech where its jumping distance and slow speed makes it able to easily traverse the close confines of a city. Though the Dragoons brought Shoguns with them from the Clan Homeworlds, they could not reach a deal with any manufacturer that met their desires, so by 3068 the total count of the 'Mech in the Inner Sphere was reduced to two, both of which were in the hands of Wannamaker's Widowmakers, taken as salvage from the Dragoons.

content.content: Производство «Сёгуна» началось ещё до падения Звёздной Лиги, и в конечном итоге все посчитали, что мех был утерян в Наследных войнах. Мех внезапно появился вновь с появлением Волчьих Драгун в 3005 году, приведя с собой значительное количество «Сёгунов». Мех предназначался для использования в качестве городского боевого меха, где его дальность прыжка и низкая скорость позволяли ему легко пересекать тесные городские границы. Хотя Драгуны привезли с собой «Сёгунов» из родных миров Кланов, им не удалось заключить сделку ни с одним производителем, который бы отвечал их требованиям, поэтому к 3068 году общее количество этих мехов во Внутренней Сфере сократилось до двух, оба из которых оказались в руках Wannamaker's Widowmakers, отнятых у Драгун.

content.original: Though built for close combat, the weapons payload on the Shogun is built for long range combat. The 'Mech carries as its primary weapon a ER PPC and two LRM-15 launchers which allow the 'Mech to engage an enemy very effectively at long ranges. The 'Mech does also carry two SRM-6 launchers for close combat, allowing the 'Mech to find any weak spots in an enemy's armor when they do get to close ranges with the Shogun. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Shootist first saw service in 2621 as a heavily armored, electronic warfare-capable command 'Mech for SLDF Royal BattleMech Regiments. However, the Shootist's upgraded electronic suites proved no match for the cutting edge of electronic warfare of its own time. When the BattleMaster eclipsed the Shootist in its intended role as a command vehicle merely ten years after its introduction, the SLDF changed the Shootist's mission parameters. The Shootist's balanced mix of weapons and speed, and its heavy armor allowed it a new role: juggernaut for close-combat heavy lances, and later, a bodyguard unit for command lances. This role never proved favorable to the longevity of the Shootist; since the Succession Wars, this BattleMech is rarely seen outside of the ComGuards, Word of Blake Militia, and ancient Clan Brian Caches. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper

content.original: The Shootist has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, giving it an average level of mobility for a heavy 'Mech. The 'Mech has thirteen double heat sinks that allow the Shootist to dissipate the waste heat that is produced by its heavy weapons payload. The Shootist carries twelve tons of MV Ferro-Fibrous armor with CASE to protect the 'Mech in the event of an ammunition explosion. The Shootist is armed to engage an enemy at various ranges. The only long-range weapon on the 'Mech is a Blankenburg ER Large Laser that has an effective range of five hundred and seventy meters. For medium to close range combat, the Shootist carries a devastating Deathgiver Autocannon/20 which is capable of downing most light and even some medium 'Mechs in a single salvo. Finally, for point blank defense, the 'Mech has two Blankenburg Medium Pulse Lasers and a Dinatech Mark III Small Laser.

content.original: The Inner Sphere adapted to battle armor quickly after being introduced to the concept by the Clan Elemental suit, so much so that the IS started innovating and testing the limits of what was possible almost immediately. In the 3050s the Lyran Commonwealth led the charge with this, the Sloth, the first quadruped battle armor. The Lyrans armed each suit with two Small Lasers and a BA-scale Pop-Up Mine, a weapon designed to penetrate armor and deal direct internal damage. The Sloth proved dangerous but unwieldy to control, making it unpopular with pilots. Quirk: IS Standard Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can only mount internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.original: The Snake is a 'Mech that was built under the aegis of an Elemental hunter. With the power of hindsight though the Snake is clearly designed to hunt Inner Sphere Battle Armor suits. The 'Mech is built using a Vox 225 XL Engine to move at a top speed of 86.4 km/h. The Snake also has a jumping capability of one hundred and fifty meters making it capable of outmaneuvering any battle armor suit and also keeping it on par with most medium 'Mechs. The Snake is also armored with seven tons of armor and uses double heat sinks to cool the 'Mech's excess heat. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Snow Fox was designed by Clan Ice Hellion as a fast 'Mech that is capable of fulfilling a number of roles. Its primary weapon is its speed, which it uses to quickly close with enemies, swiftly damage them, and get out before repeating the process. It has also found use as a Battle Armor hunter. The Hellions scientists were also gauging warrior interest in a quad design and saw the Snow Fox as a test bed for a future quad OmniMech, but the interest was not there. Not only are bipedal 'Mechs more intuitive to operate, the fast quad takes getting used to and lacks hands.

content.original: StarCorps Industries’s Project: SORCERER was shrouded in such secrecy that the first Sorcerer Battlemechs just seemed to appear in Star League Defense Force ranks where they were met with varying degrees of suspicion. The 95-ton Sorcerer 1A is built around a PlasmaStar 380XL engine to propel it to a respectable 64.8 km/h which enables the Sorcerer to bring its arsenal and Guardian ECM Suite to the enemy. The design carries a pair of Ceres Arms Smasher PPCs, a pair of Donal Snub-Nose PPCs, a pair of Magna MkII Medium Lasers, and a Magna MkI Small Laser. A staggering twenty Double Heat Sinks is barely enough to keep the weapons’ heat generation in check. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17

content.original: Shortly after the Sorcerer 1A began walking off of the StarCorps Industries production lines on Fletcher, the Sorcerer 1B began production in the satellite facility on Crofton. The 1B variant trades in the array of PPCs and Lasers for a Blankenburg Technologies ER PPC, a pair of Artemis IV-enhanced Holly LRM15s, and a trio of Defiance P5M Medium Pulse Lasers. The reduced Heat generation of this payload allowed designers to remove the five external Double Heat Sinks and freed up room for CASE in the right torso. content.original: Of the relatively few Sorcerers built before the Amaris Coup, the Sorcerer 1CC variant was considered an exceptionally rare design. Originally planned as a replacement for the 90 ton Cyclops, it quickly became apparent that the design teams at StarCorps Industries were not going to be able to best its incredible computer systems. Rather than spending several more decades of development, the design team decided that modifying the Sorcerer 1A would be a suitable method to cut corners. The 1CC drops the Snub-Nose PPCs, lasers and five Double Heat Sinks in order to mount an additional Ceres Arms Smasher PPC, a quintet of Magna 400P Medium Pulse Lasers, and the advanced Command Console. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19

content.original: StarCorps Industries’s Project: SORCERER is considered one of the best examples of effective counter-industrial espionage techniques; despite being in development for nearly two decades, the various intelligence agencies of the Great Houses never managed to collect any meaningful data on the program. The project’s primary goal was to create an assault BattleMech capable of slipping behind and operations behind enemy lines for an indefinite period of time and if at all possible, do this task undetected. Produced in exceptionally small quantities up until Amaris forces overran their facilities on Fletcher, the 95-ton Sorcerer 1X sports a combination of a Null Signature System and a Chameleon Light Polarization Shield. The 1X carries a pair of Ceres Arms Smasher PPCs, a pair of Donal Snub-Nose PPCs, and pair of Magna 400P Medium Pulse Lasers which in combination with the stealth systems onboard can easily overpower the Mech’s nineteen Double Heat Sinks. Few remember the 1X variant as the more widely-produced and fielded 1A variant stepped off of the manufacturing lines on the same day. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19

content.original: Like many designs lost during the Succession Wars, the Sorcerer design saw new life in the decades after the discovery of the Helm Memory Core. The Draconis Combine was the first to create a new variant of the aged SLDF design utilizing technologies at their disposal in 3058. The Sorcerer 2D retains the 380XL Engine, Guardian ECM Suite, one of the original PPCs, and thirteen of the original Double Heat Sinks and adds a pair of Shigunga MRM40s fed by four tons of ammo. A Small Laser is also added to the right arm for anti-personnel work. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15

Released in 3051 it uses a Crucis-II Delux Endo Steel chassis and three tons of Kallon FWL Special Ferro-Fibrous armor, freeing up weight to replace the two medium lasers with two Tronel XII medium pulse lasers. Many of the components were also replaced with proprietary technology, including Rawlings 75 jump jets, an Omicron 4002 Networking Channel, and a TRSS Eagle Eye targeting system. One thing they could not do however was include an ejection system for the pilot. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

content.original: The Primary configuration requires a very skilled MechWarrior to operate properly, using advanced volley and engage tactics. During the volley phase the 'Mech should engage with some of its ER Large Lasers, but keeping heat under control. As the engagement distance shrinks, the use of the Large Lasers should be switched to the Medium Pulse Lasers instead. If at any point all lasers will be fire together, the 'Mech will most likely instantly go into overheat shutdown. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: An upgrade originating from the Free Worlds League, the 5M variant of the Stalker was introduced in 3050 using moderate amounts of Star League technology. Most of the weaponry was retained but both large lasers were removed for a single Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser placed in the 'Mech's centerline and a Narc Missile Beacon in the left torso accompanied by two tons of reloads, allowing the Stalker to tag enemy units with homing beacon and direct friendly missile fire onto them. The seventeen double heat sinks of the 5M afford it far greater heat efficiency than the twenty single heat sinks of previous models, although it still could not handle firing all of its weaponry simultaneously, and an additional ton of armor was added for survivability. Other changes included the use of proprietary components such as an Irian E.A.R. communications system, Riese-456 armor and a Irian Chassis Class 30. Unfortunately the designers of the new 5M dismissed the inclusion of CASE, a factor which led directly to the deaths of several Stalkers during the Clan Invasion due to ammunition cook-offs caused by overheating and weapon penetrations. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.content: Модернизированный Лигой Свободных Миров, 5M-вариант «Сталкера» был представлен в 3050 году с использованием технологий Звёздной Лиги. Большая часть вооружения осталась прежней, но оба больших лазера были удалены ради одного большого лазера Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser, и ракетного маяка Narc с двумя тоннами боеприпасов, что позволяет «Сталкеру» помечать вражеские юниты самонаводящимся маяком и направлять на них ракетный огонь. Семнадцать двойных радиаторов -5M дают гораздо лучшую теплоэффективность, чем двадцать одинарных радиаторов предыдущих моделей, хотя он всё ещё не мог вести одновременный огонь из всего своего вооружения. Для живучести была добавлена дополнительная тонна брони. Среди других изменений - использование фирменных компонентов, таких как система связи Irian E.A.R., броня Riese-456 и структура Irian Class 30. К сожалению, конструкторы нового -5М отказались от включения CASE, что напрямую привело к гибели нескольких «Сталкеров» во время вторжения Кланов из-за перегрева боеприпасов и пробития брони. content.original: An upgrade originating from the Free Worlds League, the 5M variant of the Stalker uses moderate amounts of Star League technology. The seventeen double heat sinks of the 5M afford it far greater heat efficiency than the twenty single heat sinks of previous models. The Large Lasers were removed, replaced with a single Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser placed in the 'Mech's centerline and a Narc Missile Beacon. The beacon allows the Stalker to tag enemy units with homing beacons, allowing friendly 'Mechs to easily send missile salvos its way. Finally, the 'Mech bears an additional ton of armor for added survivability.
content.prevOriginal: An upgrade originating from the Free Worlds League, the 5M variant of the Stalker uses moderate amounts of Star League technology. The seventeen double heat sinks of the 5M afford it far greater heat efficiency than the twenty single heat sinks of previous models. The Large Lasers were removed, replaced with a single Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser placed in the 'Mech's centerline and a Narc Missile Beacon. The beacon allows the Stalker to tag enemy units with homing beacons, allowing friendly 'Mechs to easily send missile salvos its way. Finally, the 'Mech bears an additional ton of armor for added survivability.
content.content: Модернизированный Лигой Свободных Миров, вариант «Сталкера» -5М использует умеренное количество технологий Звёздной Лиги. Семнадцать двойных радиаторов в -5M обеспечивают гораздо лучшую теплоэффективность, чем двадцать одинарных радиаторов предыдущих моделей. Большие лазеры были удалены, их заменили одним Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser, размещённым в центре меха, а также маяком Narc. Маяк позволяет «Сталкеру» помечать вражеские юниты самонаводящимися маячками, что позволяет дружественным мехам легко посылать ракетные залпы в их сторону. И наконец, мех несёт дополнительную тонну брони для повышения живучести.

content.original: Outfitted with the relatively recently rediscovered Star League technology of circa 3050, the FedCom 5S can be characterized primarily by its tendency to overheat. The designers behind this variant took the simple expedient of upgrading its engine and firepower without taking heat build-up into consideration. The 'Mech has had its engine replaced with an XL Engine and the large lasers have been removed and replaced with two Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Lasers. For protection against ammunition explosions, CASE has been added to both side torsos, and an Deprus Swarmshot Anti-Missile System has been added for protection against incoming missiles. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The big gun on the Stalking Spider is its ER PPC, which allows it deal a strong strike from long ranges. For close-up work, it has a pair of SRM-4 launchers and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers. While the design can build a significant amount of heat if the MechWarrior constantly alpha strikes, an experienced pilot should be able to manage the Stalking Spider's heat easily. The design can stay at long range and snipe with its ER PPC, then quickly close to finish off an opponent with its pulse lasers and missiles. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: After obtaining the husk of an Inner Sphere Tarantula, Clan Cloud Cobra scientists decided to use it as the basis for a quadruped BattleMech. The 'Mech received the name Stalking Spider because it mounts enough jump jets in the legs to rocket it to 150 meters in one jump. Because the MechWarrior must move the legs during the jump, it appears that the design is crawling through the air like a spider, making it very impressive during drops. The Stalking Spider also uses MASC to move up to 119 km/h in short bursts.

content.original: A Star League era mech, the Starslayer was intended to replace the Crab as the SLDF’s standard medium chassis, though politics kept it from seeing full production until 2781. A 50 ton medium mech, the Starslayer is powered by a 250-rated fusion core and has 5 JJ’s for maximum mobility. The STY-2C-EC was an early clan mech, incorporating new technology into the older 2C chassis. It carries Improved Large Lasers, supported by 2 Prototype ER Medium Lasers and a Prototype ER Small. A Prototype Streak SRM-4 rounds out the design. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper

Starslayer — средний мех весом 50 тонн, оснащенный термоядерным реактором рейтинга 250 и 5 прыжковыми двигателями для максимальной мобильности. STY-2C-EC был одним из первых клановых мехов, в котором новые технологии были интегрированы в старую ходовую часть 2C. Он оснащен усовершенствованными большими лазерами, а также двумя прототипными средними и одним малым ER-лазерами. Завершает конструкцию прототипная Streak SRM-4. Особенность: Прочный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.02 Лимит приводов рук: Right Upper

content.original: The STL-7D Stiletto was one of very few ultralight BattleMechs designed for a specific combat role: to fight short-range delaying actions and to engage the Lyran Commonwealth's new COM-2D Commando reconnaissance 'Mech. During the 2460s and 2470s, quantities of Commandos began appearing in regiments along the Steiner/Kurita border, a situation that concerned Lord Kurita greatly. Deciding to assume the offensive, he ordered a new BattleMech design constructed, cheaper than its intended adversary and available in quantity. The result, the Stiletto, entered full-scale production in 2473. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97

content.original: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. Found in the Draconis Combine, this variant uses two pairs of Martell Small Lasers on the arms instead of a single Medium Laser. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

content.content: В 2680 году Звездная Лига запросила у разработчиков создать «мехи, которые могут и летать, и функционировать как стандартные». Первый аэромех с чертежной доски, Shadow Hawk LAM, оказался настолько несовершенным, что концепция была почти отвергнута. Тем не менее, LexaTech Industries переработала механизм трансформации и представила первый жизнеспособный LAM, Stinger LAM, в 2688 году, основанный на старом дизайне Stinger. Переделка концепции LexaTech оказалась настолько успешной, что аэромех стал очень востребованным, особенно для космических боевых действий. Фактически, Stinger LAM в своём первом бою уничтожил завод по производству ядерного оружия в облаке Оорта, вращающемся вокруг Солнца, звезды Терры. Особенность: Мех «земля-воздух» Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.99

content.original: This upgraded version of the Stinger produced by Earthwerks Incorporated on Keystone and Calloway VI took advantage of several technologies that were rediscovered, thanks in part to the Helm Memory Core. The chassis was upgraded to an Earthwerks STG II Endo Steel model, allowing it to carry an additional half-ton of armor. The 'Mech retained the Omicron medium laser but swapped the machine guns for a Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System on its right arm and a Flame Tech Flamer on its left. One ton of AMS ammo was carried in the right torso, while the Datacom 26 and Dynatec 990 electronic systems remain unchanged. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97

content.original:
The design featured Large Pulse Lasers in each arm, twin Gauss Rifles mounted behind flip-open circular firing ports on each side torso, and an almost superfluous Small Pulse Laser located above the cockpit. The Stone Rhino also sported an interesting feature; each arm contained a retractable, shock-absorbing cowl covering the weapon barrels. This allowed MechWarriors to use the arms as battering rams without damaging the weaponry. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22

content.original:
In order to plug holes in their touman, Clan Goliath Scorpion scientists revisited the Behemoth. Like Clan Smoke Jaguar before them, they upgraded and improved upon the design. This version used an Extra-light Engine to mount a pair of Thunderstroke Series 2b Gauss Rifles along the top of the 'Mech. Each arm carried a Series 4D-2 Heavy Large Laser, a Series 22a Heavy Medium Laser, and a General Systems Heavy Small Laser. It retained the shock-absorbing cowls of the original. Another pair of Heavy Mediums protected the rear of the 'Mech. A head-mounted Shield-3 Anti-Missile System defended against missiles, while an Anti-Personnel Pod in each leg discouraged unarmored infantry. This design had jump jets, nineteen tons of armor, and a meager sixteen double heat sinks. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24

Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

These combine to make a solid and well rounded configuration. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22

content.original: A common sight in Clan Toumans, the 55 ton Stormcrow is a second generation OmniMech that entered production in 2930. Powered by a 330-rated XL Engine, a combination of Ferro-Fibrous and Endo Steel give the OmniMech 23 tons of Pod Space. The Stormcrow TC is a modification to the B variant, that trades the UAC/20 for a Gauss Rifle and Targeting Computer. 4 ER Medium Lasers are the TC’s only other weapons. First seen at Tukayyid, the TC trades raw damage for increased accuracy and a smaller heat curve. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: 55-тонный Stormcrow относится ко второму поколению омнимехов, запущенных в производство в 2930 году, и часто встречающийся в туменах Кланов. Он оснащен двигателем XL рейтингом 330, а комбинация ферроволокна и эндостали даёт ему 23 тонны пространства под вооружение. Stormcrow TC - это модификация варианта B, в которой UAC/20 заменен на пушку Гаусса и компьютер наведения. Единственным доп. вооружением TC являются 4 средних ER-лазера. Впервые появившись на Тукейиде, TC разменивает урон на повышенную точность и меньший нагрев. Особенность: Стабильный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.06 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

Predating the development of the OmniMech, the Storm Giant was an early Steel Viper mech commissioned by the then Khan, Sanra Mercer. content.original: The Strider OmniMech is based on the older Cicada BattleMech. The Strider is built on an Alshain Type KR240 Endo Steel chassis to help save on weight. Built with the rugged GM 240 fusion engine, the Strider has a top speed of 97.2 km/h. Outfitted with CASE, built around the durable GM 240, and protected with seven and a half tons of armor, the Strider is a durable 'Mech for its weight class; capable of suffering considerable damage before being disabled or destroyed. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

Оснащённый надёжным термоядерным двигателем GM 240, Strider развивает максимальную скорость 97,2 км/ч. content.original: The Striker STC-2C is built using rugged, off-the-shelf technologies that allow it to stand up to a great deal of punishment and enable easy repair. The 2C has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, provided by a 320-rated Fusion engine. For protection, it carries thirteen and a half tons of armor, solidly average for a 'Mech of the Striker's size. The Striker STC-2C dissipates the heat from its arsenal with fifteen standard heat sinks. It has an arsenal that is capable of engaging an enemy at a variety of ranges. At maximum range, the 2C brings its PPC and a AC/5 to bear. As the enemy closes, it can also make use of its Large Laser, though the unit's pilot will need to monitor their heat generation carefully. Finally, for close range defense, it has three Medium Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The Striker was originally commissioned by the SLDF high command in 2571 for non-Royal SLDF units. Along with the Stalker, the Striker became one of the most common 'Mechs in service. The Striker was built with the intent of being rugged and reliable, but more importantly, allowed House Lords to reserve their precious and limited numbers of assault BattleMechs for their own personal armies. In this way, the Striker may have been the show of good faith the House Lords needed to make the Star League work. In spite of the 'Mech's dependability, the Striker was marginal compared with later assault BattleMechs, and was eventually relegated to serving in militia units, with the highest concentration ending up on the rimward edge of the Terran Hegemony. After the destruction of the Stormvanger lines in 2867, fewer than 300 Strikers were known to exist in 3058.

The PPC has been upgraded to an ER PPC, the three medium lasers have been replaced with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers, and the 'Mech has had three heat sinks removed. The remaining heat sinks have been upgraded to double heat sinks. The remaining available space has been used to add two tons of armor to the 'Mech. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

Keeping the classic jump jets and boosting armor over primary variant, an Endo Steel frame and fitting only seventeen double heat sinks are used to free up the extra weight required for the missile launchers. content.original: The Swordsman was an early Federated Suns medium-class BattleMech which was originally built in 2463 as House Davion's third in-house BattleMech design. The design was tainted by heavy use in the Davion Civil War of 2525-2540. Eventually, production ended and the design was relegated to the dustbin of history. However, in the 3060s, the mech was put back into production by House Davion to supplement their forces in the FedCom Civil War. The SWD-2 is the stock production design, mounting heavy armor and firepower for the tonnage: 7.5 tons of armor and a grab-bag mix of guns including an AC/5, LRM-5, SRM-4, two Medium Lasers, and a Small Laser. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1

Однако в 3060-х годах мех был снова запущен в производство Домом Дэвион для пополнения своих сил в Гражданской войне ФедСода. SWD-2 является стоковой моделью, несущей тяжелую броню и огневую мощь для тоннажа: 7,5 тонн брони и подборку орудий, включая AC/5, LRM-5, SRM-4, два средних лазера и малый лазер. Особенность: Встроенный прожектор Множитель стоимости высадки: 1

content.content: «Мечник» был ранним боевым мехом среднего класса Федеративных Солнц, который был первоначально построен в 2463 году как третий собственный дизайн боевого меха Дома Дэвион. Конструкция была испорчена интенсивным использованием в Гражданской войне Дэвиона 2525-2540 годов. В конце концов, производство было прекращено, и проект был отправлен на свалку истории. Однако в 3060-х годах мех был снова запущен в производство Домом Дэвион для пополнения своих сил в Гражданской войне ФедСода. SWD-2 является стоковой моделью, несущей тяжелую броню и огневую мощь для тоннажа: 7,5 тонн брони и подборку орудий, включая AC/5, LRM-5, SRM-4, два средних лазера и малый лазер.

content.original: A relic of an earlier age, it's a minor miracle this antique is still functional. Occasionally found through the frontier, surviving Taloses are a strange mix of new and old technology, bodged together by generations of different mectechs. Rarely seen and even more rarely fielded in battle, very few of these 500 year old designs still grace the modern battlefield, but those that do are treated with the respect and reverence, due to a centuries old design. The 1P is the "modern" adaptation of the older 1B design and has proliferated in recent years, leading some to speculate that a cache of Talos or Talos parts has been found. Armed with a variety of local tech and a knock-off ecm suite, the 1P is a versatile design outfitted as a mid range brawler. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: With the reintroduction of Helm Core LosTech, the Taurian Defense Force found themselves lagging behind their neighbours. Just as they did during the Age of War, the Taurians turned to the home grown Talos. With a reputation as an easy to maintain and easy to manufacture mech, the design was just what the TDF needed. Lacking the resources to turn the newly redesigned Talos into a viable production model, the Taurians enlisted the aid of their neighbours, in exchange for joining the ongoing Trinity Alliance negotiations. Aided by the expertise of Capellan engineers and financial investment from the Magistracy of Canopus, Vandenburg started limited manufacturing of the Talos; at their New Vandenburg plant: in late 3059. The formal signing of the Trinity Alliance, in 3062; awarded production licenses to both Majesty Metals and Detroit Consolidated Mech Works. Both companies swiftly opened their own lines, producing multiple variants of the Talos for their own use and for export further afield. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: Intended to emulate the Thor OmniMech used by the Clans, the Thanatos is an incredibly sturdy and hard-hitting design. Copying both the looks and the capabilities of the Clan Thor, the Thanatos is a fast all-range design, though it skimps on armor a bit for a mech its size. Carrying an ER Large Laser for long range and a brace of advanced medium lasers and a MRM-20 for medium to close range, the Thanatos has a weapon for any situation. Combined with a fast 86.4 km/h top speed and five jump jets, the Thanatos can often catch what it cannot out-range. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: Созданный по образцу омнимеха Thor, используемого Кланами, Thanatos отличается невероятной прочностью и мощью. Копируя как внешний вид, так и возможности кланового Thor, Thanatos является быстрой машиной, способной действовать на всех дистанциях, хотя для меха такого размера он немного скуповат в плане брони. Оснащенный ER Large Laser для дальних дистанций, парой усовершенствованных средних лазеров и MRM-20 для средних и ближних дистанций, Thanatos имеет оружие для любой ситуации. В сочетании с высокой максимальной скоростью 86,4 км/ч и пятью прыжковыми двигателями, Thanatos часто может догнать то, что не может перестрелять. Особенность: Стабильный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.11 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: Advanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Стандарт Внутренней Сферы был разработан после вторжения Кланов, когда державы Внутренней Сферы спешили воспроизвести технологию боевой брони Кланов. Однако, не имея никаких частей с полей сражений, инженеры были вынуждены работать на основе древних слухов о ранних силовых бронекостюмах типа Nighthawk, больше похожих на бронированные экзоскелеты, чем на тех «жаб», что встречались им в настоящее время, и их прототипы плохо показывали себя во время испытаний. Настоящий толчок в изучении боевой брони дали трофеи с первых побед над Кланами. Научный институт Нового Авалона первым частично воспроизвел броню элементалей в виде Стандарта Внутренней Сферы. Особенность: Продвинутый Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Developed in 3051 on the orders of Precentor Martial Anastasius Focht to try and close the gap between the Clans and Com Guards, the factory refit THE-N1 received its baptism of fire during the Battle of Tukayyid. Having reached a similar conclusion that resulted in the THE-Nb, the CASE was dropped and the standard engine was swapped for an XL Engine to allow the standard weaponry to be stripped for an all energy weapon array: a right arm mounted Kinslaughter H-Class ER PPC and a head-mounted Intek Small Laser. This new weapons array, enhanced by double heat sinks, added a level of lethality never seen before on the Thorn. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The advanced model employed by the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions in 2743 changed the role of the 'Mech from a missile to an energy boat, replacing the LRM launcher with an ER Large Laser, retaining one medium laser and downgrading the other to a Small Laser. Dropping the no longer required CASE, the 'Mech also used a MASC system for temporary speed bursts and Double Heat Sinks to vent its increased waste heat output. The THE-Nb mounted an XL Engine to save the weight to mount this extra equipment, at the cost of reduced survivability. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: Supplied by ComStar to the Draconis Combine as part of Operation Rosebud in 3035, the THE-S was a downgraded factory refit of the THE-N. Stripping out the advanced Endo Steel chassis and CASE, the use of a heavier standard chassis forced a reduction in the Thorns armor protection by half a ton, most of which was removed from the head and rear torso. The communications system was also changed to a more primitive Olmstead 30, although the Omicron VII targeting-tracking system was similar in capabilities to the Orion 80 it replaced. content.original: The Thug was designed by Maltex Corporation as a direct competitor to the popular Warhammer BattleMech. First seeing production in 2572, the Thug sought to directly address some of the challenges which faced the Warhammer, chief of which was to increase armor protection without sacrificing firepower. The Thugs long range striking power comes from a pair of arm mounted PPC’s. Backing up the PPCs are two SRM-6 launchers mounted in either side torso with one ton of CASE-protected reloads. Eighteen double heat sinks comfortably dissipate the enormous heat generated by the PPC’s while an Endo Steel frame allows it to carry fifteen and a half tons of armor. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14

Built on a more basic standard chassis, the now LosTech ER PPC was swapped for a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser but most of the 5Sb's systems were preserved with only the loss of one double heat sink and the head-mounted Small Laser. Production of the design only lasted a mere twenty-seven years before further technology decline resulted in the 5LS. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: Developed in 2850 as the Second Succession War saw more and more technologies disappear, the 5LS was a downgraded field refit and a factory model of the now impossible to build 5L. While the ER Large Laser and Starfish Small Pulse Lasers were retained, the standard LRM-15 and Bical SRM-2 rack were noticeably less accurate than the 5L's more advanced launchers, but nothing compared to the replacement of the 5L's double heat sinks with fifteen standard models and the heat management issues that resulted. Production of even the "primitive" 5LS would end during the Third Succession War. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

content.original: Designed with Star League technology, the 7M has been re-armored using Ferro-Fibrous armor, allowing the 'Mech's weapons to be upgraded with the freed weight. With an arsenal based on the 5S model, the 7M carries an LRM-15 missile launcher in the right torso, an ER Large Laser in the right arm, three medium lasers and a Streak SRM-2 launcher in the left torso, and a pair of machine guns in the left arm. Two tons of LRM reloads are kept in the right torso while one ton each of Streak and machine gun ammo are kept in the left torso. Additionally, the heat sinks have been upgraded to double heat sinks and CASE has been added to protect against ammunition explosion. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: When the Magistracy of Canopus found an abandoned Star League facility in 3018, amongst the stored equipment was a number of Thunderbolt chassis. All of them were severely damage and missing key components such as the weapons, gyro and engine. The Magistracy had to acquire these at great cost from the open market, and therefore opted to install internal combustion engines instead of the fusion cores. The F4X was the final version, overhauled to use an AC/10 in the right forearm while a pair of ten-tube MRM launchers was fitted into the left torso. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87
content.prevOriginal: Build from derelict Thunderbolt chassis abandoned during Amaris Revolt carries this mech a cheap AC/10 alongside 2 MRM-10s. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87

The F4X was the final version, overhauled to use an AC/10 in the right forearm while a pair of ten-tube MRM launchers was fitted into the left torso. content.original: The Thunderbolt started production in 2491 as a planetary-assault 'Mech, and in fact was one of the heaviest 'Mechs that could be produced at that time. Since then the 'Mech, known affectionately as the T-Bolt, has had its classification changed as larger 'Mechs were built but thanks to periodic updates it is still feared and respected by many. With its varied arsenal, the Thunderbolt remains one of the best-armed 'Mechs, making it capable of serving in many roles. It is also an incredibly well-armored 'Mech, rivaling or exceeding the amount of armor carried by some assault 'Mechs. One downside to the Thunderbolt though is poor heat management.
content.prevOriginal: Build from derelict Thunderbolt chassis abandoned during Amaris Revolt carries this mech a cheap AC/10 alongside 2 MRM-10.
content.content: Производство Thunderbolt началось в 2491 году как планетарный штурмовой мех, и фактически был одним из самых тяжелых мехов, которые могли быть произведены в то время. С тех пор классификация меха, ласково называемого T-Bolt, менялась по мере строительства более крупных мехов, но благодаря периодическим обновлениям его по-прежнему боятся и уважают многие. Благодаря своему разнообразному арсеналу Thunderbolt остаётся одним из наиболее вооруженных мехов, что делает его способным выполнять множество ролей. Кроме того, это невероятно хорошо бронированный мех, соперничающий или превосходящий по количеству брони некоторые штурмовые мехи. Однако одним из недостатков Thunderbolt является плохое управление теплом.

content.original: Ideal for working with spotters, the Thunder Stallion mounts four LRM-15 launchers and eight tons of ammunition for them. This gives the 'Mech a significant long-range punch that can be called down from behind cover. Perhaps the largest backup weapon ever is the Thunder Stallion's LB 20-X AC. This massive gun is capable of defending against infantry or blowing holes in all but the most well-armored of opponents. Fourteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cooled down. This relatively inexpensive, durable design is protected by a whopping seventeen and a half tons of armor. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19

content.original: Clan Hell's Horses originally conceived of the Thunder Stallion as a totem 'Mech, along the lines of the Mandrill. After the poor performance of other totem designs, however, that aspect was downplayed to the point that only the rear legs retain any of the equine aesthetic styling that was supposed to be such an important aspect of the 'Mech. True to the emphasis on combined arms warfare that the Horses value, the Thunder Stallion is an assault 'Mech that is designed to support what would be considered secondary forces in any other Clan. Since it was designed to work with infantry, the Thunder Stallion's top speed of 54 km/h is roughly equivalent to the speed that an Elemental Battle Armor can move.

content.original: The THR-1L Thunder is the first heavy ’Mech designed and produced by a Capellan manufacturer following the Clan invasion. Powered by a 350 XL Engine, the 70 ton Thunder is armed with an AC/20 supplied with three tons of ammunition. Complementing the autocannon is an LRM-5 located in the left torso, with one ton of ammunition. Three Medium Pulse Lasers back up the autocannon at close range, and the designers installed CASE to protect against ammo detonation. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper

For long range combat, a Gauss Rifle and an LRM-10 launcher gives the Timber Wolf B a powerful long range punch. For short to medium range engagements, a Large Pulse Laser is carried. Finally, for short ranges, a Small Pulse Laser and SRM-4 launcher are carried. Additionally, both of the missile launchers are linked to an Artemis IV Fire Control System to allow for greater missile accuracy. For indirect fire support capability, its two LRM-15 launchers provide an ample quantity of firepower. Finally, for close range protection, the C carries an ER Medium Laser and an Anti-Missile System.

content.original: The default configuration of the Timber Wolf features a well blended mix of energy and missile weaponry; primarily extended-range lasers and long range missile racks that give the Timber Wolf considerable firepower at medium and long range. A pair of LRM-20 racks supplemented by two Extended Range Large Lasers make up the bulk of the Timber Wolf's firepower. The Timber Wolf also has an array of lighter, shorter ranged weaponry for use once the 'Mech draws closer to its prey: two ER Medium Lasers and a Medium Pulse Laser. Finally, it has two Machine Guns for point defense against infantry. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

Armed with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers and a pair of Streak SRM-6’s, the TC mounts a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an ER Small as secondary weapons. 5 Jump Jets enhance the TC’s mobility. content.original: Produced in 2546, the Toro was the Taurian Concordant’s first battlemech design. Based on captured Firebees, the Toro is a long range support mech. Armed with a PPC and a pair of LRM-5s the Toro carried two tons of ammo and 10 single heat sinks. The last Toro factory was demolished in 2598 by invading Star League troops and production would not resume until the Word of Blake Jihad. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: Built due to an awkward exchange of technology between the Free Worlds League and the Word of Blake, the Toyama was designed by Dr. Thaddeus Anable and then given to the Word of Blake through an agreement made by Captain-General Thomas Marik. The Toyama is intended to be a multi-role BattleMech that can operate somewhat independently of supply lines. The 'Mech is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis which supports a Vlar 300 XL engine. The Toyama has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, making it capable of keeping pace with most heavy 'Mechs. The Toyama has an impressive twelve tons of Durallex Heavy armor. To dissipate heat, the Toyama carries fourteen double heat sinks. The 'Mech also carries a Garret/Guardian Interface Guardian ECM Suite to protect the 'Mech from advanced enemy electronic warfare systems. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

The Toyama is intended to be a multi-role BattleMech that can operate somewhat independently of supply lines. The 'Mech is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis which supports a Vlar 300 XL engine. The Toyama has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, making it capable of keeping pace with most heavy 'Mechs. The Toyama has an impressive twelve tons of Durallex Heavy armor. To dissipate heat, the Toyama carries fourteen double heat sinks. The 'Mech also carries a Garret/Guardian Interface Guardian ECM Suite to protect the 'Mech from advanced enemy electronic warfare systems. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Rebuilt from the salvaged remains of a Trebuchet 5S, this low tech refit is a common sight throughout the battlefields of the Deep Periphery. Mounting between 2 and 4 Rocket pods and backed up by a pair of Large Chem Lasers; makes the 5SP into a fearsome short range brawler. Some designs include scavenged or salvaged Endo Steel or Ferro-Fibrous, either for increased protection or to mount additional rocket pods. Limited by the 4 tons of Chemical Laser ammunition and the single salvos of the rocket pod, the SP lacks the endurance for protracted engagements. Fortunately these are rarely a concern in the Deep Periphery and this design is commonly seen during raids and border skirmishes, where its heavy firepower can give it an edge over less durable opponents. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Trebuchet (also jovially referred to as the Trenchbucket) is a mainline medium weight BattleMech considered to be a fine blend of long- and short-range fire support for a unit of its size. Unlike many other pre-Clan 'Mechs, the Trebuchet was designed from the beginning to work as part of a lance instead of functioning as a stand-alone model.
content.prevOriginal: A FWL export for the DCMS does the 8K Carry an upgraded load of Missiles and Tracking Systems
content.content: Требушет (также шутливо называемый «Тренчбакет» («траншейное ведро»)) — это основной боевой мех среднего веса, считающийся идеальным сочетанием дальнего и ближнего огневого сопровождения для юнита такого размера. В отличие от многих других мехов доклановского периода, «Требушет» изначально разрабатывался как часть копья, а не как самостоятельная машина.

content.original: The 9K variant of the Trebuchet is a field refit of the 7M with a distinctive Kurita feel to it. Built on an Endo Steel chassis and powered by an XL engine, the 9K replaced the LRMs for two MRM-20launchers with three tons of ammo total. The medium lasers in the right arm are replaced with two Medium Pulse Lasers while the left arm-mounted medium laser is kept, and a C3 slave unit in the left torso allows it to share targeting telemetry with other units. The jump jets are also kept, giving it a jumping distance of one hundred and fifty meters. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

Paired Anti-Personnel Pods, Machine Guns, and Flamers discourage conventional forces from closing. An Active Probe finds most hidden units, ensuring the MechWarrior is rarely surprised. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: When the Star League Defense Force left the Inner Sphere under Commanding General Aleksandr Kerensky during Operation Exodus, they brought with them many of the most common 'Mechs. As the SLDF-in-exile slowly started turning into the Clans, they started developing improved weapons, which they mounted on their existing armies of 'Mech. These weapons are commonly called Clan Early, and as such the Mech's using them got the -CE suffix added to their designation.

content.original: The Valkyrie II project originated as an assignment for two NAIS student design teams to create a new heavy scout and skirmisher mech based on the Valkyrie VLK-QA. A rivalry between the two teams and outside pressures from Davion bureaucrats pushed both designs far beyond a replacement for the VLK-QA. Achernar BattleMechs was contracted to construct the Valkyrie II-1A which sports a Hermes 360XL Engine, six Jump Jets, an ER PPC, a LRM10, and over eleven tons of armor. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08

It may not excel at anything in particular but it can work for most jobs it is tasked with.

The addition of a Targeting Computer makes its firepower even more deadly as long as it can get its weapons into range. Eleven Double Heat Sinks, half a ton of machine gun ammunition and one Streak missiles are more than adequate for the average Clan trial. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

As the SLDF-in-exile slowly started turning into the Clans, they started developing improved weapons, which they mounted on their existing armies of 'Mech. These weapons are commonly called Clan Early, and as such the Mech's using them got the -CE suffix added to their designation.

content.original: The Vindicator is one of the most well-known Capellan Confederation BattleMechs. This workhorse of the CCAF was originally built in 2826 between the First and Second Succession War to maximize the effectiveness of the Confederation's surviving production capabilities and fulfill as many roles as possible. Designed by committee, the Vindicator's 'jack-of-all-trades' nature means it does not excel in any one role but fulfills them adequately. With almost all of its components produced on Capella, the Vindicator is also cheap, easy to mass produce, and quick to repair with a ready supply of spare parts.

content.original: The 3L variant is a basic upgrade using recovered Star League technology introduced in 3051. The PPC was upgraded to a Ceres Arms Warrior ER PPC and the medium and small lasers have been removed in favor of a single Ceres Arms Model W Medium Pulse Laser. To handle the extra heat from the new ER PPC double heat sinks were added while CASE was installed to protect the LRM's ammunition.

content.original: The 5L variant is a more basic upgrade than the 4L and represents Ceres' attempt to produce a close-combat 'Mech superior to the FS9-0 Firestarter. Introduced in 3060 the 5L uses a standard engine, armor, and structure. The changes and advancements come in the weapons and the addition of a TSM system. The 'Mech's new weapons include an ER PPC, two ER medium lasers, two medium pulse lasers, a single Small Pulse Laser, and a small laser. This varied mix of energy weapons allows the MechWarrior piloting the 'Mech to balance their heat load to keep the TSM working at its optimum efficiency. In so doing, the Vindicator can deal a fair amount of damage with its Sword. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original:
Jade Falcon commanders were shocked to find themselves suffering losses from an unknown LAM that resembled a small Warhammer. Insulted that the Inner-Sphere forces disgraced the Warhammer lineage with a half-baked LAM, and being a bit more open minded on units, Jade Falcon scientists went to work, producing a 70t version loaded with Clan tech. Fielding the same powerful combo of twin ER PPCs, as well as a pair of Arrow Anti-Air missiles, these Warhammer LAMs provide withering fire on ground targets, and are able to defend themselves from modest aerospace defenses. Coupled with the improved maneuverability of a LAM, these units are finding themselves to be the backbone of quick-response anti-militia garrisons across Jade Falcon territory. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

content.content: Известный и почитаемый во Внутренней Сфере и за её пределами, «Вархаммер» — выдающийся тяжёлый мех. Этот 70-тонный мех, дебютировавший в 2515 году, представляет собой гармоничное сочетание огневой мощи и мобильности, способный победить практически любого противника. Powered by a 280 Fusion Core, the Warhammer WHM-7M-DC is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s. A Medium Laser, Machine Gun and SRM-6 deter opponents from closing in. A Command Console rounds out the design.

content.original: The 7M variant was introduced in 3047 by Ronin Inc. as the official upgraded variant of the Warhammer for the Free Worlds League. Built around a Magna 280 fusion engine, the 7M had a top speed of 64.5 km/h and carried eighteen double heat sinks to handle the waste heat generated by its two Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs. Backing up these new weapons were two Martell medium lasers in the side torsos and a Shannon SH-60 SRM-6 launcher over the right shoulder. A LFN Lindblad machine gun was carried in the right torso, while the left mounted an LFN Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System. One ton of machine gun rounds were carried in the center torso, while one ton each of missile reloads and AMS rounds were carried in the right. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The 7S Warhammer was the official upgraded version built for the Federated Commonwealth by Olivettie Weaponry. Built out of their Sudeten factory starting in 3050, the 7S retained the small lasers of the original but updated the rest of the weaponry. It carried two arm-mounted ER PPCs, two Defiance P5M medium pulse lasers in the side torsos, and two Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launchers in place of the SRM-6 launcher. Eighteen double heat sinks handled the additional waste heat and one ton of reloads for the Streak launchers was carried in the center torso. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original:
Developed as part of Project Thor's Hammer, the Warhammer LAM aims to merge the effectiveness of the Warhammer's twin PPCs, with the mobility of a LAM, in hopes of aiding the fight against the Clans. While weight requirements forced the PPCs to be downsized to Light PPCs, they are equipped with PPC Capacitors for that extra punch, and the expansion of SRMs to twin SRM4's, as well as a sizable bomb bay, provide devastating short range firepower. This allows the Warhammer LAM to inflict serious damage on a flyover, then pepper the target at range with the Light PPCs from the rear, until enough gaps open up for the SRMs to exploit. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Wow Boss, a Thor's Hammer production model? These things were rare as hell, considering the Clans took great offense to having LAMs built to fight them. They went out of their way to track down and destroy all the factories, and their warriors would focus on them even if it meant ignoring bigger threats. This is the basic model, pretty good at what it was set out to do: bomb, rear attack, then crit the enemy out. But remember, it's a LAM; none of that 'stand and shoot' stuff you might pull off in a Warhammer will work with this.

content.original:
Developed as part of Project Thor's Hammer, the Warhammer LAM aims to merge the effectiveness of the Warhammer's twin PPCs, with the mobility of a LAM, in hopes of aiding the fight against the Clans. The B variant replaces the bomb bay and SRMs for MMLs, providing 16 tubes in total, and was marketed towards Mercenary groups. The lack of PPC Capacitors aids in repairs, and the loss of damage is replaced by the MMLs providing long range fire support with the LRMs. For close range combat, the quadrupling of SRMs fired offsets the loss of the bomb bay, but allows for a few more short range passes as the MMLs can fire multiple times. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: A Merc's Hammer? These were never as popular as the advertisements claimed; the minimal ammo for the MMLs meant most Mercs would immediately buy a refit package to drop one of the leg MMLs for some extra ammunition. Though, they are great fire support units once you get past that ammo issue; anything that could outrange them, was often too slow to keep them in range, which meant they would often survive traps that would eliminate other fire support lances.

Fulfilling the initial goal of Project Thor's Hammer, the Warhammer LAM ver. C is able to take out a Clan's Thor Omnimech with a single pass, and survive the encounter. While single-kill mechs were often relegated to the trashbin in the planning stages, the necessity of defeating a mech, and then claiming the salvage during the early Clan Invasion, saw such units come to the forefront of battle for a brief period. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

The primitive engine reduced the top speed to 85 km/h and meant that only a single medium laser was carried. The prototype jump jets could only cover 150 meters in a jump. The primitive armor provided much less protection than the later Succession Wars-era Wasps, even though it carried three and a half tons of armor. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.75 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.content: Разработанный компанией General Mechanics на Марсе в 2464 году как Wasp первого поколения, этот вариант использовал несколько примитивных компонентов. Примитивный двигатель снижал максимальную скорость до 85 км/ч и позволял нести только один средний лазер. Прототипные прыжковые двигатели могли преодолевать в прыжке только 150 метров. Примитивная броня обеспечивала гораздо меньшую защиту, чем на более поздних «Осах» времен Наследных войн, несмотря на то, что брони было три с половиной тонны. Envisioning a variant highly adaptable to the raiding actions of the First Succession War, the Capellan Strategios deployed the 1L with multiple munition types based on their intended mission role, such as incendiary or gas SRMs for anti-infantry support or smoke SRMs for recon-concealment. content.original: A common Periphery rebuild, this mech is a mix of different weapons systems. A primitive medium laser copied from the original Wasp model provides subpar firepower, backed up by the one shot punch of an RL15. A small calibre rifle makes for a semi effective sniper weapon whilst its ammo lasts. The rest of the mech is almost standard spec, rebuilt by a succession of engineers to specs nearly identical to Inner Sphere counterparts. Surprisingly enough, this rebuild offers somewhat superior capabilities compared to most Inner Sphere models. Produced in any number of Periphery junk yards and back alley chop shops, this mech is incredibly common amongst periphery factions; who field the mech in vast quantities, praising its cheap firepower and easily repaired chassis. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.content: Типичный рефит из Периферии, этот мех - смесь различных систем вооружения. Примитивный средний лазер, скопированный с оригинальной модели Wasp, даёт огневую мощь, подкрепленную одним ударом из RL15. Винтовка малого калибра годится как аналог снайперского оружия, пока не иссякнут патроны. Остальное - почти стандартная конструкция, доведённая инженерами почти до аналогов Внутренней Сферы. Удивительно, но мех даёт более широкие возможности по сравнению с моделями ВС. Собранный буквально на коленке, этот мех крайне распространён среди окраинных фракций, предпочитающих дешёвых в обслуживании мехов. Особенность: Расширенный поворот торса Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.95 Лимит приводов рук: Right Lower

content.original: Standing at ten meters tall, the Watchman is a 'Mech that was born of necessity. The idea for the design came when the bulk of the AFFS was moved to the Clan front. Because this seriously undermined the ability of the Federated Suns to keep its borders secure, the Watchman was designed to be distributed to militia units within the border marches to bulk up their strength. In its own right the Watchman is a durable and reliable 'Mech that is built with off the shelf components and is very easy to repair. The 'Mech is armored with eight and a half tons of standard armor, has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, and can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. This, combined with the Watchman's varied arsenal, makes it an excellent trooper or trainer. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1

As the SLDF-in-exile slowly started turning into the Clans, they started developing improved weapons, which they mounted on their existing armies of 'Mech. These weapons are commonly called Clan Early, and as such the Mech's using them got the -CE suffix added to their designation.

content.original: A Taurian variant, the WVR-6T design was created to capitalize on the less expensive ballistic weapons that were readily available within the Concordat to reduce their reliance on Star League member states. The 6T was also meant to act as anti-pirate garrison 'Mech, utilizing its long range AC/5 and LRM-5 combo to engage raiders at range. While the swap out of the Medium Laser for a Small Laser and the addition of two Machine Guns allow this Wolverine variant to better engage with the light vehicles and infantry common to raiding forces. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The 7D variant of the Wolverine is a major upgrade to the design introduced in 3050 by the Federated Suns' new Nanking factory. The standard engine on the 'Mech was replaced with a Nissan 275 XLversion and the armor has been upgraded to Kallon Unity Weave Ferro-Fibrous material with an extra half-ton added. To increase the Wolverine's speed, MASC has been added, allowing it to move up to 108 km/h in bursts. Finally, the weapons payload has been upgraded as well. The autocannon has been upgraded to a General Motors Nova-5 Ultra Autocannon/5 and the medium laser is now a Sutel Precision Line Medium Pulse Laser. The design retains its jumping capability, as well as the SRM-6, although CASE now protects the SRM reloads Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

The 7M has twelve double heat sinks and, for a weapons package, it carries two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers in the right arm and two Magna 400P medium pulse lasers in the head mount while retaining the SRM-6 for close range work.

content.original: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 km/h. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: Designed for Urban combat, the 45 ton Wyvern blends heavy armor, jump jets and a versatile weapons package. Powered by a 180-rated Fusion Core, the Wyvern 5N is armed with a Large Laser and an LRM-10. For close range combat, the Mech carries a pair of Small Lasers and a SRM-6. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01

content.content: Разработанный для ведения боевых действий в городских условиях, 45-тонный Wyvern сочетает в себе тяжелую броню, прыжковые двигатели и универсальный набор вооружения. Оснащенный термоядерным реактором рейтинга 180, Wyvern 5N вооружен большим лазером и LRM-10. Для ближнего боя мех оснащен парой малых лазеров и SRM-6. Особенность: Прочный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.01

content.content: Разработанный для ведения боевых действий в городских условиях, 45-тонный Wyvern сочетает в себе тяжелую броню, прыжковые двигатели и универсальный набор вооружения. Оснащенный термоядерным реактором рейтинга 180, Wyvern 9N вооружен большим импульсным лазером и LRM-10. Для ближнего боя мех оснащен парой средних импульсных лазеров и SSRM-2.

content.original: A second line Clan mech, the 45 ton Wyvern IIC is an upgrade of the SLDF Wyverns that survived the Exodus. Built using a cache of Wyverns, Clan Burrock upgraded every aspect of the original mech with Clan tech. Retaining the original 180-rated Fusion Core, the Wyvern IIC is armed with a mix of weapons. An ER Large Laser and an LRM-10 make up the Mechs long range firepower, with a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 for medium range combat. A pair of MG’s, a Flamer and a pair of ER Smalls give additional firepower at close range. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

content.original: The Xanthos was first introduced by the Capellan Confederation in 2564, designed by a young engineer named Dr. David Harrison. Working for Hollis Inc., he pioneered the technology to create four-legged BattleMechs. This technological advancement that later allowed the research into the Scorpion and Goliath enabled the Xanthos to get on the field. It was presented to the Terran Hegemony for review after the cancellation of the Catapult. Hollis pushed to have this 'Mech presented against Dr. Harrison's wishes in a bid to maintain financial solvency. Clumsy and stiff, the 'Mech failed to win the contract from the Star League purchasing committee.

content.original: The Ymir was the Lyran Commonwealth's first homegrown BattleMech, designed during the Age of War.  Named for the frost giants of Scandinavian mythology, the Ymir was developed by Coventry Defense Conglomerate by taking the basic frame of the Mackie, shaving ten tons from it and then modifying it to form a sleeker design, that offered greater stability and the ability to maneuver more easily.

content.original: The original Ymir, the X1 prototype could only reach 53 km/h due to its primitive engine. The cockpit and armor were also both primitive, but the design mounted fifteen and a half tons of armor in total. Mounting sixteen heat sinks, the X1 was equipped with two LRM-5s in the right torso,a large laser in the right arm and an AC/5 in the left arm for long-range work. Four SRM-2s were mounted in the left torso for short range work - the designers believing that multiple small systems would be easier to maintain and adapt than larger systems - along with two vehicle flamers mounted in the right hand arm. The vehicle flamers were chosen for the design because of concerns about the safety of taking plasma directly from the reactor, although protecting and shielding the flamers caused problems. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.94 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Yu Huang, named for the Jade Emperor that rules the Heavenly Court in the ancient Chinese pantheon, debuted with the promise from Sun-Tzu Liao that 'it shall sit in judgment over a battlefield, meting out justice to those who would transgress against us'. To live up to the promise of the Chancellor of the Capellan Confederation, the Yu Huang carries some of the most advanced technologies available at the time of its initial production. The Yu Huang is built on a Chariot Type II Endo Steel chassis and carries a Hermes 360 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty meters with its four Rodan 90 jump jets. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The H10G variant is designed to directly engage an enemy at short ranges. The 10G removes all of the 'Mechs weapons. Instead, it carries a powerful Gauss Rifle for long range combat. This is supported by an ER Large Laser for additional long range firepower. For close combat, the 10G has six ER Medium Lasers and also carries a Guardian ECM Suite and a Beagle Active Probe to both protect the 'Mech from advanced enemy electronics systems and find hidden enemy units to prevent ambushes.

Manufactured on Kwangjong-ni by Defiance, the Zeus X was both a poster child for excellence in production engineering and an innovative high-technology platform. The first of what became commonly referred to as the Zeus X series, the ZEU-X was a variant of the venerable Zeus BattleMech developed using Experimental Technology to push the envelope of the original design. The 'Mech was armed with an LB-X Autocannon/20 as its primary weapon, backed up by an MRM-30 launcher. The ZEU-X carried three tons of ammunition for the LB-X AC/20 and two tons for the MRM-30, stored in the right torso and protected by CASE II. For close combat, the Zeus had two Medium X-Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2

content.original: The Manticore is one of the best-designed and most powerful heavy tanks ever created, built to combat BattleMechs in support of infantry formations. Although the Manticore mounts a variety of weapons to handle a variety of combat roles and ranges, and is heavily armored for a vehicle of its weight, it is not equipped to deal with the raw firepower of Assault weight vehicles such as the Demolisher or the Behemoth. Despite this, the popularity of the Manticore has remained high, even during the Succession Wars era with its use of an expensive and rare Fusion Engine. Originally developed by TechniCorp during the Reunification War, the destruction of the company's head office on Terra during the Amaris Coup spread the Manticore across the Inner Sphere as other manufacturers absorbed their facilities. Although the Manticore mounts a variety of weapons to handle a variety of combat roles and ranges, and is heavily armored for a vehicle of its weight, it is not equipped to deal with the raw firepower of Assault weight vehicles such as the Demolisher or the Behemoth. Despite this, the popularity of the Manticore has remained high, even during the Succession Wars era with its use of an expensive and rare Fusion Engine. Originally developed by TechniCorp during the Reunification War, the destruction of the company's head office on Terra during the Amaris Coup spread the Manticore across the Inner Sphere as other manufacturers absorbed their facilities. content.content: «Мантикора» — один из самых совершенных и мощных тяжёлых танков, когда-либо созданных, предназначенный для борьбы с боевыми мехами в поддержку пехотных формирований. Несмотря на то, что «Мантикора» оснащена разнообразным вооружением для выполнения различных боевых задач на разных дистанциях, а также имеет тяжёлую броню для машины своего веса, она не способна справиться с грубой огневой мощью штурмовых машин, таких как «Демолишер» или «Бегемот». Несмотря на это, популярность «Мантикоры» оставалась высокой даже в эпоху Наследных войн благодаря использованию дорогостоящего и редкого термоядерного двигателя. Изначально разработанная компанией TechniCorp во время Объединительной войны, после уничтожения её головного офиса на Терре во время переворота Амариса «Мантикора» распространилась по всей Внутренней Сфере, поскольку другие производители поглотили их заводы. With a top speed faster than most 'Mechs, the Galleon was mobile but generally lacked protection, early models carrying only three and a half tons of armor. After the Exodus, these tracked vehicles mostly fell into the possession of the Draconis Combine and the Free Worlds League. The Galleon is often paired with the Harasser Missile Platform. content.original: Little known even inside Comstar and the Word of Blake, the Schrek SNPPC was a notable failure. Designed in the early 31st century, the design team swapped the standard PPC for some Star League era Snub Nose PPC from Comstars stockpile. Unfortunately the shorter range of the PPC left the tank vulnerable to longer ranged opponents and Comstars inability to manufacture or repair any SNPPP limited the number of SNPPC Schreks that could be produced. The few prototype models were stored in a forgotten warehouse when the Word of Blake took Terra and their fate is unknown. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. content.original: A variant of the 3053 Striker, the vehicle is fitted with the Striker's original LRM-10 and SRM-6. However, it's also equipped with a Narc Missile Beacon. The Striker Light Tank started out as a joint project venture between Valiant Systems and Wunderland Enterprises on the world of Johnsondale. They united in their efforts to create a joint company known as Valiant Vehicles, with the Striker being their first product. The low cost light fire support tank became a mainstay of the AFFS after its introduction in the first decade of the thirty-first century, and orders for the Striker soon outstripped the Valiant production line's capacity. content.original: The Daimyo HQ was a heavy theater command unit utilized by the Draconis Combine. The first Daimyo was fielded in 2796 at the beginning of the Succession Wars by Jinjiro Kurita, who used the vehicle during the Kentares Massacre. While the Coordinator attended executions in person, the Daimyo HQ's crew transmitted the data to ComStar representatives on the planet who then sent the data through the whole Inner Sphere. When Jinjiro discovered the treason, the whole crew was executed. Daimyo production ceased between the years 3027 and 3063 because the unit's communication system technology become a form of Lostech. While the Coordinator attended executions in person, the Daimyo HQ's crew transmitted the data to ComStar representatives on the planet who then sent the data through the whole Inner Sphere. When Jinjiro discovered the treason, the whole crew was executed. Daimyo production ceased between the years 3027 and 3063 because the unit's communication system technology become a form of Lostech. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 5/8 гексов / 150/240 метров. No more a fighting vehicle than its 'standard' counterpart, the Heavy Tracked APC carries only two front mounted Machine Guns supplied by half a ton of ammunition each. The lack of a turret makes the APC particularly vulnerable to flanking or attacks from the rear, but most can successfully unload their troops before an enemy gets in position to launch such an attack. content.content: Тяжёлый ховер БТР — это увеличенная версия стандартного аналога, способная перевозить два полных взвода пешей пехоты или один взвод моторизованной или прыжковой пехоты. Примерно столь же не боевой, как и стандартный вариант, тяжёлый гусеничный БТР оснащён всего двумя передними пулемётами, каждый из которых снабжён полутонной боеприпасов. Отсутствие башни делает БТР особенно уязвимым для фланговых атак и атак с тыла, зато большинство таких БТР способны успешно высадить десант до того, как противник займёт позицию для такой атаки. Ограничения биома: этот юнит не может действовать в лунном или марсианском биомах из-за использования ДВС. Передвижение: 8/12 гексов / 240/360 метров. content.original: Originally produced by Maxim Transport Industries, before a series of scandals led to its closure in 3039, the fast and heavily armed Maxim quickly became the model example of a transport throughout the Inner Sphere. БМП способен перевозить целый отряд пехоты в относительно комфортных условиях, а после высадки — оказывать бойцам огневую поддержку. По иронии судьбы, сочетание высокой надежности и большой стоимости ограничивает рыночный потенциал этой техники: ежегодно выпускается лишь 200 единиц. Тем не менее, Trident можно встретить по всей Внутренней Сфере и даже в Периферии — у самых разных владельцев. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 5/8 гексов / 150/240 метров.
