content.original: Since it was the chosen BattleMech of the Great Father, the venerable Orion has always held a special place in the mystique of the Clans. Out of respect for General Kerensky's legacy, all the Clans maintained the design for several decades even as the development of newer and more advanced technologies increasingly left it less effective on the battlefield. Not a radical reworking of the design, as some Clan upgrades are, the Orion IIC replaces much of the innards and weapons of the original, while preserving its mass and aesthetics. This IIC upgrade utilizes an Endo Steel chassis and twelve tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, while also making use of twelve double heat sinks, freeing up weight for heavier weapons loadout. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: Будучи боевым мехом, избранным самим Великим отцом, достопочтенный «Орион» всегда занимал особое место в глазах Кланов. Из уважения к наследию генерала Керенского, все кланы держали у себя этого меха на протяжении нескольких десятилетий, несмотря на то, что развитие новых и более продвинутых технологий всё больше снижало его эффективность на поле боя. «Орион IIC» не является радикальной переработкой конструкции, как некоторые модификации Кланов, а заменяет большую часть внутренних компонентов и вооружения оригинала, сохраняя при этом его массу и эстетику. Данная модификация IIC использует эндостальное шасси и двенадцать тонн ферроволоконной брони, а также двенадцать двойных охладителей, что позволяет снизить вес для установки более тяжёлого вооружения. Особенность: Противовоздушное наведение Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.15 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

Из уважения к наследию генерала Керенского, все кланы держали у себя этого меха на протяжении нескольких десятилетий, несмотря на то, что развитие новых и более продвинутых технологий всё больше снижало его эффективность на поле боя. «Орион IIC» не является радикальной переработкой конструкции, как некоторые модификации Кланов, а заменяет большую часть внутренних компонентов и вооружения оригинала, сохраняя при этом его массу и эстетику. Данная модификация IIC использует эндостальное шасси и двенадцать тонн ферроволоконной брони, а также двенадцать двойных охладителей, что позволяет снизить вес для установки более тяжёлого вооружения. В этом варианте сохраняется пушка Гаусса, но LRM-20 заменена на пусковую установку SRM-6. content.original: Since it was the chosen BattleMech of the Great Father, the venerable Orion has always held a special place in the mystique of the Clans. Out of respect for General Kerensky's legacy, all the Clans maintained the design for several decades even as the development of newer and more advanced technologies increasingly left it less effective on the battlefield. Not a radical reworking of the design, as some Clan upgrades are, the Orion IIC replaces much of the innards and weapons of the original, while preserving its mass and aesthetics. This IIC upgrade utilizes an Endo Steel chassis and twelve tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, while also making use of twelve double heat sinks, freeing up weight for heavier weapons loadout. This variant switches the Gauss Rifle to an Ultra Autocannon/10 and downgrading the LRM-20 rack into an LRM-15. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Built by General Mechanics, the ON1-H was the third known primitive prototype of the Orion 'Mech that was eventually accepted for mass production in 2456. While slower than the first iterations, with a top speed of only 54 km/h (the same as that of a Mackie or Banshee), due to the inclusion of a smaller 275-class engine, the additional weight saved allowed the designers to mount far more firepower. A newly developed Class-10 Prototype Autocannon was installed and two tons of ammo in place of the AC/5. This was backed up by two 5-tube Long-Range Missile launchers with one ton of reloads in the left torso for striking enemies at range and a short-range SRM-4 missile launcher and a ton of ammunition installed in the left arm for close-in defense. It was also heavily protected by 21 tons of armor. A minimal amount of heatsinks, however, could cause build-up of heat within crippling levels, but could be avoided by competent MechWarriors. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The 5M variant of the Ostsol is an upgrade of the design using Star League technology and is built for close-range combat with production starting in 3050. The original engine, heat sinks, and weapons have been stripped from the chassis and replaced with a Hermes 300 XL engine and sixteen double heat sinks. Taking the place of its standard weapons, the 5M Ostsol carries two Tronel XIII Large Pulse Lasers and four Tronel XII Medium Pulse Lasers, two of which remain rear-mounted to discourage attacks against the 'Mech's weak rear armor. Finally, for added protection against missile attacks, the 5M carries a Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System in its right torso with one ton of ammo in the left. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08

content.original: The Pack Hunter is the first new design produced by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal. It also represents a new partnership between Phelan's Wolves and the Kell Hounds, as the armor and communications gear are Kell Hound products, traded to the Wolves in exchange for Endo Steel. Reflecting their Khan's bias towards light, fast designs, Wolf scientists designed the Pack Hunter to be fast and have a sharp bite. Though its four tons of armor are light, the BattleMech is supposed to use its speed and maneuverability to stay out of trouble. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.content: «Пак Хантер» — первый новый проект, созданный кланом Волка-в-изгнании на Арк-Ройяле. Он также представляет собой результат нового партнёрства между Волками Фелана и Гончими Келла, поскольку броня и средства связи изготовлены Гончими и были переданы Волкам в обмен на эндосталь. Следуя за стремлением их хана к лёгким и быстрым конструкциям, учёные Волка разработали Pack Hunter таким образом, чтобы он был быстрым и обладал болючим укусом. Несмотря на лёгкость четырёхтонной брони, этот боевой мех должен использовать свою скорость и манёвренность, чтобы оставаться в стороне от неприятностей. Особенность: Укреплённые ноги Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

content.original: The 10K Panther is a high tech upgrade of the 9R model introduced by Wakazashi Enterprises. The chassis has been rebuilt using Endo Steel construction techniques and the saved weight used to add an Artemis IV fire control system to the missile launcher, as well as upgrading the PPC to a Lord's Light 2 ER PPC. Since its introduction the 10K has gone on to replace the 9R as the most common model employed by the DCMS. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Penetrator PTR-4D has an all energy weapons arsenal and uses twelve double heat sinks to handle the massive heat load from its weapons. The 'Mech uses a Vlar 300 fusion engine for its combat durability, giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. To help offset the 'Mech's lack of mobility, the Penetrator has four Anderson 398 jump jets giving it added mobility with a jumping distance of one hundred and twenty meters. The Penetrator also carries a respectable thirteen tons of armor. The 'Mech's heavy armor protection, combined with its standard engine and limited amounts of ammunition, make for a 'Mech that is very rugged and hard to kill. The primary weapons are a pair of arm mounted Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers for long range firepower. For close range combat, the 'Mech carries six Sutel Precision Line Medium Pulse Lasers which are mounted in its right and left torsos. Finally, the 'Mech carries its only ammunition based weapon, a Yori Flyswatter Anti-Missile System, for added defense against missile attacks. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: In an attempt to make the -4F more durable, the -4FX variant was a field modification of the Penetrator. Replacing the 4 Medium Pulse Lasers with 6 Medium Lasers allowed the addition of CASE in both side torsos, which after moving the Anti-Missile System ammunition from Center Torso to the Left Torso ensured any ammo explosion should not be able to penetrate the Center Torso. The 0.5 ton weight capacity still remaining was used to improve the armor of the legs and side torsos. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original:
The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The Perseus shares much with the venerable Orion, a staple of Free Worlds League Military, both broadly resembling the older design visually and using a number of the same components. This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content:
«Персей» является продуктом программы, начатой ​​Центральным координационным и командным управлением Лиги, для создания омнимеха собственного производства Лиги Свободных Миров, от концепции до производства. Perseus во многом похож на почтенный Orion, основной продукт вооружённых сил Лиги Свободных Миров, оба в целом напоминают старый дизайн визуально, достаточно, чтобы техники ЛСМ прозвали его «Омни-Орионом», и развертывание Perseus в основном осуществлялось в передовых частях, которые имели большие концентрации его предшественника, заменяя старые Orion по принципу один к одному. Созданный на лёгком шасси из эндостали, Perseus оснащён двигателем Hermes 300 XL, что помогает ещё больше снизить вес и даёт меху максимальную скорость 64,8 км/ч. Усовершенствованная структура и двигатель значительно экономят вес оружия и оборудования. «Персей» защищён четырнадцатью тоннами брони Valiant Lamellor, что обеспечивает ему среднюю броневую защиту для меха такого размера. Кроме того, в шасси установлены 12 двойных охладителей. Особенность: Противовоздушное наведение Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.06

Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: The Phoenix Hawk LAM was the largest Land-Air 'Mech produced during the Star League. Allied Aerospace reworked their designs for conversion equipment and the size of the LAM, learning from their mistake with the Shadow Hawk LAM and the success of the Stinger LAM. The resulting LAM was the largest LAM ever constructed capable of remaining in AirMech mode. Unfortunately, large Land-Air 'Mech conversion technology was not fully researched before the fall of the Star League, and the Phoenix Hawk LAM frequently met its end due to the occasional glitch. The end of the Star League and destruction of the Allied Aerospace facilities at the beginning of the First Succession War prevented further development and refinement. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08

content.original: The original Pillager, designed in 2575 and fielded for the first two decades of the Reunification War, uses a standard fusion engine instead of the extralight model that later went into production. Other limitations include a 60 meter jump range and 17 tons of armor. The weapons suite was also different, relying on twin torso mounted Autocannon/20s, a single SRM-4, and three medium lasers; one mounted in each arm and a head-mounted laser firing to the rear. Sixteen single heat sinks kept the heat under control. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18

content.original: The PLG-3Z Pillager is built using a 300 XL engine, which weighs half as much as a standard fusion engine and gives the Pillager a top speed of 54 km/h. The small mass of the engine allows the 'Mech to mount an obscene array of weapons. The 'Mech's mobility is enhanced with three jump jets that allow it to jump up to ninety meters. The Pillager has excellent armor protection at nineteen and a half tons and has fourteen double heat sinks that provide more than enough heat dissipation capability for the Pillager's needs. The primary weapons on the Pillager are a pair of Gauss rifles, which allows the 'Mech' to engage an enemy at very long ranges. The Gauss rifles were supported at intermediate to close range by a Large laser and four Medium lasers. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18

content.original: The Piranha's main threat is its twelve Series XII Rotary Machine Guns. These are a serious threat to any foe on such a speedy 'Mech, especially if a Star of Piranhas operate in a pack, and such a large array allows the 'Mech to chew through an opponent's rear armor almost instantly. They are most deadly, however, to unarmored infantry, capable of wiping out an entire company in seconds. For work against hardened targets, the Piranha mounts a pair of Mk. 3 ER Medium Lasers and a single Series 1 ER Small Laser. Since the design only uses ten single heat sinks, the MechWarrior must still manage heat levels. The ammunition dependency of the Machine Guns ensure that Piranhas must stay close to supply lines, so most have been relegated to solahma or garrison roles. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01

content.original: The Pouncer was originally a test bed design that was upgraded to combat specifications on the orders of then-IlKhan Ulric Kerensky, as it was realized that a more mobile 'Mech was needed when combating Inner Sphere forces. The Pouncer is built on a lightweight DSAM Endo 4 Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a 240 XL engine which gives it a maximum speed of 97.2 km/h. The 'Mech's mobility is enhanced with five Grandthrust Mk. Four jump jets that allow it to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. For protection from enemy fire, the Pouncer has a respectable six tons of Forging ZM15 Ferro-Fibrous armor. Overall, the Pouncer is an excellent OmniMech with fifteen and a half tons of pod space, allowing it to carry a wide variety of weapons payloads. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: «Налётчик» изначально был платформой для тестов, который был модернизирован до боевых спецификаций по приказу тогдашнего ильхана Ульрика Керенского, поскольку стало ясно, что для сражений с силами Внутренней Сферы необходим более мобильный мех. Pouncer построен на легком шасси из эндостали DSAM Endo 4 и оснащен двигателем 240 XL, который обеспечивает ему максимальную скорость 97,2 км/ч. Мобильность меха повышена за счет пяти прыжковых двигателей Grandthrust Mk. 4, которые позволяют ему прыгать на дистанцию до 150 метров. Для защиты от вражеского огня Pouncer имеет внушительные шесть тонн ферроволоконной брони Forging ZM15. В целом, Pouncer является превосходным омнимехом с 15,5 тоннами пространства под вооружение, что позволяет ему нести широкий спектр вооружения. Особенность: Воздушное нападение Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.03 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: The Pouncer was originally a test bed design that was upgraded to combat specifications on the orders of then-IlKhan Ulric Kerensky, as it was realized that a more mobile 'Mech was needed when combating Inner Sphere forces. The Pouncer is built on a lightweight DSAM Endo 4 Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a 240 XL engine which gives it a maximum speed of 97.2 km/h. The 'Mech's mobility is enhanced with five Grandthrust Mk. Four jump jets that allow it to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. For protection from enemy fire, the Pouncer has a respectable six tons of Forging ZM15 Ferro-Fibrous armor. Overall, the Pouncer is an excellent OmniMech with fifteen and a half tons of pod space, allowing it to carry a wide variety of weapons payloads. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: Technicron's replacement for the original 4G model, the 5M was introduced in 3049 as an answer to the original's heat problems by replacing the thirteen normal heat sinks with double-strength versions. It also improved the design's defenses by swapping out the regular armor with Kallon FWL Special Ferro-Fibrous and installing CASE for the LRM's ammunition. The space necessary for these upgrades was provided for by removing the SRM launcher for a one-shot Hovertec SRM-4 Launcher, a disposable missile launcher more commonly found on VTOLs, hovercraft and similar combat vehicles. The loss in sheer short-range firepower is more than made up for by the other upgrades to the design. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08

content.original: The Raijin is designed to be highly mobile and capable of engaging an enemy at a variety of ranges. The Raijin is built around a 300 XL Engine that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h. For added mobility, the Raijin carries six jump jets, allowing the 'Mech to jump up to one hundred and eighty meters. The Raijin carries seven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The 'Mech's relatively light armor can be a liability if it is engaged in close combat or finds itself in a protracted engagement. To handle the heat from the weapons onboard, the Raijin carries ten double heat sinks. For long-range striking power, the Raijin carries a ER PPC that can be used to engage a target at up to six hundred and ninety meters. For close combat, the Raijin has three Medium Pulse Lasers. content.original: Originally conceived by Clan Jade Falcon during the Clans' Golden Century, the Emerald Harrier is a 15-ton BattleMech. It was out of production by the time of the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere and, as such, was only sparsely deployed there. ComStar ROM operatives gave it the reporting name RD-1R Roadrunner when they first observed it in the Jade Falcon occupation zone. content.original: The Salamander the design incorporates fire-based weapons; its primary armaments being a pair of Flamers slung under the arms and a single, one-shot short-range missile strapped to the shoulder, invariably one with an Inferno payload. This makes the Salamander especially potent against infantry and combat vehicles, though that does not mean it is less intimidating to MechWarriors: few would want to get caught in the sights of a Salamander Point. Quirk: Salamander Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.

Особенность: Прочный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.16 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to its notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 1N is powered by a 330-rated Fusion Core giving it a top speed of 97 km/h. A PPC and an SRM-6 form the Mechs weapons load. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.content: Один из первых серийных квадмехов, 55-тонный Scorpion, был запущен в производство в 2570 году как юнит поддержки пехоты. Несмотря на то, что большинство мехвоинов избегали его из-за его известной нестабильности, Scorpion тем не менее использовался без перерыва на протяжении всех Наследных войн и после них. Scorpion 1N оснащён термоядерным двигателем рейтинга 330, что обеспечивает ему максимальную скорость 97 км/ч. Боевая нагрузка меха включает в себя РРС и SRM-6. Особенность: Ул. система жизнеобеспечения Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.03

content.original: The Sentinel is a medium BattleMech built by Defiance Industries, originally under exclusive contract for the Lyran Commonwealth, as an infantry support and installation defense 'Mech. While initially pleased to have a then Terran Hegemony controlled factory manufacturing the 'Mech exclusively for the LCAF, the Lyrans were less so when a Star League Council amendment in 2652 permitted the Star League Defense Force to purchase a highly advanced version of the design which Houses Steiner, Marik and Davion would not receive until years later. The Sentinel was one of many designs to suffer from the technological decline of the Succession Wars era, with Defiance first losing the ability to manufacture its advanced weapon systems before discontinuing production entirely in 3014 due to lack of both parts and interest. Rather than disappear from the battlefield, the Sentinel now began to appear in increasing numbers thanks to ComStar and its massive stockpile of SLDF material, both providing the design to the Draconis Combine prior to the War of 3039 and using it to help outfit its Com Guards. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper

content.content: «Страж» — средний боевой мех, построенный компанией Defiance Industries по эксклюзивному контракту для Лиранского Содружества в качестве меха поддержки пехоты и защиты объектов. Хотя поначалу они были рады иметь завод на тогда ещё территории Терранской Гегемонии, и производить мехов эксклюзивно для лиранцев, лиранцы стали менее довольны, когда поправка Совета Звёздной Лиги в 2652 году позволила Силам обороны Звёздной Лиги получить сильно улучшенную версию этого меха, которую Дома Штайнер, Марик и Дэвион получат лишь спустя годы. Sentinel был одним из многих проектов, пострадавших от технологического упадка Наследных войн: Defiance сначала потеряла возможность производить свои передовые системы вооружения, а затем полностью прекратила производство в 3014 году из-за нехватки как деталей, так и интереса. Вместо того, чтобы исчезнуть с поля боя, «Стражи» начали появляться во все большем количестве благодаря КомСтару и его огромному запасу материалов СОЗЛ. Материалы и сам мех они предоставили Синдикату Дракона до Войны 3039 года и использовали меха для оснащения своей комстражи. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 1 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper

Хотя поначалу они были рады иметь завод на тогда ещё территории Терранской Гегемонии, и производить мехов эксклюзивно для лиранцев, лиранцы стали менее довольны, когда поправка Совета Звёздной Лиги в 2652 году позволила Силам обороны Звёздной Лиги получить сильно улучшенную версию этого меха, которую Дома Штайнер, Марик и Дэвион получат лишь спустя годы. Sentinel был одним из многих проектов, пострадавших от технологического упадка Наследных войн: Defiance сначала потеряла возможность производить свои передовые системы вооружения, а затем полностью прекратила производство в 3014 году из-за нехватки как деталей, так и интереса. Вместо того, чтобы исчезнуть с поля боя, «Стражи» начали появляться во все большем количестве благодаря КомСтару и его огромному запасу материалов СОЗЛ. Материалы и сам мех они предоставили Синдикату Дракона до Войны 3039 года и использовали меха для оснащения своей комстражи. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.04 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper

content.original: The Sentinel is a medium BattleMech built by Defiance Industries, originally under exclusive contract for the Lyran Commonwealth, as an infantry support and installation defense 'Mech. While initially pleased to have a then Terran Hegemony controlled factory manufacturing the 'Mech exclusively for the LCAF, the Lyrans were less so when a Star League Council amendment in 2652 permitted the Star League Defense Force to purchase a highly advanced version of the design which Houses Steiner, Marik and Davion would not receive until years later. The Sentinel was one of many designs to suffer from the technological decline of the Succession Wars era, with Defiance first losing the ability to manufacture its advanced weapon systems before discontinuing production entirely in 3014 due to lack of both parts and interest. Rather than disappear from the battlefield, the Sentinel now began to appear in increasing numbers thanks to ComStar and its massive stockpile of SLDF material, both providing the design to the Draconis Combine prior to the War of 3039 and using it to help outfit its Com Guards. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper

content.original: The Sentry was developed under pressure from the Draconis and Capellan marches for a more advanced 'Mech to defend the borders of the Federated Suns. The 'Mech is built on a light weight Dorwinion hyperactive 3 Endo Steel chassis. This chassis saves weight, allowing the 'Mech to carry heavier weapons and equipment. The Sentry is powered by a Nissan 200 fusion engine that gives it a top speed of 86.4 km/h that is augmented by five HildCo Model 12 jump jets that make it possible for the Sentry to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. To compensate for its less than average mobility, the Sentry has an impressive eight and a half tons of Starshield A armor that has been fitted with CASE to protect the 'Mech from an ammunition explosion. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

The first version of the Shadow Hawk IIC is meant for close-range fighting, and appears to be designed with urban warfare in mind. Этот мех оснащён системой ATM 6 с тремя тоннами различных боеприпасов, что обеспечивает гибкость выбора. Ракетная установка дополнена двумя средними импульсными лазерами и одним средним ER-лазером. Особенность: Боевые кулаки Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.07

content.original: Allied Aerospace won the SLDF's contract to produce a series of Land-Air mechs with a design based on the venerable Shadow HawkBattleMech. Allied gave their new Land-Air 'Mech the ability to convert directly into an Aerospace Fighter. While construction was completed in 2680, thanks to the chassis' numerous flaws, lackluster performance and a number of ill-fated and publicly witnessed test-flights disasters during SLDF reviews in 2682, Allied Aerospace was forced to go back to the drawing board. The more refined X2 variant faced considerable scrutiny by SLDF evaluators in 2684, successfully meeting the SLDF's requirements but still rejected thanks to its high fuel consumption and the bad press generated by the earlier X1. Twenty SHD-X2 were built for trials with potential customers, but failed to attract any interest. Ultimately Allied scrapped the Shadow Hawk LAM program in favor of what became the considerably more successful Phoenix Hawk LAM. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: The 5M Shadow Hawk is the first complete overhaul and upgrade of the design, unveiled in 3048 by Earthwerks for the Free Worlds League. The chassis has been upgraded to an Earthwerks SHD II Endo Steel frame, an additional ton of armor was added, two additional jump jets were fitted for a total jumping distance of 150 meters, the engine replaced with an extralight version of the Hermes 275, and the weapons load has undergone an almost complete renovation. The original autocannon has been updated to an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5, the LRM launcher to a Doombud LRM-20, and the head-mounted SRM launcher to a Hovertec Streak SRM-2. The amount of ammunition carried and the left-arm medium laser are maintained, and while the number of heat sinks was reduced to ten these were upgrade to double-strength models. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Shootist first saw service in 2621 as a heavily armored, electronic warfare-capable command 'Mech for SLDF Royal BattleMech Regiments. However, the Shootist's upgraded electronic suites proved no match for the cutting edge of electronic warfare of its own time. When the BattleMaster eclipsed the Shootist in its intended role as a command vehicle merely ten years after its introduction, the SLDF changed the Shootist's mission parameters. The Shootist's balanced mix of weapons and speed, and its heavy armor allowed it a new role: juggernaut for close-combat heavy lances, and later, a bodyguard unit for command lances. This role never proved favorable to the longevity of the Shootist; since the Succession Wars, this BattleMech is rarely seen outside of the ComGuards, Word of Blake Militia, and ancient Clan Brian Caches. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper

When the BattleMaster eclipsed the Shootist in its intended role as a command vehicle merely ten years after its introduction, the SLDF changed the Shootist's mission parameters. The Shootist's balanced mix of weapons and speed, and its heavy armor allowed it a new role: juggernaut for close-combat heavy lances, and later, a bodyguard unit for command lances. This role never proved favorable to the longevity of the Shootist; since the Succession Wars, this BattleMech is rarely seen outside of the ComGuards, Word of Blake Militia, and ancient Clan Brian Caches. Особенность: Командирский мех Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.1 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper

content.original: A variant of the standard Shootist ST-8A, the ST-8A2 is a refit designed to enhance the Mech's utility as a bodyguard for Command lances. A class D refit, the 8A2 replaces the standard Medium Pulse Lasers with standard Medium Lasers. The free tonnage this creates is used to install a Beagle Active Probe and upgrade the Small Laser to a Pulse model. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper

content.original:
Apparently based on the Timber Wolf, the Sidewinder OmniMech was developed by Clan Cloud Cobra in preparation for the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere. When it turned out that the Cloud Cobras would likely not be among the invader clans they became increasingly desperate and eventually fielded a Sidewinder against Clan Jade Falcon in a trial on Babylon that they lost. The Jade Falcons salvaged the heavily damaged 'Mech and all available information is based on their investigation of the design. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

content.original: The Siren ProtoMech was originally designed by Clan Smoke Jaguar to serve as a reconnaissance unit. Its high speed allowed it to rush forward, find enemy forces, call in a missile strike, and evacuate without the enemy being able to see them. As the Siren was intended to be a scout and observer, it only carries a Light Machine Gun in either arm. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96

content.original: The Inner Sphere adapted to battle armor quickly after being introduced to the concept by the Clan Elemental suit, so much so that the IS started innovating and testing the limits of what was possible almost immediately. In the 3050s the Lyran Commonwealth led the charge with this, the Sloth, the first quadruped battle armor. The Lyrans armed each suit with two Small Lasers and a BA-scale Pop-Up Mine, a weapon designed to penetrate armor and deal direct internal damage. The Sloth proved dangerous but unwieldy to control, making it unpopular with pilots. Quirk: IS Standard Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can only mount internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.original: The Snake is a 'Mech that was built under the aegis of an Elemental hunter. With the power of hindsight though the Snake is clearly designed to hunt Inner Sphere Battle Armor suits. The 'Mech is built using a Vox 225 XL Engine to move at a top speed of 86.4 km/h. The Snake also has a jumping capability of one hundred and fifty meters making it capable of outmaneuvering any battle armor suit and also keeping it on par with most medium 'Mechs. The Snake is also armored with seven tons of armor and uses double heat sinks to cool the 'Mech's excess heat. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: StarCorps Industries’s Project: SORCERER was shrouded in such secrecy that the first Sorcerer Battlemechs just seemed to appear in Star League Defense Force ranks where they were met with varying degrees of suspicion. The 95-ton Sorcerer 1A is built around a PlasmaStar 380XL engine to propel it to a respectable 64.8 km/h which enables the Sorcerer to bring its arsenal and Guardian ECM Suite to the enemy. The design carries a pair of Ceres Arms Smasher PPCs, a pair of Donal Snub-Nose PPCs, a pair of Magna MkII Medium Lasers, and a Magna MkI Small Laser. A staggering twenty Double Heat Sinks is barely enough to keep the weapons’ heat generation in check. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17

content.original: Shortly after the Sorcerer 1A began walking off of the StarCorps Industries production lines on Fletcher, the Sorcerer 1B began production in the satellite facility on Crofton. The 1B variant trades in the array of PPCs and Lasers for a Blankenburg Technologies ER PPC, a pair of Artemis IV-enhanced Holly LRM15s, and a trio of Defiance P5M Medium Pulse Lasers. The reduced Heat generation of this payload allowed designers to remove the five external Double Heat Sinks and freed up room for CASE in the right torso. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17

content.original: Of the relatively few Sorcerers built before the Amaris Coup, the Sorcerer 1CC variant was considered an exceptionally rare design. Originally planned as a replacement for the 90 ton Cyclops, it quickly became apparent that the design teams at StarCorps Industries were not going to be able to best its incredible computer systems. Rather than spending several more decades of development, the design team decided that modifying the Sorcerer 1A would be a suitable method to cut corners. The 1CC drops the Snub-Nose PPCs, lasers and five Double Heat Sinks in order to mount an additional Ceres Arms Smasher PPC, a quintet of Magna 400P Medium Pulse Lasers, and the advanced Command Console. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19

content.original: StarCorps Industries’s Project: SORCERER is considered one of the best examples of effective counter-industrial espionage techniques; despite being in development for nearly two decades, the various intelligence agencies of the Great Houses never managed to collect any meaningful data on the program. The project’s primary goal was to create an assault BattleMech capable of slipping behind and operations behind enemy lines for an indefinite period of time and if at all possible, do this task undetected. Produced in exceptionally small quantities up until Amaris forces overran their facilities on Fletcher, the 95-ton Sorcerer 1X sports a combination of a Null Signature System and a Chameleon Light Polarization Shield. The 1X carries a pair of Ceres Arms Smasher PPCs, a pair of Donal Snub-Nose PPCs, and pair of Magna 400P Medium Pulse Lasers which in combination with the stealth systems onboard can easily overpower the Mech’s nineteen Double Heat Sinks. Few remember the 1X variant as the more widely-produced and fielded 1A variant stepped off of the manufacturing lines on the same day. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19

content.original: Like many designs lost during the Succession Wars, the Sorcerer design saw new life in the decades after the discovery of the Helm Memory Core. The Draconis Combine was the first to create a new variant of the aged SLDF design utilizing technologies at their disposal in 3058. The Sorcerer 2D retains the 380XL Engine, Guardian ECM Suite, one of the original PPCs, and thirteen of the original Double Heat Sinks and adds a pair of Shigunga MRM40s fed by four tons of ammo. A Small Laser is also added to the right arm for anti-personnel work. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15

content.original: An upgrade originating from the Free Worlds League, the 5M variant of the Stalker was introduced in 3050 using moderate amounts of Star League technology. Most of the weaponry was retained but both large lasers were removed for a single Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser placed in the 'Mech's centerline and a Narc Missile Beacon in the left torso accompanied by two tons of reloads, allowing the Stalker to tag enemy units with homing beacon and direct friendly missile fire onto them. The seventeen double heat sinks of the 5M afford it far greater heat efficiency than the twenty single heat sinks of previous models, although it still could not handle firing all of its weaponry simultaneously, and an additional ton of armor was added for survivability. Other changes included the use of proprietary components such as an Irian E.A.R. communications system, Riese-456 armor and a Irian Chassis Class 30. Unfortunately the designers of the new 5M dismissed the inclusion of CASE, a factor which led directly to the deaths of several Stalkers during the Clan Invasion due to ammunition cook-offs caused by overheating and weapon penetrations. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.content: Модернизированный Лигой Свободных Миров, 5M-вариант «Сталкера» был представлен в 3050 году с использованием технологий Звёздной Лиги. Большая часть вооружения осталась прежней, но оба больших лазера были удалены ради одного большого лазера Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser, и ракетного маяка Narc с двумя тоннами боеприпасов, что позволяет «Сталкеру» помечать вражеские юниты самонаводящимся маяком и направлять на них ракетный огонь. Семнадцать двойных радиаторов -5M дают гораздо лучшую теплоэффективность, чем двадцать одинарных радиаторов предыдущих моделей, хотя он всё ещё не мог вести одновременный огонь из всего своего вооружения. Для живучести была добавлена дополнительная тонна брони. Среди других изменений - использование фирменных компонентов, таких как система связи Irian E.A.R., броня Riese-456 и структура Irian Class 30. К сожалению, конструкторы нового -5М отказались от включения CASE, что напрямую привело к гибели нескольких «Сталкеров» во время вторжения Кланов из-за перегрева боеприпасов и пробития брони. Особенность: Боевой компьютер Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.15 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Outfitted with the relatively recently rediscovered Star League technology of circa 3050, the FedCom 5S can be characterized primarily by its tendency to overheat. The designers behind this variant took the simple expedient of upgrading its engine and firepower without taking heat build-up into consideration. The 'Mech has had its engine replaced with an XL Engine and the large lasers have been removed and replaced with two Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Lasers. For protection against ammunition explosions, CASE has been added to both side torsos, and an Deprus Swarmshot Anti-Missile System has been added for protection against incoming missiles. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The big gun on the Stalking Spider is its ER PPC, which allows it deal a strong strike from long ranges. For close-up work, it has a pair of SRM-4 launchers and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers. While the design can build a significant amount of heat if the MechWarrior constantly alpha strikes, an experienced pilot should be able to manage the Stalking Spider's heat easily. The design can stay at long range and snipe with its ER PPC, then quickly close to finish off an opponent with its pulse lasers and missiles. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: The STL-7D Stiletto was one of very few ultralight BattleMechs designed for a specific combat role: to fight short-range delaying actions and to engage the Lyran Commonwealth's new COM-2D Commando reconnaissance 'Mech. During the 2460s and 2470s, quantities of Commandos began appearing in regiments along the Steiner/Kurita border, a situation that concerned Lord Kurita greatly. Deciding to assume the offensive, he ordered a new BattleMech design constructed, cheaper than its intended adversary and available in quantity. The result, the Stiletto, entered full-scale production in 2473. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97

content.original: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. Found in the Draconis Combine, this variant uses two pairs of Martell Small Lasers on the arms instead of a single Medium Laser. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

content.content: В 2680 году Звездная Лига запросила у разработчиков создать «мехи, которые могут и летать, и функционировать как стандартные». Первый аэромех с чертежной доски, Shadow Hawk LAM, оказался настолько несовершенным, что концепция была почти отвергнута. Тем не менее, LexaTech Industries переработала механизм трансформации и представила первый жизнеспособный LAM, Stinger LAM, в 2688 году, основанный на старом дизайне Stinger. Переделка концепции LexaTech оказалась настолько успешной, что аэромех стал очень востребованным, особенно для космических боевых действий. Фактически, Stinger LAM в своём первом бою уничтожил завод по производству ядерного оружия в облаке Оорта, вращающемся вокруг Солнца, звезды Терры. Особенность: Мех «земля-воздух» Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.99

This version used an Extra-light Engine to mount a pair of Thunderstroke Series 2b Gauss Rifles along the top of the 'Mech. Each arm carried a Series 4D-2 Heavy Large Laser, a Series 22a Heavy Medium Laser, and a General Systems Heavy Small Laser. It retained the shock-absorbing cowls of the original. A head-mounted Shield-3 Anti-Missile System defended against missiles, while an Anti-Personnel Pod in each leg discouraged unarmored infantry. This design had jump jets, nineteen tons of armor, and a meager sixteen double heat sinks. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24

content.original: The Striker STC-2C is built using rugged, off-the-shelf technologies that allow it to stand up to a great deal of punishment and enable easy repair. The 2C has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, provided by a 320-rated Fusion engine. For protection, it carries thirteen and a half tons of armor, solidly average for a 'Mech of the Striker's size. The Striker STC-2C dissipates the heat from its arsenal with fifteen standard heat sinks. It has an arsenal that is capable of engaging an enemy at a variety of ranges. At maximum range, the 2C brings its PPC and a AC/5 to bear. As the enemy closes, it can also make use of its Large Laser, though the unit's pilot will need to monitor their heat generation carefully. Finally, for close range defense, it has three Medium Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.content: «Призыватель» — высокомобильный тяжёлый омнимех, широко используемый в самых разных целях. Едва ли являющийся мехом второго поколения, Summoner был представлен кланом Нефритового Сокола сразу после того, как они стали первым кланом, получившим технологию омнимеха от клана Койота в 2863 году. content.original: The Swordsman was an early Federated Suns medium-class BattleMech which was originally built in 2463 as House Davion's third in-house BattleMech design. The design was tainted by heavy use in the Davion Civil War of 2525-2540. Eventually, production ended and the design was relegated to the dustbin of history. However, in the 3060s, the mech was put back into production by House Davion to supplement their forces in the FedCom Civil War. The SWD-2 is the stock production design, mounting heavy armor and firepower for the tonnage: 7.5 tons of armor and a grab-bag mix of guns including an AC/5, LRM-5, SRM-4, two Medium Lasers, and a Small Laser. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1

content.original: A relic of an earlier age, it's a minor miracle this antique is still functional. Occasionally found through the frontier, surviving Taloses are a strange mix of new and old technology, bodged together by generations of different mectechs. Rarely seen and even more rarely fielded in battle, very few of these 500 year old designs still grace the modern battlefield, but those that do are treated with the respect and reverence, due to a centuries old design. The 1P is the "modern" adaptation of the older 1B design and has proliferated in recent years, leading some to speculate that a cache of Talos or Talos parts has been found. Armed with a variety of local tech and a knock-off ecm suite, the 1P is a versatile design outfitted as a mid range brawler. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: With the reintroduction of Helm Core LosTech, the Taurian Defense Force found themselves lagging behind their neighbours. Just as they did during the Age of War, the Taurians turned to the home grown Talos. With a reputation as an easy to maintain and easy to manufacture mech, the design was just what the TDF needed. Lacking the resources to turn the newly redesigned Talos into a viable production model, the Taurians enlisted the aid of their neighbours, in exchange for joining the ongoing Trinity Alliance negotiations. Aided by the expertise of Capellan engineers and financial investment from the Magistracy of Canopus, Vandenburg started limited manufacturing of the Talos; at their New Vandenburg plant: in late 3059. The formal signing of the Trinity Alliance, in 3062; awarded production licenses to both Majesty Metals and Detroit Consolidated Mech Works. Both companies swiftly opened their own lines, producing multiple variants of the Talos for their own use and for export further afield. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

Lacking the resources to turn the newly redesigned Talos into a viable production model, the Taurians enlisted the aid of their neighbours, in exchange for joining the ongoing Trinity Alliance negotiations. Aided by the expertise of Capellan engineers and financial investment from the Magistracy of Canopus, Vandenburg started limited manufacturing of the Talos; at their New Vandenburg plant: in late 3059. The formal signing of the Trinity Alliance, in 3062; awarded production licenses to both Majesty Metals and Detroit Consolidated Mech Works. Both companies swiftly opened their own lines, producing multiple variants of the Talos for their own use and for export further afield. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The original variant of the Tarantula is armored with four and a half tons of armor, while it only carries about three quarters of the theoretical maximum armor, the 'Mech's amazing speed makes the Tarantula capable of avoiding most damage. As the design is focused on scouting, the Tarantula carries a light armament that is common to a 'Mech of its size and role. The primary weapons are a pair of medium lasers which give the Tarantula most of its striking power. These are backed up by a Streak SRM-2 launcher, which allows the Tarantula to find any weak spots in an enemy's armor. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98

content.original: Intended to emulate the Thor OmniMech used by the Clans, the Thanatos is an incredibly sturdy and hard-hitting design. Copying both the looks and the capabilities of the Clan Thor, the Thanatos is a fast all-range design, though it skimps on armor a bit for a mech its size. Carrying an ER Large Laser for long range and a brace of advanced medium lasers and a MRM-20 for medium to close range, the Thanatos has a weapon for any situation. Combined with a fast 86.4 km/h top speed and five jump jets, the Thanatos can often catch what it cannot out-range. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: Созданный по образцу омнимеха Thor, используемого Кланами, Thanatos отличается невероятной прочностью и мощью. Копируя как внешний вид, так и возможности кланового Thor, Thanatos является быстрой машиной, способной действовать на всех дистанциях, хотя для меха такого размера он немного скуповат в плане брони. Оснащенный ER Large Laser для дальних дистанций, парой усовершенствованных средних лазеров и MRM-20 для средних и ближних дистанций, Thanatos имеет оружие для любой ситуации. В сочетании с высокой максимальной скоростью 86,4 км/ч и пятью прыжковыми двигателями, Thanatos часто может догнать то, что не может перестрелять. Особенность: Стабильный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.11 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: Advanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Стандарт Внутренней Сферы был разработан после вторжения Кланов, когда державы Внутренней Сферы спешили воспроизвести технологию боевой брони Кланов. Однако, не имея никаких частей с полей сражений, инженеры были вынуждены работать на основе древних слухов о ранних силовых бронекостюмах типа Nighthawk, больше похожих на бронированные экзоскелеты, чем на тех «жаб», что встречались им в настоящее время, и их прототипы плохо показывали себя во время испытаний. Настоящий толчок в изучении боевой брони дали трофеи с первых побед над Кланами. Научный институт Нового Авалона первым частично воспроизвел броню элементалей в виде Стандарта Внутренней Сферы. Особенность: Продвинутый Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

Having reached a similar conclusion that resulted in the THE-Nb, the CASE was dropped and the standard engine was swapped for an XL Engine to allow the standard weaponry to be stripped for an all energy weapon array: a right arm mounted Kinslaughter H-Class ER PPC and a head-mounted Intek Small Laser. This new weapons array, enhanced by double heat sinks, added a level of lethality never seen before on the Thorn. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The Thug was designed by Maltex Corporation as a direct competitor to the popular Warhammer BattleMech. First seeing production in 2572, the Thug sought to directly address some of the challenges which faced the Warhammer, chief of which was to increase armor protection without sacrificing firepower. The Thugs long range striking power comes from a pair of arm mounted PPC’s. Backing up the PPCs are two SRM-6 launchers mounted in either side torso with one ton of CASE-protected reloads. Eighteen double heat sinks comfortably dissipate the enormous heat generated by the PPC’s while an Endo Steel frame allows it to carry fifteen and a half tons of armor. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14

content.original: Developed in 2850 as the Second Succession War saw more and more technologies disappear, the 5LS was a downgraded field refit and a factory model of the now impossible to build 5L. While the ER Large Laser and Starfish Small Pulse Lasers were retained, the standard LRM-15 and Bical SRM-2 rack were noticeably less accurate than the 5L's more advanced launchers, but nothing compared to the replacement of the 5L's double heat sinks with fifteen standard models and the heat management issues that resulted. Production of even the "primitive" 5LS would end during the Third Succession War. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

content.original: Designed with Star League technology, the 7M has been re-armored using Ferro-Fibrous armor, allowing the 'Mech's weapons to be upgraded with the freed weight. With an arsenal based on the 5S model, the 7M carries an LRM-15 missile launcher in the right torso, an ER Large Laser in the right arm, three medium lasers and a Streak SRM-2 launcher in the left torso, and a pair of machine guns in the left arm. Two tons of LRM reloads are kept in the right torso while one ton each of Streak and machine gun ammo are kept in the left torso. Additionally, the heat sinks have been upgraded to double heat sinks and CASE has been added to protect against ammunition explosion. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: When the Magistracy of Canopus found an abandoned Star League facility in 3018, amongst the stored equipment was a number of Thunderbolt chassis. All of them were severely damage and missing key components such as the weapons, gyro and engine. The Magistracy had to acquire these at great cost from the open market, and therefore opted to install internal combustion engines instead of the fusion cores. The F4X was the final version, overhauled to use an AC/10 in the right forearm while a pair of ten-tube MRM launchers was fitted into the left torso. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87

content.original: Ideal for working with spotters, the Thunder Stallion mounts four LRM-15 launchers and eight tons of ammunition for them. This gives the 'Mech a significant long-range punch that can be called down from behind cover. Perhaps the largest backup weapon ever is the Thunder Stallion's LB 20-X AC. This massive gun is capable of defending against infantry or blowing holes in all but the most well-armored of opponents. Fourteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cooled down. This relatively inexpensive, durable design is protected by a whopping seventeen and a half tons of armor. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19

content.original: The THR-1L Thunder is the first heavy ’Mech designed and produced by a Capellan manufacturer following the Clan invasion. Powered by a 350 XL Engine, the 70 ton Thunder is armed with an AC/20 supplied with three tons of ammunition. Complementing the autocannon is an LRM-5 located in the left torso, with one ton of ammunition. Three Medium Pulse Lasers back up the autocannon at close range, and the designers installed CASE to protect against ammo detonation. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper

content.original: Armed to engage an enemy at either short or long ranges, the B configuration is an attempt to use the Timber Wolf in a workhorse role. For long range combat, a Gauss Rifle and an LRM-10 launcher gives the Timber Wolf B a powerful long range punch. For short to medium range engagements, a Large Pulse Laser is carried. Finally, for short ranges, a Small Pulse Laser and SRM-4 launcher are carried. Additionally, both of the missile launchers are linked to an Artemis IV Fire Control System to allow for greater missile accuracy. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: Built due to an awkward exchange of technology between the Free Worlds League and the Word of Blake, the Toyama was designed by Dr. Thaddeus Anable and then given to the Word of Blake through an agreement made by Captain-General Thomas Marik. The Toyama is intended to be a multi-role BattleMech that can operate somewhat independently of supply lines. The 'Mech is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis which supports a Vlar 300 XL engine. The Toyama has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, making it capable of keeping pace with most heavy 'Mechs. The Toyama has an impressive twelve tons of Durallex Heavy armor. To dissipate heat, the Toyama carries fourteen double heat sinks. The 'Mech also carries a Garret/Guardian Interface Guardian ECM Suite to protect the 'Mech from advanced enemy electronic warfare systems. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Rebuilt from the salvaged remains of a Trebuchet 5S, this low tech refit is a common sight throughout the battlefields of the Deep Periphery. Mounting between 2 and 4 Rocket pods and backed up by a pair of Large Chem Lasers; makes the 5SP into a fearsome short range brawler. Some designs include scavenged or salvaged Endo Steel or Ferro-Fibrous, either for increased protection or to mount additional rocket pods. Limited by the 4 tons of Chemical Laser ammunition and the single salvos of the rocket pod, the SP lacks the endurance for protracted engagements. Fortunately these are rarely a concern in the Deep Periphery and this design is commonly seen during raids and border skirmishes, where its heavy firepower can give it an edge over less durable opponents. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The 5L variant is a more basic upgrade than the 4L and represents Ceres' attempt to produce a close-combat 'Mech superior to the FS9-0 Firestarter. Introduced in 3060 the 5L uses a standard engine, armor, and structure. The changes and advancements come in the weapons and the addition of a TSM system. The 'Mech's new weapons include an ER PPC, two ER medium lasers, two medium pulse lasers, a single Small Pulse Laser, and a small laser. This varied mix of energy weapons allows the MechWarrior piloting the 'Mech to balance their heat load to keep the TSM working at its optimum efficiency. In so doing, the Vindicator can deal a fair amount of damage with its Sword. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original:
Jade Falcon commanders were shocked to find themselves suffering losses from an unknown LAM that resembled a small Warhammer. Insulted that the Inner-Sphere forces disgraced the Warhammer lineage with a half-baked LAM, and being a bit more open minded on units, Jade Falcon scientists went to work, producing a 70t version loaded with Clan tech. Fielding the same powerful combo of twin ER PPCs, as well as a pair of Arrow Anti-Air missiles, these Warhammer LAMs provide withering fire on ground targets, and are able to defend themselves from modest aerospace defenses. Coupled with the improved maneuverability of a LAM, these units are finding themselves to be the backbone of quick-response anti-militia garrisons across Jade Falcon territory. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

One ton of machine gun rounds were carried in the center torso, while one ton each of missile reloads and AMS rounds were carried in the right. content.original:
Developed as part of Project Thor's Hammer, the Warhammer LAM aims to merge the effectiveness of the Warhammer's twin PPCs, with the mobility of a LAM, in hopes of aiding the fight against the Clans. While weight requirements forced the PPCs to be downsized to Light PPCs, they are equipped with PPC Capacitors for that extra punch, and the expansion of SRMs to twin SRM4's, as well as a sizable bomb bay, provide devastating short range firepower. This allows the Warhammer LAM to inflict serious damage on a flyover, then pepper the target at range with the Light PPCs from the rear, until enough gaps open up for the SRMs to exploit. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

Developed as part of Project Thor's Hammer, the Warhammer LAM aims to merge the effectiveness of the Warhammer's twin PPCs, with the mobility of a LAM, in hopes of aiding the fight against the Clans. The B variant replaces the bomb bay and SRMs for MMLs, providing 16 tubes in total, and was marketed towards Mercenary groups. The primitive engine reduced the top speed to 85 km/h and meant that only a single medium laser was carried. The prototype jump jets could only cover 150 meters in a jump. The primitive armor provided much less protection than the later Succession Wars-era Wasps, even though it carried three and a half tons of armor. Примитивный двигатель снижал максимальную скорость до 85 км/ч и позволял нести только один средний лазер. Прототипные прыжковые двигатели могли преодолевать в прыжке только 150 метров. content.original: A common Periphery rebuild, this mech is a mix of different weapons systems. A primitive medium laser copied from the original Wasp model provides subpar firepower, backed up by the one shot punch of an RL15. A small calibre rifle makes for a semi effective sniper weapon whilst its ammo lasts. The rest of the mech is almost standard spec, rebuilt by a succession of engineers to specs nearly identical to Inner Sphere counterparts. Surprisingly enough, this rebuild offers somewhat superior capabilities compared to most Inner Sphere models. Produced in any number of Periphery junk yards and back alley chop shops, this mech is incredibly common amongst periphery factions; who field the mech in vast quantities, praising its cheap firepower and easily repaired chassis. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.content: Типичный рефит из Периферии, этот мех - смесь различных систем вооружения. Примитивный средний лазер, скопированный с оригинальной модели Wasp, даёт огневую мощь, подкрепленную одним ударом из RL15. Винтовка малого калибра годится как аналог снайперского оружия, пока не иссякнут патроны. Остальное - почти стандартная конструкция, доведённая инженерами почти до аналогов Внутренней Сферы. Удивительно, но мех даёт более широкие возможности по сравнению с моделями ВС. Собранный буквально на коленке, этот мех крайне распространён среди окраинных фракций, предпочитающих дешёвых в обслуживании мехов. Особенность: Расширенный поворот торса Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.95 Лимит приводов рук: Right Lower

content.original: Standing at ten meters tall, the Watchman is a 'Mech that was born of necessity. The idea for the design came when the bulk of the AFFS was moved to the Clan front. Because this seriously undermined the ability of the Federated Suns to keep its borders secure, the Watchman was designed to be distributed to militia units within the border marches to bulk up their strength. In its own right the Watchman is a durable and reliable 'Mech that is built with off the shelf components and is very easy to repair. The 'Mech is armored with eight and a half tons of standard armor, has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, and can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. This, combined with the Watchman's varied arsenal, makes it an excellent trooper or trainer. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1

content.original: The 7D variant of the Wolverine is a major upgrade to the design introduced in 3050 by the Federated Suns' new Nanking factory. The standard engine on the 'Mech was replaced with a Nissan 275 XLversion and the armor has been upgraded to Kallon Unity Weave Ferro-Fibrous material with an extra half-ton added. To increase the Wolverine's speed, MASC has been added, allowing it to move up to 108 km/h in bursts. Finally, the weapons payload has been upgraded as well. The autocannon has been upgraded to a General Motors Nova-5 Ultra Autocannon/5 and the medium laser is now a Sutel Precision Line Medium Pulse Laser. The design retains its jumping capability, as well as the SRM-6, although CASE now protects the SRM reloads Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 km/h. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 kph. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: A second line Clan mech, the 45 ton Wyvern IIC is an upgrade of the SLDF Wyverns that survived the Exodus. Built using a cache of Wyverns, Clan Burrock upgraded every aspect of the original mech with Clan tech. Retaining the original 180-rated Fusion Core, the Wyvern IIC is armed with a mix of weapons. An ER Large Laser and an LRM-10 make up the Mechs long range firepower, with a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 for medium range combat. A pair of MG’s, a Flamer and a pair of ER Smalls give additional firepower at close range. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

The Large Laser and autocannon were swapped out for two PPCs. Because they did not upgrade the heat dissipation system along with the weapons, MechWarriors had to use volley fire, leading to displeasure with the design. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The original Ymir, the X1 prototype could only reach 53 km/h due to its primitive engine. The cockpit and armor were also both primitive, but the design mounted fifteen and a half tons of armor in total. Mounting sixteen heat sinks, the X1 was equipped with two LRM-5s in the right torso,a large laser in the right arm and an AC/5 in the left arm for long-range work. Four SRM-2s were mounted in the left torso for short range work - the designers believing that multiple small systems would be easier to maintain and adapt than larger systems - along with two vehicle flamers mounted in the right hand arm. The vehicle flamers were chosen for the design because of concerns about the safety of taking plasma directly from the reactor, although protecting and shielding the flamers caused problems. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.94 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Yu Huang, named for the Jade Emperor that rules the Heavenly Court in the ancient Chinese pantheon, debuted with the promise from Sun-Tzu Liao that 'it shall sit in judgment over a battlefield, meting out justice to those who would transgress against us'. To live up to the promise of the Chancellor of the Capellan Confederation, the Yu Huang carries some of the most advanced technologies available at the time of its initial production. The Yu Huang is built on a Chariot Type II Endo Steel chassis and carries a Hermes 360 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty meters with its four Rodan 90 jump jets. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

Manufactured on Kwangjong-ni by Defiance, the Zeus X was both a poster child for excellence in production engineering and an innovative high-technology platform. The first of what became commonly referred to as the Zeus X series, the ZEU-X was a variant of the venerable Zeus BattleMech developed using Experimental Technology to push the envelope of the original design. The 'Mech was armed with an LB-X Autocannon/20 as its primary weapon, backed up by an MRM-30 launcher. The ZEU-X carried three tons of ammunition for the LB-X AC/20 and two tons for the MRM-30, stored in the right torso and protected by CASE II. For close combat, the Zeus had two Medium X-Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2

content.content: БТРы, основа любого боевого подразделения с транспортами, использовались для перевозки пехоты ещё со времён докосмической Терры. Каждый из трёх основных типов БТР выполняет свою индивидуальную функцию на поле боя. Колёсные БТР, как правило, дешевле в производстве и несут более прочную броню, чем их гусеничные или ховер-аналоги. Колёсные БТР используются преимущественно в городских боях, поскольку колёса лучше всего подходят для дорог и лёгкой пересеченной местности. content.original: The Daimyo HQ was a heavy theater command unit utilized by the Draconis Combine. The first Daimyo was fielded in 2796 at the beginning of the Succession Wars by Jinjiro Kurita, who used the vehicle during the Kentares Massacre. While the Coordinator attended executions in person, the Daimyo HQ's crew transmitted the data to ComStar representatives on the planet who then sent the data through the whole Inner Sphere. When Jinjiro discovered the treason, the whole crew was executed. Daimyo production ceased between the years 3027 and 3063 because the unit's communication system technology become a form of Lostech. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. content.content: «Трезубец» — прочный и дорогостоящий 30-тонный гусеничный бронетранспортер, разработанный компанией Aldis Industries в период Первой войны за Наследство и с тех пор находящийся в постоянном производстве. Машина оснащена топливной ячейкой военного класса и защищена 7 тоннами брони; её максимальная скорость составляет 84 км/ч. Вооружение «Трезубца» состоит из двух пусковых установок LRM-5 и пары пулеметов. БМП способен перевозить целый отряд пехоты в относительно комфортных условиях, а после высадки — оказывать бойцам огневую поддержку. По иронии судьбы, сочетание высокой надежности и большой стоимости ограничивает рыночный потенциал этой техники: ежегодно выпускается лишь 200 единиц. Тем не менее, Trident можно встретить по всей Внутренней Сфере и даже в Периферии — у самых разных владельцев. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 5/8 гексов / 150/240 метров. Armed with a pair of SRM-4’s and a pair of Machine Guns; the Trident can ferry a full squad of troops in relative comfort and support them once they disembark. Ironically the combination of durability and high cost limits the potential market for the vehicle and only 200 are produced each year. Despite that, it can be found all around the Inner Sphere and occasionally the Periphery with a wide variety of buyers. Fuel Cell: Improved vehicle engine that works in a Vacuum. Movement: 5/8 Hex: 150/240 Meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 120 15 Left 95 15 Right 95 15 Rear 95 15 Turret 120 15 Total 525 75 Quirk: Enhanced FPE Can Resupply/Repair
content.content: «Трезубец» — прочный и дорогостоящий 30-тонный гусеничный бронетранспортер, разработанный компанией Aldis Industries в период Первой войны за Наследство и с тех пор находящийся в постоянном производстве. Машина оснащена топливной ячейкой военного класса и защищена 7 тоннами брони; её максимальная скорость составляет 84 км/ч. Вооружение Trident состоит из двух пусковых установок SRM-4 и двух пулеметов. БМП способен перевозить целый отряд пехоты в относительно комфортных условиях, а после высадки — оказывать бойцам огневую поддержку. По иронии судьбы, сочетание высокой надежности и большой стоимости ограничивает рыночный потенциал этой техники: ежегодно выпускается лишь 200 единиц. Тем не менее, Trident можно встретить по всей Внутренней Сфере и даже в Периферии — у самых разных владельцев. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 5/8 гексов / 150/240 метров. content.original: The Turhan was first built for the Terran Hegemony in 2530 by Dieron's Buhallin Military Products. The company, known for its wheeled vehicles, built the Turhan to answer the HAF's need for an urban assault vehicle to support its infantry in urban environments. The vehicle acted as an Armored Personnel Carrier, deploying troops from its large infantry transport bay. The vehicle is protected by seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, which ensured its cargo arrived at the designation intact. The Turhan's principal weaponry was its twin Large Lasers which were mounted in its turret. Mounted with the lasers were a pair of Machine Guns. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. content.original: The Blizzard Hover Transport was designed by Kressly Warworks and was first produced in 3054. While the Blizzard was intended for use against the Clans, it gained notoriety in the Chaos March and its effectiveness was realized in the Capellan-St. Ives War. The only weaponry integral to the Blizzard is a turret-mounted LongFire V LRM-5. This enables the speedy vehicle to remain out of range for most weapons, yet still contribute to the fight once its infantry bays are debarked. It can even hide behind cover and rely on infantry units to spot so it can fire indirectly. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. content.original: The Manticore is one of the best-designed and most powerful heavy tanks ever created, built to combat BattleMechs in support of infantry formations. Although the Manticore mounts a variety of weapons to handle a variety of combat roles and ranges, and is heavily armored for a vehicle of its weight, it is not equipped to deal with the raw firepower of Assault weight vehicles such as the Demolisher or the Behemoth. Despite this, the popularity of the Manticore has remained high, even during the Succession Wars era with its use of an expensive and rare Fusion Engine. Originally developed by TechniCorp during the Reunification War, the destruction of the company's head office on Terra during the Amaris Coup spread the Manticore across the Inner Sphere as other manufacturers absorbed their facilities. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. content.content: «Мантикора» — один из самых совершенных и мощных тяжёлых танков, когда-либо созданных, предназначенный для борьбы с боевыми мехами в поддержку пехотных формирований. Несмотря на то, что «Мантикора» оснащена разнообразным вооружением для выполнения различных боевых задач на разных дистанциях, а также имеет тяжёлую броню для машины своего веса, она не способна справиться с грубой огневой мощью штурмовых машин, таких как «Демолишер» или «Бегемот». Несмотря на это, популярность «Мантикоры» оставалась высокой даже в эпоху Наследных войн благодаря использованию дорогостоящего и редкого термоядерного двигателя. Изначально разработанная компанией TechniCorp во время Объединительной войны, после уничтожения её головного офиса на Терре во время переворота Амариса «Мантикора» распространилась по всей Внутренней Сфере, поскольку другие производители поглотили их заводы. content.original: The Demon was originally created by the SLDF as its standard fighting vehicle in 2716. A match for any light or medium BattleMech, the Demon had good maneuverability and was protected by ten tons of slab armor, most of it concentrated in its front. Due to the nature of its powerful main weapon the Demon was often used in ambush attacks and fought in pairs instead of the usual four-vehicle lance. The vehicle's main disadvantage was its lack of speed, which made it vulnerable to faster 'Mechs and other vehicles able to maneuver around and engage its weaker rear armor. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: The Manticore is one of the best-designed and most powerful heavy tanks ever created, built to combat BattleMechs in support of infantry formations. Although the Manticore mounts a variety of weapons to handle a variety of combat roles and ranges, and is heavily armored for a vehicle of its weight, it is not equipped to deal with the raw firepower of Assault weight vehicles such as the Demolisher or the Behemoth. Despite this, the popularity of the Manticore has remained high, even during the Succession Wars era with its use of an expensive and rare Fusion Engine. Originally developed by TechniCorp during the Reunification War, the destruction of the company's head office on Terra during the Amaris Coup spread the Manticore across the Inner Sphere as other manufacturers absorbed their facilities. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. content.content: «Мантикора» — один из самых совершенных и мощных тяжёлых танков, когда-либо созданных, предназначенный для борьбы с боевыми мехами в поддержку пехотных формирований. Несмотря на то, что «Мантикора» оснащена разнообразным вооружением для выполнения различных боевых задач на разных дистанциях, а также имеет тяжёлую броню для машины своего веса, она не способна справиться с грубой огневой мощью штурмовых машин, таких как «Демолишер» или «Бегемот». Несмотря на это, популярность «Мантикоры» оставалась высокой даже в эпоху Наследных войн благодаря использованию дорогостоящего и редкого термоядерного двигателя. Изначально разработанная компанией TechniCorp во время Объединительной войны, после уничтожения её головного офиса на Терре во время переворота Амариса «Мантикора» распространилась по всей Внутренней Сфере, поскольку другие производители поглотили их заводы. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 4/6 гексов / 120/180 метров. content.content: «Мантикора» — один из самых совершенных и мощных тяжёлых танков, когда-либо созданных, предназначенный для борьбы с боевыми мехами в поддержку пехотных формирований. Несмотря на то, что «Мантикора» оснащена разнообразным вооружением для выполнения различных боевых задач на разных дистанциях, а также имеет тяжёлую броню для машины своего веса, она не способна справиться с грубой огневой мощью штурмовых машин, таких как «Демолишер» или «Бегемот». Несмотря на это, популярность «Мантикоры» оставалась высокой даже в эпоху Наследных войн благодаря использованию дорогостоящего и редкого термоядерного двигателя. Изначально разработанная компанией TechniCorp во время Объединительной войны, после уничтожения её головного офиса на Терре во время переворота Амариса «Мантикора» распространилась по всей Внутренней Сфере, поскольку другие производители поглотили их заводы. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 4/6 гексов / 120/180 метров.
