content.original:
Initially created as a ClanTech test bed by the AFFC, the Prometheus is more known for its legendary run in the Solaris 7 arenas. Stolen by the notorious Professor Burke Kale, the Prometheus was fitted with an illegal Direct Neural Interface and a Virtual Reality Piloting Pod; allowing the Professor to control the Mech as easily as if it were his own body. Powered by a 375-rated XL Engine and built around a clan made Endo Steel skeleton, the Prometheus had a top speed of 80km/h and nearly 12 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The Prometheus's weapons were all ClanTech and consisted of an ER PPC and Large Pulse Laser paired with 2 LRM-15's. For close range combat, it mounted a Medium Pulse Laser, 2 SRM-6's and 6 Machine Guns. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: The personal 'Mech of Khan Sullivan Koga, it mimics her trends in leading the Coyotes; a strong base, upgraded and enhanced by new features. Building off of the classic Awesome loadout, three ER PPCs provide long range firepower without ammo constraints, or thanks to the 23 double heatsinks, heat worries. Running relatively minimal ammo considering the heat produced by the ER PPCs, the UAC/10 and ATM 9 are more support weapons; available to finish off a target, instead of waiting for the PPCs to recharge. Khan Koga used this to great effect when attacking the Nova Cats on Huntress, splitting fire between a distant target with two PPCs, and finishing off a closer 'Mech with the UAC/10 and ATM 9. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: Clan Coyote created the LUNA experimental model as a reminder of their history with the Inner Sphere and Star League, borrowing heavily from Native American lore; they had foolishly left their love when trying to impress them, and their nightly howl is their eternal promise to return. The howl of the HAG 40, the burning display of the Laser Heatsinks, all reinforce the theme of announcing their love for, and sorrow for leaving, their love. Outside of the handful of Coyotes who know the stories though, the LUNA designator is assumed to be related to the effectiveness of the unit on low-atmospheric worlds, perfectly masking the feelings of those who feel the decision to stay with the Clan Homeworlds was not the right choice. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to its notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scoprion 1NW is a custom refit created by Wendall Puritan of the Smithson's Chinese Bandits. Retaining the 330-rated Fusion Core and the SRM-6, the PPC was replaced with a Large Laser and additional tonnage was dedicated to armor. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

Несмотря на то, что большинство мехвоинов избегали его из-за его известной нестабильности, Scorpion тем не менее использовался без перерыва на протяжении всех Наследных войн и после них. content.original: Designed after the personal ‘Mech of Elle Bennett of the 5th Donegal Guards, the GRF-1E 'Sparky' is a radical departure from standard Griffin design ethos. In place of its typical missile rack, the 1E features enough power couplings to mount a cluster of Medium Lasers - five of them, in fact - alongside the typical PPC. In a curious design decision, the engineers behind the Sparky opted for an innovative radiator pattern instead of more sophisticated heat sinks, likely as a cost-saving experiment. While this does give the 'Mech above-average heat dissipation, it's provided complement of standard heat sinks is still woefully inadequate for such a high heat load. This means that, while powerful, this 'Mech needs an equally disciplined pilot to avoid cooking alive. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The Summoner is a highly mobile heavy OmniMech that is commonly used in a wide variety of roles. Barely a second generation OmniMech, the Jade Falcons introduced the Summoner just after becoming the first Clan to win OmniMech technology from Clan Coyote in 2863. The custom configuration of Aiden Pryde used during his first Trial of Position with Clan Jade Falcon in 3030, the ADN features an ER PPC and Large Pulse Laser in the right arm as primary weapons. Backing these up are the standard LRM15 in the Left Torso and a pair of ER Medium Pulse Lasers in the left arm. A single Anti-Missile System in the right torso rounds out the configuration. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: «Призыватель» — высокомобильный тяжёлый омнимех, широко используемый в самых разных целях. Едва ли являющийся мехом второго поколения, Summoner был представлен кланом Нефритового Сокола сразу после того, как они стали первым кланом, получившим технологию омнимеха от клана Койота в 2863 году. ADN оснащён ER PPC и Large Pulse Laser в правой руке как основное оружие. Кроме того, в левом торсе установлены стандартный LRM15 и пара средних импульсных лазеров в левой руке. Завершает конфигурацию одиночная система ПРО в правом торсе. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.13 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: This Thunder Stallion is the personal BattleMech of Galaxy Commander Titus Mitchell, commander of Clan Hell’s Horses Beta Galaxy. While still a support ‘Mech, the Thunder Stallion Mitchell carries a unique loadout when compared to the standard Thunder Stallion, or even the common variant, the Fire Stallion. Mitchell’s ‘Mech carries an LB-X autocannon, much like the standard version, but tones it down to an LB-10X instead of the larger LB-20X. Besides the autocannon, the Thunder Stallion carries energy weapons exclusively. One Large Pulse Laser, a Medium Pulse Laser, and an ER Medium Laser were added to the left torso. On the right torso three more Medium Pulse Lasers are arrayed. Along with his weaponry upgrades, Mitchell also had a clan targeting computer added to his Thunder Stallion. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21

content.original: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. content.original: With 'Mechs having begun their rule of the open battlefields the Gallant was intended as a niche product for the specific role of urban warfare and infantry support. Developed by Freeport Armorworks on Helm (production was later taken over by Kallon Industries on Loyalty) the design was nearly killed by budget issues which forced downgrades to the planned fusion power plant and other modern features, though eventually it was equipped at least with CASE. To fulfill its urban combat role the vehicle featured a low, very heavily armored chassis with self-inflating tires, a necessity to keep the heavy six-wheeler mobile under fire. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 300 35 Left 275 35 Right 275 35 Rear 300 35 Turret 250 35 Total 1400 175 Quirk: Main Battle Tank

content.content: С началом господства мехов на полях сражений Gallant задумывался как нишевый продукт, предназначенный для ведения боевых действий в городских условиях и поддержки пехоты. Разработанный компанией Freeport Armorworks на Хельме (производство впоследствии перешло к Kallon Industries на Лоялти), проект едва не был загублен из-за бюджетных ограничений, которые привели к отказу от запрашиваемого термоядерного двигателя и других современных функций, хотя в конечном итоге он был оснащён хотя бы системой CASE. Для выполнения своих функций в городских условиях машина имела низкое и очень прочное бронированное шасси с самонадувающимися шинами, что было необходимо для обеспечения мобильности тяжёлого шестиколёсного автомобиля под обстрелом. Ограничения биома: этот юнит не может действовать в лунном или марсианском биомах из-за использования ДВС. Передвижение: 3/5 гексов / 90/150 метров. content.original: The Packrat is a speedy eight-wheeled vehicle that is designed for deep infiltration and sabotage. First produced by Robertson Technologies, the vehicle is meant to operate on its own deep behind enemy lines for extended periods of time. While excelling in this role, the Packrat suffered during the Succession Wars as, with the decline in knowledge brought about by the conflicts, many had their advanced fusion engines removed for use elsewhere. The technological renaissance brought about by the Helm Memory Core recovery also proved to be a turning point for the Packrat, as manufacturers in the Lyran Commonwealth were able to put fusion-powered Packrats back into production and help spread them across the Inner Sphere. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 80 10 Left 80 10 Right 80 10 Rear 80 10 Total 320 40 Quirk: Improved Communications

content.content: «Packrat» — скоростная восьмиколёсная машина, предназначенная для глубокого проникновения и диверсий. Впервые произведенная компанией Robertson Technologies, эта машина предназначена для длительных автономных действий в глубоком тылу противника. Несмотря на превосходные результаты в этой роли, «Packrat» пострадал во время Наследных войн, поскольку из-за упадка знаний, вызванного конфликтами, многие из них были вынуждены демонтировать свои передовые термоядерные двигатели для использования в других целях. Технологический ренессанс, вызванный восстановлением ядра памяти Хельма, также стал поворотным моментом для «Packrat», поскольку производители в Лиранском Содружестве смогли возобновить производство «Packrat» на термоядерных двигателях и способствовать их распространению по всей Внутренней Сфере. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 7/11 гексов / 210/330 метров. Броня: Броня Структура: Структура Знач-я Б С Перед 80 10 Лево 80 10 Право 80 10 Зад 80 10 Итого 320 40 Особенность: Улучшенная связь

content.original: The Rotunda was a covert reconnaissance wheeled vehicle intentionally designed to resemble a civilian sedan. The 20-ton Rotunda was designed to be a self sufficient combat platform and home for its single crew member. From a distance, the sleek Rotunda resembled any number of civilian ICE-powered saloon cars, only enhanced by body kits which allowed it to become a variety of other similarly shaped vehicle types. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 45 10 Left 20 10 Right 20 10 Rear 5 10 Total 90 40 Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile

First produced by Robertson Technologies, the vehicle is meant to operate on its own deep behind enemy lines for extended periods of time. While excelling in this role, the Packrat suffered during the Succession Wars as, with the decline in knowledge brought about by the conflicts, many had their advanced fusion engines removed for use elsewhere. The technological renaissance brought about by the Helm Memory Core recovery also proved to be a turning point for the Packrat, as manufacturers in the Lyran Commonwealth were able to put fusion-powered Packrats back into production and help spread them across the Inner Sphere. content.original: The original 3024 prototype of what became the RVN-3L Raven, this was the unit that was pressed into service against the Federated Suns during the Fourth Succession War. With XL engine technology not yet available, the 'Mech mounted a standard Omni 175 fusion engine, giving it a maximum speed of 86 km/h, and was protected by four tons of standard armor. The EW Equipment at the time that this 'Mech was built consisted of a massive 7.5 ton experimental electronic warfare suite that unfortunately did not live up to expectations. content.original: With 'Mechs having begun their rule of the open battlefields the Gallant was intended as a niche product for the specific role of urban warfare and infantry support. Developed by Freeport Armorworks on Helm (production was later taken over by Kallon Industries on Loyalty) the design was nearly killed by budget issues which forced downgrades to the planned fusion power plant and other modern features, though eventually it was equipped at least with CASE. To fulfill its urban combat role the vehicle featured a low, very heavily armored chassis with self-inflating tires, a necessity to keep the heavy six-wheeler mobile under fire. content.original: The Packrat is a speedy eight-wheeled vehicle that is designed for deep infiltration and sabotage. First produced by Robertson Technologies, the vehicle is meant to operate on its own deep behind enemy lines for extended periods of time. While excelling in this role, the Packrat suffered during the Succession Wars as, with the decline in knowledge brought about by the conflicts, many had their advanced fusion engines removed for use elsewhere. The technological renaissance brought about by the Helm Memory Core recovery also proved to be a turning point for the Packrat, as manufacturers in the Lyran Commonwealth were able to put fusion-powered Packrats back into production and help spread them across the Inner Sphere. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 80 10 Left 80 10 Right 80 10 Rear 80 10 Total 320 40 Quirk: Improved Communications

content.content: «Packrat» — скоростная восьмиколёсная машина, предназначенная для глубокого проникновения и диверсий. Впервые произведенная компанией Robertson Technologies, эта машина предназначена для длительных автономных действий в глубоком тылу противника. Несмотря на превосходные результаты в этой роли, «Packrat» пострадал во время Наследных войн, поскольку из-за упадка знаний, вызванного конфликтами, многие из них были вынуждены демонтировать свои передовые термоядерные двигатели для использования в других целях. Технологический ренессанс, вызванный восстановлением ядра памяти Хельма, также стал поворотным моментом для «Packrat», поскольку производители в Лиранском Содружестве смогли возобновить производство «Packrat» на термоядерных двигателях и способствовать их распространению по всей Внутренней Сфере. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 7/11 гексов / 210/330 метров. Броня: Броня Структура: Структура Знач-я Б С Перед 80 10 Лево 80 10 Право 80 10 Зад 80 10 Итого 320 40 Особенность: Улучшенная связь

content.content: С началом господства мехов на полях сражений Gallant задумывался как нишевый продукт, предназначенный для ведения боевых действий в городских условиях и поддержки пехоты. Разработанный компанией Freeport Armorworks на Хельме (производство впоследствии перешло к Kallon Industries на Лоялти), проект едва не был загублен из-за бюджетных ограничений, которые привели к отказу от запрашиваемого термоядерного двигателя и других современных функций, хотя в конечном итоге он был оснащён хотя бы системой CASE. Для выполнения своих функций в городских условиях машина имела низкое и очень прочное бронированное шасси с самонадувающимися шинами, что было необходимо для обеспечения мобильности тяжёлого шестиколёсного автомобиля под обстрелом. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 3/5 гексов / 90/150 метров. content.original: The Packrat is a speedy eight-wheeled vehicle that is designed for deep infiltration and sabotage. First produced by Robertson Technologies, the vehicle is meant to operate on its own deep behind enemy lines for extended periods of time. While excelling in this role, the Packrat suffered during the Succession Wars as, with the decline in knowledge brought about by the conflicts, many had their advanced fusion engines removed for use elsewhere. The technological renaissance brought about by the Helm Memory Core recovery also proved to be a turning point for the Packrat, as manufacturers in the Lyran Commonwealth were able to put fusion-powered Packrats back into production and help spread them across the Inner Sphere. Технологический ренессанс, вызванный восстановлением ядра памяти Хельма, также стал поворотным моментом для «Packrat», поскольку производители в Лиранском Содружестве смогли возобновить производство «Packrat» на термоядерных двигателях и способствовать их распространению по всей Внутренней Сфере. content.content: Первоначально разработанный в последний год Гражданской войны Амариса как лучший стационарный боевой мех для обороны города, «Аннигилятор» был построен в знак военной мощи Звёздной Лиги-в-изгнании. 1A был вооружён четырьмя Autocannon/10 и четырьмя средними лазерами. Хотя он был менее точным, чем оригинальный 2A, 1A всё ещё оставался крайне разрушительным и опасным мехом, которому ни один мехвоин не смел противостоять. Особенность: Прост в обслуживании Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.16 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: A 95-ton Mech, the Bullshark was recovered from the wreck of the Jump Ship Dobrev and schematics were later acquired by Majesty Metals which produced the Mech in limited quantities. The difficulty in sourcing parts and the hand built nature of each Bullshark would limit it to a mere 2 dozen examples, most of which served with the Magistracy Armed Forces. The unveiling of the Helm Core and subsequent Clan Invasion signaled the end of the Bullshark, with Majesty Metals reallocating resources to more profitable projects. The Bullshark M3 is a Juggernaut, built around a 190-rated Fusion Core and armed with paired AC/10s and AC/5s. Quad Medium Lasers and LRM-5s round out the design. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.content: 95-тонный мех Bullshark был извлечен из обломков прыжкового корабля Dobrev, а его чертежи позже были приобретены компанией Majesty Metals, которая произвела мех в ограниченном количестве. Сложность в поиске запчастей и ручная сборка каждого Bullshark ограничили его производство всего двумя десятками экземпляров, большинство из которых служили в вооруженных силах Магистрата. Обнаружение Хельмового ядра памяти и последующее вторжение Кланов ознаменовали конец Bullshark, и Majesty Metals перенаправили ресурсы на более прибыльные проекты. Bullshark M3 — это Juggernaut, построенный на базе двигателя с рейтингом 190 и вооруженный парой AC/10 и AC/5. Четыре средних лазера и LRM-5 дополняют конструкцию. Особенность: Устрашающий Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.15 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most famous BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower, and electronics. Originally a staple of the SLDF, Phoenix Hawks remained common within the armies of the Successor States after the fall of the Star League. At first Phoenix Hawks were grouped together to form powerful recon lances, but as they started reaching their various deployments, their full potential as command 'Mechs was discovered and many were reassigned to instead lead units of smaller recon 'Mechs.

content.content: Впервые представленный Терранской гегемонией в 2568 году, Phoenix Hawk был одним из самых известных боевых мехов во Внутренней Сфере. Этот мех появился, когда Orguss Industries поняли, что могут усилить шасси Stinger, чтобы породить более крупную версию, обладающую той же скоростью и маневренностью, что и Stinger, но с улучшенной броней, огневой мощью и электроникой. Изначально являясь основной рабочей лошадкой СОЗЛ, «Феникс Хоки» оставались распространенными в армиях государств-наследников после падения Звездной Лиги. Сначала «Феникс Хоки» были объединены в мощные разведывательные отряды, но по мере того, как они начали достигать своих различных мест развертывания, был обнаружен их полный потенциал в качестве командирских мехов, и многие из них были переведены на руководство подразделениями малых развед мехов.

content.original: The 4D was one of two variants designed by Hanse Davion; it was intended to compete with the heavier Warhammer. It replaced the autocannon/5s with PPCs and removed the medium lasers, using the freed-up weight to mount an five extra heat sinks. In spite of the extra heat sinks, this model suffered from significant overheat problems.

content.original: The Vulcan is lightly armored at only five tons, though this is typically sufficient when facing infantry forces and its narrow profile makes it a harder target to hit. A cruising speed of 64.8 km/h is enhanced with by six jump jets mounted in the rear of the Vulcan's torso, specially vented to reduce heat build-up in the rear, giving it a jumping range of 180 meters. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Apparently based on the ANH-1G, this variant only uses Clan technology. The 'Mech's top speed was 32.4 km/h and the armor protection was reduced, but four Gauss Rifles backed up by an ER PPC in the center torso and a head mounted ER Small Laser provided withering firepower for defensive engagements. Ten tons of ammunition kept the Gauss Rifles fed through the longest engagements. To make room for all these weapons, the C2 used an Endo Steel internal structure. Integrated CASE protected the arms and torsos from Gauss Rifle explosions. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Apollo is designed to be a long range fire support BattleMech. This is accomplished by mounting an engine on the 'Mech that gives it a top speed of only 64.8 km/h and eleven and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech was then armed with massive missile launchers which can rain destruction down on an enemy. While the Apollo has less than average speed for a medium 'Mech, if it is employed correctly the Apollo should have nothing to fear from enemy fire; it is fully capable of staying at the edge of the battlefield and laying down suppressive LRM fire. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.content: «Аполлон» разработан как дальнобойный боевой мех огневой поддержки. Это достигается установкой двигателя, дающего максимальную скорость всего 64,8 км/ч, и 11,5 тонн брони. Мех вооружён мощными ракетными установками, способными обрушить на противника разрушительный шквал. Хотя скорость «Аполлона» ниже обычной для среднего меха, при правильном использовании ему не страшен вражеский огонь; он вполне способен оставаться на краю поля боя и вести подавляющий огонь из LRM. Особенность: Прочный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

content.original: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Archer 5CS was a Comstar prototype rushed into production specifically to outfit units that would be fighting on Tukayyid. Designed to carry as much firepower as possible, a combination of a 280-rated XL Engine, Endo Steel chassis and DHS free up the tonnage need to mount 4 LRM-15’s with an Artemis IV FCS. A pair of Medium Lasers are retained should enemies close on the Archer. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: Built by the GKT Enterprise factory on Satalice for the Free Rasalhague Republic, the 5R was introduced in 3050 and bore similarities to the 2K model of the Archer. It carried a pair of FarFire LRM-15 launchers but mounted two Victory Nickel Alloy ER Large Lasers, one in either arm, in place of the medium lasers. It also linked Artemis IV fire control systems to the launchers and utilized twelve double heat sinks to improve waste heat dissipation. Despite being built around an Endo-Steel chassis, these improvements necessitated a decrease in armor protection by two tons. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: The 5S variant of the Archer, built out of Defiance Industries' massive Hesperus II complex in 3050, was the official variant for the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth. The 5S upgraded the engine to an Edasich Motors 280 XL Engine, cutting the engine's weight in half while retaining the same speed profile. The 5S also reduced the LRM-20 launchers to LRM-15s. This saved weight was used to add two Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launchers, one in each arm and fed by two tons of reloads in the side torsos. They also upgraded the four medium lasers to Medium Pulse Lasers. Finally, the 'Mech carried a Doering Electronics Glowworm Narc Missile Beacon launcher in its left torso along with one ton of ammo. This allowed the Archer to tag enemy units with a beacon so that friendly 'Mechs could more easily hit the unit with their own missile weapons. All of the ammunition carried by the 5S was protected by CASE. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: The 5W was an upgrade of the 2W variant, and was produced for the Wolf's Dragoons by Bowie Industries at Alarion. This was done in an orbital 'Mech repair facility which was converted into a 'Mech assembly line. Introduced in 3050, the 'Mech was upgraded with an XL Engine to save weight and used ten double heat sinks for greater heat dissipation. It retained the two LRM-20 launchers but replaced all other weaponry with one TharHes Blue SRM-4 launchers in each arm and a Doering Electronics Glowworm Narc Missile Beacon launcher in the center torso. The 5W was supplied with four tons of LRM reloads, two tons of SRM reloads, and two tons of Narc reloads, all carried in the CASE-protected side torsos. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: The -23 variant of the Assassin is an upgrade of the original model using Lostech; originally seen as a standardized field modification, in 3067 new production began at Hellespont 'Mech Works. The SRM-2 has been removed to upgrade the Medium Laser to a Medium Pulse Laser and an Artemis IV fire control system has been added for the LRM-5 launcher. Within the CCAF, TDF and MAF it is largely used as a cheap way to rebuild shattered forces and sees service mostly in green and reserve formations. The Capellans in particular use the -23 as a fire-support unit for pursuit and strike lances, though shortages of Artemis munitions means many are forced to use mine-delivery missiles. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.content: В наши дни «Ассасины» — редкий тип мехов, которые обладают хорошей огневой мощью и броней, а также отличаются высокой скоростью и дальностью прыжка. content.original: A 3050's tech version of the -30, the -26 also uses an endo steel chassis but mounts an XL engine, the extra weight saved allowing the 'Mech to carry an UAC/5 and a pair of medium pulse lasers for offensive armament. Field endurance is limited however, as six and half tons of armor provided basic protection, and a single ton of autocannon reloads are chewed through rapidly. The 10 double heat sinks struggle to manage heat strain. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: A 95-ton Mech, the Bullshark was recovered from the wreck of the Jump Ship Dobrev and schematics were later acquired by Majesty Metals which produced the Mech in limited quantities. The difficulty in sourcing parts and the hand built nature of each Bullshark would limit it to a mere 2 dozen examples, most of which served with the Magistracy Armed Forces. The unveiling of the Helm Core and subsequent Clan Invasion signaled the end of the Bullshark, with Majesty Metals reallocating resources to more profitable projects. The Bullshark M4 is a fire support design, built around a 285-rated Fusion Core and armed with a pair of Large Lasers and a pair of AC/5’s. An LRM-15 and a pair of Medium Lasers round out the design. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.content: 95-тонный мех Bullshark был извлечен из обломков прыжкового корабля Dobrev, а его чертежи позже были приобретены компанией Majesty Metals, которая произвела мех в ограниченном количестве. Сложность в поиске запчастей и ручная сборка каждого Bullshark ограничили его производство всего двумя десятками экземпляров, большинство из которых служили в вооруженных силах Магистрата. Обнаружение Хельмового ядра памяти и последующее вторжение Кланов ознаменовали конец Bullshark, и Majesty Metals перенаправили ресурсы на более прибыльные проекты. Bullshark M4 — это модель огневой поддержки, построенная на базе двигателя рейтинга 285 и вооруженная парой больших лазеров и парой AC/5. LRM-15 и пара средних лазеров дополняют конструкцию. Особенность: Устрашающий Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.15 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: A 95-ton Mech, the Bullshark was recovered from the wreck of the Jump Ship Dobrev and schematics were later acquired by Majesty Metals which produced the Mech in limited quantities. The difficulty in sourcing parts and the hand built nature of each Bullshark would limit it to a mere 2 dozen examples, most of which served with the Magistracy Armed Forces. The unveiling of the Helm Core and subsequent Clan Invasion signaled the end of the Bullshark, with Majesty Metals reallocating resources to more profitable projects. The Bullshark M6 is a fire support design, built around a 285-rated Fusion Core and armed with paired AC/5's and LRM-15's. 4 Medium Lasers round out the design.

content.original: The Exterminator is a BattleMech that was designed in 2630 for the most dubious, but necessary, of purposes: Headhunting. Advanced systems allowed it to easily infiltrate enemy lines. Once the Exterminator had breached the enemy's rear, its mission was to find and destroy as much of the enemy's command structure as possible. This mission profile included attacking Mobile Headquarters, field bases and command level officers. Rather than be part of the standard formation, Exterminators were attached to a regimental or higher headquarters unit, often as a fifth member of the command lance itself, before being assigned to individual units. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: Entering production in 2519 the FLE-14 Flea was an attempt to create an ultra-light BattleMech. Weighing a mere fifteen tons, it could arguably be regarded as a different 'Mech design than the true Flea. It was capable of a maximum ground speed of nearly 150 km/h with a 120 meter jump capability. Its weapons and armor however were very light: Only one ton of armor protected the unit, and the single Medium Laser mounted in the right arm was barely enough to make it a viable battlefield unit. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97

content.original: Built as part of the Wolf's Dragoons exclusive contract with Earthwerks Incorporated to replenish the Dragoon's losses at the end of the Fourth Succession War, alongside renewed production of original Fleas, the FLE-16 was the first new production model of the extremely rare 'Mech in centuries. The variant remedied the earlier FLE-14's weaknesses by combining incredible speed with additional armor and weaponry on a 20 ton chassis. The engine was upgraded to a GM 180 in order to reach a similar maximum ground speed of nearly 150 km/h. It mounts two Medium Lasers and an Flamer while retaining an armor profile like the earlier FLE-15. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Originally produced exclusively for the Dragoons until the Capellan Confederation acquired the design's blueprints via a Maskirovka raid during the 3040s, the post-Helm Memory Core FLE-17 variant is based on the older FLE-15 model. Since the Dragoons used the Flea in a recon role more than an antipersonnel 'Mech, Earthwerks conceived a new design by incorporating recovered technology. Retaining the design's maximum speed of 97.2 km/h, the addition of an Endo Steelchassis frees up weight for a MASC system that allows the 'Mech's speed to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The increase of speed is required to ensure survival on the modern battlefield, as the FLE-17 is only clad in a pitiful three tons of Livingston Ceramics armor plating. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: A favorite tool of planetary governments through out the Periphery, the Louse is designed for riot suppression. Capable of dispersing riots with lethal and non lethal options, it works well against civilians and lightly armed vehicles while posing no significant threat to actual battlemechs or military grade vehicles. Dual grenade launchers and a mixed laser package provide the bulk of the firepower, whilst a pair of flare launchers provides additional deterrent and can be used defensively in combat. Spall lined armor provides additional protection against infantry grade weapons and a set of sensors designed specifically for peering through cluttered urban environments round out the package. Often deployed as scouts and support forces; this mech is a common sight amongst the pirate bands who find themselves facing it across the battlefield. Not designed for battle, it is nonetheless pressed into service by desperate militias and governments that lack real battlemechs. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Phoenix Hawk 1bC was a Comstar refit built with damaged Phoenix Hawk 1b’s inherited from the 112th Royal Hussar regiment of the SLDF. Powered by a 270 XL Engine and possessing an Endo Steel chassis, the PHX-1bC is armed with an ER Large Laser and a pair of Medium Lasers. A Narc Beacon and 4 tons of ammo allow the Mech to spot for allied artillery and support assets, while a Flamer gives the Mech some anti-infantry capability. The 1b’s CASE and Guardian ECM are retained. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: A Blue Shot Weapons special, the Phoenix Hawk 1GS is a custom order variant based on the STR-3G Stinger. Popular among rookie pilots, the 1GS trades range and firepower for increased survivability and an easier heat curve. Built from salvaged PHX-1D’s, the 1GS strips out the XL Engine and extra DHS. The weapons are replaced with a Large Laser and a Small Laser in each arm, the additional range of the ER’s not being needed in the close quarter fighting of the Arena. Both the primary lasers are mounted in gunpods giving the variant its "Gunslinger" nickname. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The Phoenix Hawk 2L was one of the first new mechs to be produced under the Long Road initiative. A compete overhaul designed to be compatible with the myriad PXH-1 variants found throughout the Periphery, the redesign takes advantage of Lushan Industries production license for the new ER Large Laser. Mounting this in place of the original Large Laser, the weapons increased heat is balanced by the inclusion of 2 extra heat sinks; with an Endo steel chassis providing the necessary free weight. Retaining the medium lasers and the Guardian ECM suite, the 2L is a cheap upgrade for anyone fielding a PXH-1 design. Available for export throughout the Periphery, the only constraint to production is the lack of a production facility for the PXH chassis, though Alliance Mech Works has plans to build a dedicated PHX line should the design prove popular. Until then the current output is limited to in-situ conversions of existing mechs and the restoration of battlefield salvage. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

Available for export throughout the Periphery, the only constraint to production is the lack of a production facility for the PXH chassis, though Alliance Mech Works has plans to build a dedicated PHX line should the design prove popular. Until then the current output is limited to in-situ conversions of existing mechs and the restoration of battlefield salvage.

content.original: The 3D variant of this 'Mech was introduced in 3048, based on the 1D used by Davion forces. It was built out of New Avalon by Archenar BattleMechs as one of a slew of redesigns using recovered lostech. The 'Mech utilized Endo Steel construction techniques and a Extra-Light engine to free up weight and space for a number of improvements, particularly its weaponry. The 'Mech carried a pair of ER Large Lasers and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers split between both arms. With the machine guns and their ammunition removed, this allowed two additional heat sinks to be added, and all single heat sinks were exchanged for double strength models. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The 3K Phoenix Hawk was another upgrade of the design that used rediscovered technologies, built by Alshain Weapons and GKT Enterprises for House Kurita and the Free Rasalhague Republicrespectively. Introduced in 3050, the engine was upgraded to an XL model, with the saved weight used to upgrade the weapons payload on the 'Mech, taking its cues from the 1K variant. Like the PXH-3D model the 3K carries carries two ER large lasers and two medium Lasers. It also carried twelve double heat sinks to manage the additional waste heat, and the eight tons of standard armor were replaced with the same amount of New Samarkand Royal Ferro-Fibrous armor, improving its survivability. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The 3M variant of the 'Mech was also introduced in 3048, built by Earthwerks Incorporated from their Keystone factory and using upgrades based on rediscovered Star League technology. First, the internal structure of the 'Mech has been redesigned to utilize a 1A Type7 Endo Steel chassis. The engine was then replaced with a GM 270 XL and the heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks. This allowed the weapons payload to be changed extensively, with all of the original weapons being stripped from the chassis. In their place the 'Mech carried two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers as its primary weapons and two Martell Medium Pulse Lasers for close in work, with one of each mounted in either arm. Finally, a MainFire Point Defense Anti-Missile System replaced the right-arm machine gun, with two tons of both AMS and machine gun reloads carried in the CASE-protected left torso. The electronic systems were also replaced with an Achernar Electronics HID-8 comm system and Federated Hunter target-tracking system. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The 3S model of this 'Mech, first deployed in 3042, was another upgrade using rediscovered technology that attempted to make the Phoenix Hawk even more effective for reconnaissance. The engine was upgraded to an ExtraLight version and ten double heat sinks improved heat management. The overall armor protection was increased by one ton and replaced with Lexington Ltd. High Grade Ferro-Fibrous armor. The primary weapon on the 'Mech was a Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Laser built into the right arm, though it still retained the two medium lasers and machine guns of the original. Additionally an anti-missile system was mounted on the right arm, with its two tons of ammo (along with two tons of machine gun ammo) protected by CASE in the left torso. Its primary difference from other variants introduced during the time period was the addition of a MASC system, which allowed the 'Mech to reach speeds of up to 129.6 in short bursts. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Rifleman 5CS was a Comstar refit designed with the aim of extending the Rifleman’s battlefield endurance. Replacing the original 240-rated Fusion Core with a larger 300-rated XL Engine increased the Mechs speed and allowed for the installation of additional armor. DHS replaced the original SHS, reducing the chronic overheating issues that plagued the Rifleman, while the AC/5’s were upgraded to a pair of UAC/5’s with 2 tons of ammo. The pair of Large Lasers remain, but the 2 Medium Lasers were removed to make space for the UAC ammo. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: A recovered-technology version of the RFL-4D, the 5D was introduced in 3050 for the Federated Commonwealth. Based on the earlier 4D, it replaces the PPCs with ER PPC models and restores the original model's medium lasers to the side torsos. A 240-rated XL engine was used to free up weight for the mounting of seventeen double heat sinks and an increase in armor protection to nine tons. Production of this model was taken up by Kallon Industries on Talon, Trellshire Industires on Twycross and Red Devil Industries on Pandora. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The 5M is another product of the Gray Death Memory Core technology boon, built by Kallon Industries at Thermopolis for the Free Worlds League. Introduced in 3049, it retained the same energy weapons as the original 3N but replaced the standard autocannons with Imperator Ultra models; though the ammunition load remained a single ton, it was moved to the right torso and protected by CASE. Twelve double heat sinks were mounted and another ton of Kallon Royalstar armor was carried. The free weight for all these changes was created by the use of an Hermes 240 XL Engine. One thing which wasn't replaced however were the Garret comms and targeting systems. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The so-called Stag II incorporated a prototype version of the ER PPC that was roughly comparable to the Clan version of the weapon, though it was slightly less destructive. This upgrade of the large laser necessitated removal of the MASC, though the top speed was upgraded to 119 km/h. Additionally, Ferro-Fibrous weave was incorporated into the armor, though at an overall decrease in protection. The SRMs were removed in favor of an additional Medium Laser, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and two Small Lasers. This gave the 'Mech greater battlefield longevity, though the potential for excessive heat buildup was much greater. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Stag was built on an Endo Steel frame and powered by an XL Engine. Ten tons of armor provided the 'Mech with the maximum possible protection. The long-range threat from the cavalry 'Mech comes from one ER Large Laser. At close range it is supplemented by paired Medium Lasers and SRM-4s. Two, CASE-protected tons of ammunition gives MechWarriors the flexibility to use different types of munitions, making the Stag a threat to a variety of units. Twelve double heat sinks handles all of the heat generated by the weapons. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Stealth is a heavy scout 'Mech that is in use by the Federated Suns and the Lyran Alliance. The 'Mech has a GM 315 XL Engine that allows the Stealth to move at speeds of 118.8 km/h and the MASC system on board can push the 'Mech to 151.2 km/h in short bursts. This amazing mobility is augmented by jump jets which the Stealth can use to jump up to two hundred and ten meters. The Stealth is also outfitted with a Cyclops-Beagle Sensory Active Probe that the Stealth can use to find hidden enemy units. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

Мех имеет двигатель GM 315 XL, который позволяет Stealth двигаться со скоростью 118,8 км/ч, а бортовая система MASC может разгонять мех на короткое время до 151,2 км/ч. Такая удивительная мобильность дополняется прыжковыми двигателями, с помощью которых Stealth может прыгать на высоту до двухсот десяти метров. Stealth также оснащен сенсорным активным зондом Cyclops-Beagle, который можно использовать для поиска скрытых вражеских целей. Особенность: Улучшенные сенсоры Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.03

content.original: When the Star League Defense Force left the Inner Sphere under Commanding General Aleksandr Kerensky during Operation Exodus, they brought with them many of the most common 'Mechs. As the SLDF-in-exile slowly started turning into the Clans, they started developing improved weapons, which they mounted on their existing armies of 'Mech. These weapons are commonly called Clan Early, and as such the Mech's using them got the -CE suffix added to their designation.

content.original: The 5M Vulcan is an upgrade of the 2T version used by House Marik that makes the 'Mech far more effective in close range combat. The 'Mech uses a Crucis-II Delux Endo Steel chassis and removes the autocannon for a Tronel PPL-20 Large Pulse Laser and also upgrades the Medium Laser to a Tronel XII Medium Pulse Laser. Eleven double heat sinks were also incorporated. This version of the Vulcan began production in 3052 and ceased only with the destruction of Nimakachi's Tematagi plant in 3069. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: A 95-ton Mech, the Bullshark was recovered from the wreck of the Jump Ship Dobrev and schematics were later acquired by Majesty Metals which produced the Mech in limited quantities. The difficulty in sourcing parts and the hand built nature of each Bullshark would limit it to a mere 2 dozen examples, most of which served with the Magistracy Armed Forces. The unveiling of the Helm Core and subsequent Clan Invasion signaled the end of the Bullshark, with Majesty Metals reallocating resources to more profitable projects. The Bullshark M3 is a Juggernaut, built around a 190-rated Fusion Core and armed with paired AC/10s and AC/5s. Quad Medium Lasers and LRM-5s round out the design. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most well known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower and electronics. Though not without its own drawbacks, the Phoenix Hawk quickly became the standard by which all other reconnaissance 'Mechs were measured. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01

content.original: The Apollo is designed to be a long range fire support BattleMech. This is accomplished by mounting an engine on the 'Mech that gives it a top speed of only 64.8 km/h and eleven and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech was then armed with massive missile launchers which can rain destruction down on an enemy. While the Apollo has less than average speed for a medium 'Mech, if it is employed correctly the Apollo should have nothing to fear from enemy fire; it is fully capable of staying at the edge of the battlefield and laying down suppressive LRM fire. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

Мех вооружён мощными ракетными установками, способными обрушить на противника разрушительный шквал. Хотя скорость «Аполлона» ниже обычной для среднего меха, при правильном использовании ему не страшен вражеский огонь; он вполне способен оставаться на краю поля боя и вести подавляющий огонь из LRM. Особенность: Прочный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

It carried a pair of FarFire LRM-15 launchers but mounted two Victory Nickel Alloy ER Large Lasers, one in either arm, in place of the medium lasers. It also linked Artemis IV fire control systems to the launchers and utilized twelve double heat sinks to improve waste heat dissipation. Despite being built around an Endo-Steel chassis, these improvements necessitated a decrease in armor protection by two tons. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: The 5S variant of the Archer, built out of Defiance Industries' massive Hesperus II complex in 3050, was the official variant for the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth. The 5S upgraded the engine to an Edasich Motors 280 XL Engine, cutting the engine's weight in half while retaining the same speed profile. The 5S also reduced the LRM-20 launchers to LRM-15s. This saved weight was used to add two Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launchers, one in each arm and fed by two tons of reloads in the side torsos. They also upgraded the four medium lasers to Medium Pulse Lasers. Finally, the 'Mech carried a Doering Electronics Glowworm Narc Missile Beacon launcher in its left torso along with one ton of ammo. This allowed the Archer to tag enemy units with a beacon so that friendly 'Mechs could more easily hit the unit with their own missile weapons. All of the ammunition carried by the 5S was protected by CASE. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: The 5W was an upgrade of the 2W variant, and was produced for the Wolf's Dragoons by Bowie Industries at Alarion. This was done in an orbital 'Mech repair facility which was converted into a 'Mech assembly line. Introduced in 3050, the 'Mech was upgraded with an XL Engine to save weight and used ten double heat sinks for greater heat dissipation. It retained the two LRM-20 launchers but replaced all other weaponry with one TharHes Blue SRM-4 launchers in each arm and a Doering Electronics Glowworm Narc Missile Beacon launcher in the center torso. The 5W was supplied with four tons of LRM reloads, two tons of SRM reloads, and two tons of Narc reloads, all carried in the CASE-protected side torsos. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: A 95-ton Mech, the Bullshark was recovered from the wreck of the Jump Ship Dobrev and schematics were later acquired by Majesty Metals which produced the Mech in limited quantities. The difficulty in sourcing parts and the hand built nature of each Bullshark would limit it to a mere 2 dozen examples, most of which served with the Magistracy Armed Forces. The unveiling of the Helm Core and subsequent Clan Invasion signaled the end of the Bullshark, with Majesty Metals reallocating resources to more profitable projects. The Bullshark M4 is a fire support design, built around a 285-rated Fusion Core and armed with a pair of Large Lasers and a pair of AC/5’s. An LRM-15 and a pair of Medium Lasers round out the design. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.content: 95-тонный мех Bullshark был извлечен из обломков прыжкового корабля Dobrev, а его чертежи позже были приобретены компанией Majesty Metals, которая произвела мех в ограниченном количестве. Сложность в поиске запчастей и ручная сборка каждого Bullshark ограничили его производство всего двумя десятками экземпляров, большинство из которых служили в вооруженных силах Магистрата. Обнаружение Хельмового ядра памяти и последующее вторжение Кланов ознаменовали конец Bullshark, и Majesty Metals перенаправили ресурсы на более прибыльные проекты. Bullshark M4 — это модель огневой поддержки, построенная на базе двигателя рейтинга 285 и вооруженная парой больших лазеров и парой AC/5. LRM-15 и пара средних лазеров дополняют конструкцию. Особенность: Устрашающий Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.15 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Exterminator is a BattleMech that was designed in 2630 for the most dubious, but necessary, of purposes: Headhunting. Advanced systems allowed it to easily infiltrate enemy lines. Once the Exterminator had breached the enemy's rear, its mission was to find and destroy as much of the enemy's command structure as possible. This mission profile included attacking Mobile Headquarters, field bases and command level officers. Rather than be part of the standard formation, Exterminators were attached to a regimental or higher headquarters unit, often as a fifth member of the command lance itself, before being assigned to individual units. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

Weighing a mere fifteen tons, it could arguably be regarded as a different 'Mech design than the true Flea. It was capable of a maximum ground speed of nearly 150 km/h with a 120 meter jump capability. Its weapons and armor however were very light: Only one ton of armor protected the unit, and the single Medium Laser mounted in the right arm was barely enough to make it a viable battlefield unit. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97

content.original: Originally produced exclusively for the Dragoons until the Capellan Confederation acquired the design's blueprints via a Maskirovka raid during the 3040s, the post-Helm Memory Core FLE-17 variant is based on the older FLE-15 model. Since the Dragoons used the Flea in a recon role more than an antipersonnel 'Mech, Earthwerks conceived a new design by incorporating recovered technology. Retaining the design's maximum speed of 97.2 km/h, the addition of an Endo Steelchassis frees up weight for a MASC system that allows the 'Mech's speed to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The increase of speed is required to ensure survival on the modern battlefield, as the FLE-17 is only clad in a pitiful three tons of Livingston Ceramics armor plating. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.content: Originally produced exclusively for the Dragoons until the Capellan Confederation acquired the design's blueprints via a Maskirovka raid during the 3040s, the post-Helm Memory Core FLE-17 variant is based on the older FLE-15 model. Since the Dragoons used the Flea in a recon role more than an antipersonnel 'Mech, Earthwerks conceived a new design by incorporating recovered technology. Retaining the design's maximum speed of 97.2 km/h, the addition of an Endo Steelchassis frees up weight for a MASC system that allows the 'Mech's speed to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The increase of speed is required to ensure survival on the modern battlefield, as the FLE-17 is only clad in a pitiful three tons of Livingston Ceramics armor plating. content.original: A favorite tool of planetary governments through out the Periphery, the Louse is designed for riot suppression. Capable of dispersing riots with lethal and non lethal options, it works well against civilians and lightly armed vehicles while posing no significant threat to actual battlemechs or military grade vehicles. Dual grenade launchers and a mixed laser package provide the bulk of the firepower, whilst a pair of flare launchers provides additional deterrent and can be used defensively in combat. Spall lined armor provides additional protection against infantry grade weapons and a set of sensors designed specifically for peering through cluttered urban environments round out the package. Often deployed as scouts and support forces; this mech is a common sight amongst the pirate bands who find themselves facing it across the battlefield. Not designed for battle, it is nonetheless pressed into service by desperate militias and governments that lack real battlemechs. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: A Blue Shot Weapons special, the Phoenix Hawk 1GS is a custom order variant based on the STR-3G Stinger. Popular among rookie pilots, the 1GS trades range and firepower for increased survivability and an easier heat curve. Built from salvaged PHX-1D’s, the 1GS strips out the XL Engine and extra DHS. The weapons are replaced with a Large Laser and a Small Laser in each arm, the additional range of the ER’s not being needed in the close quarter fighting of the Arena. Both the primary lasers are mounted in gunpods giving the variant its "Gunslinger" nickname. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The Phoenix Hawk 2L was one of the first new mechs to be produced under the Long Road initiative. A compete overhaul designed to be compatible with the myriad PXH-1 variants found throughout the Periphery, the redesign takes advantage of Lushan Industries production license for the new ER Large Laser. Mounting this in place of the original Large Laser, the weapons increased heat is balanced by the inclusion of 2 extra heat sinks; with an Endo steel chassis providing the necessary free weight. Retaining the medium lasers and the Guardian ECM suite, the 2L is a cheap upgrade for anyone fielding a PXH-1 design. Available for export throughout the Periphery, the only constraint to production is the lack of a production facility for the PXH chassis, though Alliance Mech Works has plans to build a dedicated PHX line should the design prove popular. Until then the current output is limited to in-situ conversions of existing mechs and the restoration of battlefield salvage. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The 3D variant of this 'Mech was introduced in 3048, based on the 1D used by Davion forces. It was built out of New Avalon by Archenar BattleMechs as one of a slew of redesigns using recovered lostech. The 'Mech utilized Endo Steel construction techniques and a Extra-Light engine to free up weight and space for a number of improvements, particularly its weaponry. The 'Mech carried a pair of ER Large Lasers and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers split between both arms. With the machine guns and their ammunition removed, this allowed two additional heat sinks to be added, and all single heat sinks were exchanged for double strength models. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

Introduced in 3050, the engine was upgraded to an XL model, with the saved weight used to upgrade the weapons payload on the 'Mech, taking its cues from the 1K variant. Like the PXH-3D model the 3K carries carries two ER large lasers and two medium Lasers. It also carried twelve double heat sinks to manage the additional waste heat, and the eight tons of standard armor were replaced with the same amount of New Samarkand Royal Ferro-Fibrous armor, improving its survivability. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The 3M variant of the 'Mech was also introduced in 3048, built by Earthwerks Incorporated from their Keystone factory and using upgrades based on rediscovered Star League technology. First, the internal structure of the 'Mech has been redesigned to utilize a 1A Type7 Endo Steel chassis. The engine was then replaced with a GM 270 XL and the heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks. This allowed the weapons payload to be changed extensively, with all of the original weapons being stripped from the chassis. In their place the 'Mech carried two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers as its primary weapons and two Martell Medium Pulse Lasers for close in work, with one of each mounted in either arm. Finally, a MainFire Point Defense Anti-Missile System replaced the right-arm machine gun, with two tons of both AMS and machine gun reloads carried in the CASE-protected left torso. The electronic systems were also replaced with an Achernar Electronics HID-8 comm system and Federated Hunter target-tracking system. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The 3S model of this 'Mech, first deployed in 3042, was another upgrade using rediscovered technology that attempted to make the Phoenix Hawk even more effective for reconnaissance. The engine was upgraded to an ExtraLight version and ten double heat sinks improved heat management. The overall armor protection was increased by one ton and replaced with Lexington Ltd. High Grade Ferro-Fibrous armor. The primary weapon on the 'Mech was a Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Laser built into the right arm, though it still retained the two medium lasers and machine guns of the original. Additionally an anti-missile system was mounted on the right arm, with its two tons of ammo (along with two tons of machine gun ammo) protected by CASE in the left torso. Its primary difference from other variants introduced during the time period was the addition of a MASC system, which allowed the 'Mech to reach speeds of up to 129.6 in short bursts. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

It was protected by eleven and a half tons of Primitive Armor and used a Primitive Engine to reach a top speed of 64 km/h. Though it served in the Reunification War, this version of the Rifleman was usually used by militia and second line forces thereafter. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.82 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Rifleman 5CS was a Comstar refit designed with the aim of extending the Rifleman’s battlefield endurance. Replacing the original 240-rated Fusion Core with a larger 300-rated XL Engine increased the Mechs speed and allowed for the installation of additional armor. DHS replaced the original SHS, reducing the chronic overheating issues that plagued the Rifleman, while the AC/5’s were upgraded to a pair of UAC/5’s with 2 tons of ammo. The pair of Large Lasers remain, but the 2 Medium Lasers were removed to make space for the UAC ammo. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

Based on the earlier 4D, it replaces the PPCs with ER PPC models and restores the original model's medium lasers to the side torsos. A 240-rated XL engine was used to free up weight for the mounting of seventeen double heat sinks and an increase in armor protection to nine tons. Production of this model was taken up by Kallon Industries on Talon, Trellshire Industires on Twycross and Red Devil Industries on Pandora. content.original: The 5M is another product of the Gray Death Memory Core technology boon, built by Kallon Industries at Thermopolis for the Free Worlds League. Introduced in 3049, it retained the same energy weapons as the original 3N but replaced the standard autocannons with Imperator Ultra models; though the ammunition load remained a single ton, it was moved to the right torso and protected by CASE. Twelve double heat sinks were mounted and another ton of Kallon Royalstar armor was carried. The free weight for all these changes was created by the use of an Hermes 240 XL Engine. One thing which wasn't replaced however were the Garret comms and targeting systems. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The so-called Stag II incorporated a prototype version of the ER PPC that was roughly comparable to the Clan version of the weapon, though it was slightly less destructive. This upgrade of the large laser necessitated removal of the MASC, though the top speed was upgraded to 119 km/h. Additionally, Ferro-Fibrous weave was incorporated into the armor, though at an overall decrease in protection. The SRMs were removed in favor of an additional Medium Laser, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and two Small Lasers. This gave the 'Mech greater battlefield longevity, though the potential for excessive heat buildup was much greater. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

The long-range threat from the cavalry 'Mech comes from one ER Large Laser. At close range it is supplemented by paired Medium Lasers and SRM-4s. Two, CASE-protected tons of ammunition gives MechWarriors the flexibility to use different types of munitions, making the Stag a threat to a variety of units. Twelve double heat sinks handles all of the heat generated by the weapons. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Stealth is a heavy scout 'Mech that is in use by the Federated Suns and the Lyran Alliance. The 'Mech has a GM 315 XL Engine that allows the Stealth to move at speeds of 118.8 km/h and the MASC system on board can push the 'Mech to 151.2 km/h in short bursts. This amazing mobility is augmented by jump jets which the Stealth can use to jump up to two hundred and ten meters. The Stealth is also outfitted with a Cyclops-Beagle Sensory Active Probe that the Stealth can use to find hidden enemy units. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

The 'Mech uses a Crucis-II Delux Endo Steel chassis and removes the autocannon for a Tronel PPL-20 Large Pulse Laser and also upgrades the Medium Laser to a Tronel XII Medium Pulse Laser. Eleven double heat sinks were also incorporated. This version of the Vulcan began production in 3052 and ceased only with the destruction of Nimakachi's Tematagi plant in 3069. Intended to aid in exploration work, they have surprised many opponents in combat or a circle of equals, helping to contribute to the Seeker's many victories. content.original: Piloted by Baron Oliver Kincaid who once served with the prestigious Free World Guards before being dishonorably discharged. After that he spent some time as a mercenary serving with Nik's Cavaliers which is when he gave his Archer the name 'Agincourt'. When he was asked to explain why he chose that name he replied that it was named to remind him of how powerful the turns of fate can be, and to work hard to earn back what he once had.

content.original: Supposedly the custom Assassin that Dale Sandstrom piloted, this DarkDeath is built around a 280-rated XL engine on endo steel chassis, and is armed with an AC/2 in the right arm, twin LRM-5s in right torso, and a pair of medium lasers split between head and left torso. Retaining the ASN-21's seven jump jets, that variant's single heat sinks are also upgraded to double strength versions. Though carrying only a single ton of autocannon and LRM reloads limits it field endurance, DarkDeath mounts a Guardian ECM suite to help ensure the fight is on its terms. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original:
The personally built 'Mech of Cranston Snord's Irregulars member 'Shorty' Sneede, his Rifleman is a FrankenMech featuring a Phoenix Hawk head, Warhammer right arm and the left torso and arm from an Archer, with only the center and right torsos and both legs left from the parent design. Built around the 3N's standard 240-rated engine, much of the weapons and ammunition from the donor 'Mechs was retained, Sneede's custom being armed with a right-arm mounted PPC, left-torso mounted LRM-20 with two tons of ammo, and three Medium Lasers - one fitted to the right torso and two to the left arm. Carrying a total of fourteen single heat sinks, Sneede's patchwork Rifleman is clad in nine tons of armor. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

Built around the 3N's standard 240-rated engine, much of the weapons and ammunition from the donor 'Mechs was retained, Sneede's custom being armed with a right-arm mounted PPC, left-torso mounted LRM-20 with two tons of ammo, and three Medium Lasers - one fitted to the right torso and two to the left arm. Carrying a total of fourteen single heat sinks, Sneede's patchwork Rifleman is clad in nine tons of armor. Особенность: Противовоздушное наведение Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.07

Like all the current variants of the Canon versions, the Bloodlust is jump capable, however, has Standard Heat Sink capability. content.original: The Wolfman was first created by Valdis Ullman, a MechWarrior belonging to the Legion of Vega, on Bergman's Planet during the Second Battle of Ryersson in 2986. Originally piloting a Wolverine, his BattleMech was damaged in a fight with a Davion Marauder, with most of its upper body damaged or destroyed. Fortunately, a Davion Rifleman had been destroyed only a hundred meters away from his 'Mech. The Rifleman had suffered damage to its torso and legs. Ullman's personal technician, Sharis Brand thought that the two 'Mechs could be merged together, taking the intact legs and hips from Ullman's Wolverine and combining it with the torso and arms from the Rifleman. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

A pair of Enhanced LRM-20 Artemis launchers are backed up by a handheld "Avenger Rifle", which is some kind of hand-held RAC/5 comparable to the best RISC technology. Maybe it would be more appropriate to call that thing the primary weapon, as it carries more than twice as much ammo as the meager three tons of missiles. This is all wrapped in a thick shell of top-of-the-line mimetic stealth armor. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

content.original: Supposedly the custom Assassin that Dale Sandstrom piloted, this DarkDeath is built around a 280-rated XL engine on endo steel chassis, and is armed with an AC/2 in the right arm, twin LRM-5s in right torso, and a pair of medium lasers split between head and left torso. Retaining the ASN-21's seven jump jets, that variant's single heat sinks are also upgraded to double strength versions. Though carrying only a single ton of autocannon and LRM reloads limits it field endurance, DarkDeath mounts a Guardian ECM suite to help ensure the fight is on its terms. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

The personally built 'Mech of Cranston Snord's Irregulars member 'Shorty' Sneede, his Rifleman is a FrankenMech featuring a Phoenix Hawk head, Warhammer right arm and the left torso and arm from an Archer, with only the center and right torsos and both legs left from the parent design. Built around the 3N's standard 240-rated engine, much of the weapons and ammunition from the donor 'Mechs was retained, Sneede's custom being armed with a right-arm mounted PPC, left-torso mounted LRM-20 with two tons of ammo, and three Medium Lasers - one fitted to the right torso and two to the left arm. content.original: The Wolfman was first created by Valdis Ullman, a MechWarrior belonging to the Legion of Vega, on Bergman's Planet during the Second Battle of Ryersson in 2986. Originally piloting a Wolverine, his BattleMech was damaged in a fight with a Davion Marauder, with most of its upper body damaged or destroyed. Fortunately, a Davion Rifleman had been destroyed only a hundred meters away from his 'Mech. The Rifleman had suffered damage to its torso and legs. Ullman's personal technician, Sharis Brand thought that the two 'Mechs could be merged together, taking the intact legs and hips from Ullman's Wolverine and combining it with the torso and arms from the Rifleman. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Technicals are improvised combat vehicles. Generally a logistics truck or civilian vehicle outfitted with the heaviest armaments available. The origin of the term is lost to history, however references can be found in material dating back to pre Star League Terra. Technicals are popular with irregular forces due to their low cost and flexibility. They tend to be relatively fragile, but when used as skirmishers or light fire support, they can be remarkably effective. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: Vehicle Stealth Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 70 10 Left 40 10 Right 40 10 Rear 40 10 Turret 40 10 Total 230 50 Quirk: Technical

content.content: «Технички» — импровизированные боевые машины. Обычно это логистический грузовик или гражданский автомобиль, под завязку заправленный оружием. Происхождение термина утеряно историей, однако упоминания о нём встречаются в материалах, относящихся к периоду до Звёздной Лиги на Терре. «Технички» популярны среди нерегулярных формирований благодаря своей низкой стоимости и гибкости. Они, как правило, относительно хрупкие, однако при использовании в качестве стрелков или лёгкой огневой поддержки могут быть чрезвычайно эффективны. Ограничения биома: этот юнит не может действовать в лунном или марсианском биомах из-за использования ДВС. Передвижение: 5/8 гексов / 150/240 метров. Броня: Vehicle Stealth Броня Структура: Структура Знач-я Б С Перед 70 10 Лево 40 10 Право 40 10 Зад 40 10 Турель 40 10 Итого 230 50 Особенность: Technical

content.original: A Succession Wars era downgrade of the original EXT-4D model, the Exterminator 4A model was created in 3007 by Kallon Industries as a potential replacement for their Wolverine line. While packing nearly the same weapons array as the original 4D, engineers were forced to substitute the AMS for a conventional Machine Gun and downgrade the engine to a smaller 325-rated model. Lacking the advanced stealth systems and high speed of its progenitor model, the design was considered a failure and only 25 models were constructed. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

content.original: A Succession Wars era downgrade of the original EXT-4D model, the Exterminator 4A model was created in 3007 by Kallon Industries as a potential replacement for their Wolverine line. While packing nearly the same weapons array as the original 4D, engineers were forced to substitute the AMS for a conventional Machine Gun and downgrade the engine to a smaller 325-rated model. Lacking the advanced stealth systems and high speed of its progenitor model, the design was considered a failure and only 25 models were constructed. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

content.original: A unique Exterminator variant refitted as specifically as a dueling Mech, the EXT-4DX was piloted by Lieutenant Caine Barclay of the SLDF's Forty-First Assault Battalion. Designed for close range combat, the 4DX mounts 6 Medium Pulse Lasers and a headmounted AMS. To fit the battery of Lasers, engineers replaced the 390-rated XL Engine with a smaller 325-rated model. Offsetting the slower speed is a Supercharger paired with MASC; allowing the 4DX to theoretically outrun a Locust. Laser Insulators are attached to each MPL, reducing the heat load to managable levels. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13

content.original: The Black Knight was designed both as a front-line combatant and as a command BattleMech at the company and battalion level for the Star League Defense Force. Its advanced communications gear allowed the Black Knight to effortlessly coordinate an entire company of 'Mechs simultaneously, and could easily link together the command frequencies of an entire parent regiment and connect with orbital support satellites. Advanced building materials gave the Black Knight a light but strong chassis able to carry more weapons and armor for less weight. Given the type and amount of firepower the 'Mech carries the only issue facing the Black Knight is heat management.

content.content: «Чёрный рыцарь» был разработан как боевая машина первой линии, так и как командный боевой мех на уровне роты и батальона для Сил обороны Звездной Лиги. Его передовое коммуникационное оборудование позволяло Black Knight без труда координировать действия целой роты мехов одновременно, а также легко соединять командные частоты всего родительского полка и связываться с орбитальными спутниками поддержки. Современные строительные материалы обеспечили Black Knight легким, но прочным шасси, способным нести больше оружия и брони при меньшем весе. Учитывая тип и количество огневой мощи, которую несет мех, единственной проблемой Black Knight является управление тепловыделением.

Advanced building materials gave the Black Knight a light but strong chassis able to carry more weapons and armor for less weight. Given the type and amount of firepower the 'Mech carries the only issue facing the Black Knight is heat management.
content.content: «Чёрный рыцарь» был разработан как боевая машина первой линии, так и как командный боевой мех на уровне роты и батальона для Сил обороны Звездной Лиги. Его передовое коммуникационное оборудование позволяло Black Knight без труда координировать действия целой роты мехов одновременно, а также легко соединять командные частоты всего родительского полка и связываться с орбитальными спутниками поддержки. Современные строительные материалы обеспечили Black Knight легким, но прочным шасси, способным нести больше оружия и брони при меньшем весе. Учитывая тип и количество огневой мощи, которую несет мех, единственной проблемой Black Knight является управление тепловыделением.

content.original: The Black Lanner's F2 loadout is currently only used with the Jade Falcon Clan. It is a general-purpose design, intended to take on recon patrols and disrupt supply lines on an intermittent basis. The choice of weapons suggests a need to minimize the burden on the Jade Falcon support and technical training pipelines. Unfortunately, while it is capable of many routine assignments, the F2 will do none of them well. It is presumed the Jade Falcons will exercise caution, fielding this configuration only when they are sure there are no massed formations of Battlemechs in the target area. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: Newly developed by Clan Jade Falcon for the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere, the Black Lanner is a fast medium OmniMech that can take on a variety of roles. Intended as a front-line 'Mech, the Black Lanner makes use of all weight-saving technology available to the Clan Jade Falcon scientists who designed it, including an XL engine, endo steel, and eight tons of ferro-fibrous armor. The Black Lanner also includes a MASC system on the base chassis that enables it to run up to 151 km/h in bursts, allowing it to outrun many 'Mechs half its size. The design sacrifices pod space for that speed however, with an engine almost half the Black Lanner's weight leaving a mere 13 tons for offensive weaponry.

content.original: The ability to close quickly on large, slow-moving Assault 'Mechs, combined with the potential to kill such foes with a single headshot, makes it abundantly clear the Black Lanner G2 configuration is intended for brutal sledgehammer operations. Deployed in pure Stars, the G2 can quickly gain the upper hand and go on to dominate the battlefield, moving about at will. Jade Falcon Commanders who make proper use of this threat can force an opponent into defensive strategies which will ultimately lead to defeat. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The Crusader was initially designed as a close combat BattleMech for the Star League Defense Force, but soon proved itself to be a very adaptable, multirole design. This reliable workhorse of the SLDF, while not excelling in any one job, was quite capable of accomplishing just about any mission, whether it be close assault, anti-aircraft, counterinsurgency, or even reconnaissance. Its versatility and large number of manufacturers ensured the Crusader its place as one of the most common heavy 'Mechs in the Inner Sphere.
