content.original: The Dire Wolf F3 configuration is presently used mostly with front line regiments and a few reserves. Most other Clans are restricting their 'rookie-resistant' designs to reserve units only. However, Clan Diamond Shark seems determined to correct their past conservative strategy by swinging wildly in the opposite direction, dropping the new design right on the front lines. Some rumours claim this is due to the clan lacking the resources to conduct a full field test of the Dire Wolf F2 before committing it to combat. Only time will tell. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. The 1M sports an ER large laser and an ER small laser, along with an anti-missile system. Five jump jets allow it to maintain decent mobility, but its overland speed is lacking compared to similarly weighted BattleMechs. content.original: Named for the demonic wolf of Germanic myth, the Fenrir was less a traditional battle suit and more a mobile fire support platform. The trooper controlling the suit was situated inside a cramped "cockpit" and piloted the Fenrir like a small walking tank. The single, configurable turret mounted on the suit could accept a wide variety of weapon configurations and the Fenrir's sturdy, powerful legs could propel it to much greater speeds than the Sloth. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only mount internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Названный в честь демонического волка из германских мифов, «Фенрир» представлял собой скорее мобильную платформу огневой поддержки, чем традиционный боевой костюм. Управляющий костюмом боец ​​располагался в тесной «кабине» и пилотировал «Фенрир», словно небольшой шагающий танк. Единственная настраиваемая турель, установленная на костюме, могла нести широкий спектр вооружения, а крепкие и мощные ноги «Фенрира» позволяли ему развивать гораздо большую скорость, чем было у Sloth. Особенность: Бронированный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.content: Названный в честь демонического волка из германских мифов, «Фенрир» представлял собой скорее мобильную платформу огневой поддержки, чем традиционный боевой костюм. Управляющий костюмом боец ​​располагался в тесной «кабине» и пилотировал «Фенрир», словно небольшой шагающий танк. Единственная настраиваемая турель, установленная на костюме, могла нести широкий спектр вооружения, а крепкие и мощные ноги «Фенрира» позволяли ему развивать гораздо большую скорость, чем было у Sloth.

The Gargoyle is therefore commonly seen among Clan Wolf, and was a featured assault OmniMech during the Clan Invasion. The Gargoyle earned the code name Man O' War from the Inner Sphere forces because of its effectiveness. This dependable design eventually spread throughout the Clans, and can be seen with any of their Galaxies now.

content.original: Conceived as a long-range infantry support Mech, the ill-fated Jackrabbit entered prototyping mere weeks before the Amaris Coup. Mass produced without regard for its design flaws, the 25 ton Jackrabbit suffered from anaemic firepower and poor armor; resulting in a bad reputation and the eventual extinction of the design. Powered by a 150-rated Fusion Engine, the Jackrabbit carries 3.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor and has a top speed of 97 km/h. An endosteel skeleton allows the Jackrabbit JKR-8T to carry an AC/2 and a Streak SRM-2, both with a single ton of ammo. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

Like other IIC designs, visual similarities between it and its predecessor initially led ComStar to incorrectly label the design as a mere refit of the original.

content.original: The 5D Marauder was the first updated variant to be designed in the wake of the Helm Memory Core recovery. A direct upgrade of the 3D model, the 5D's engine was replaced with a 300 XL engine, retaining the same speed profile at a much-reduced weight, to allow the entire weapons payload to be stripped out and upgraded. The 5D's primary weapons were two ER PPCs, carried in either arm, supported by a Large Pulse Laser in place of the autocannon. The medium lasers were replaced with two Medium Pulse Lasers, while a Streak SRM-2 launcher was also added to the left torso, along with one ton of CASE-protected ammo, for more close-range firepower. The model was protected by fourteen tons of armor, and carried sixteen double heat sinks for heat management. It also had a jumping capability of up to 120 meters thanks to four jump jets mounted in its legs. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

A direct upgrade of the 3D model, the 5D's engine was replaced with a 300 XL engine, retaining the same speed profile at a much-reduced weight, to allow the entire weapons payload to be stripped out and upgraded. The 5D's primary weapons were two ER PPCs, carried in either arm, supported by a Large Pulse Laser in place of the autocannon. The medium lasers were replaced with two Medium Pulse Lasers, while a Streak SRM-2 launcher was also added to the left torso, along with one ton of CASE-protected ammo, for more close-range firepower. The model was protected by fourteen tons of armor, and carried sixteen double heat sinks for heat management. It also had a jumping capability of up to 120 meters thanks to four jump jets mounted in its legs. Особенность: Узкий/низкий профиль Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.11 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: A multirole BattleMech developed in 2550 during the Golden Age, the Shadow Hawk is a powerful fusion of maneuverability and firepower. With a mix of long-range and short-range weapons, good maneuverability thanks to jump jets, and excellent endurance, the Shadow Hawk has long been regarded as one of the best 'Mechs in its weight class. The Shadow Hawk is equally adept whether commanding a reconnaissance company or serving as a spotter for heavy and assault lances.

Shadow Hawk одинаково хорош как в роли командира развед роты, так и в качестве засветчика для тяжелых и штурмовых отрядов.

content.original: The 2D2 is an upgrade of the -2D Shadow Hawk introduced in 3049, born of the Federated Commonwealth buying original-model 2Hs from Majesty Metals and refitting them for use by militia forces or for sale to mercenaries. Like the 2D this upgrade adds another SRM launcher to the center torso and a medium laser to the left arm, however both center torso and head launchers are Federated SuperStreak Streak SRM-2s. Besides carrying slightly more armor, a total of six and a half tons, and one ton of Streak ammo in the right torso, it is otherwise identical to the 2D Shadow Hawk. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: A multirole BattleMech developed in 2550 during the Golden Age, the Shadow Hawk is a powerful fusion of maneuverability and firepower. With a mix of long-range and short-range weapons, good maneuverability thanks to jump jets, and excellent endurance, the Shadow Hawk has long been regarded as one of the best 'Mechs in its weight class. The Shadow Hawk is equally adept whether commanding a reconnaissance company or serving as a spotter for heavy and assault lances.

content.content: Многоцелевой боевой мех, разработанный в 2550 году во время Золотого века, Shadow Hawk представляет собой мощное сочетание маневренности и огневой мощи. Благодаря сочетанию оружия дальнего и ближнего боя, хорошей маневренности благодаря прыжковым двигателям и отличной выносливости, Shadow Hawk долгое время считался одним из лучших мехов в своей весовой категории. Shadow Hawk одинаково хорош как в роли командира развед роты, так и в качестве засветчика для тяжелых и штурмовых отрядов.

content.original: This heavy scout variant carries a large laser in the right arm, a pair of medium lasers in each side torso, and a medium pulse laser with a coaxially mounted TAG system in the left arm. The left and right torso carry a Guardian ECM suite and a Beagle active probe, respectively, and a half ton of cargo space is provided in the head, probably for supplies on long reconnaissance missions. The most interesting change, however, is the use of a more powerful 330-rated XL engine that gives a top speed of 97.2 km/h which, when combined with five jump jets allowing 150 meter leaps, allows the 'Mech to get out of tight spots. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: A Clan-tech retrofit of the classic Shadow Hawk and intended for second-line and solahma troops, the Shadow Hawk C replaces all Inner Sphere–tech weaponry with Clan equivalents. The C mounts an LB 5-X AC, an LRM-5 equipped with Swarm LRM munitions, a Streak SRM-2, and an ER medium laser. Two additional jump jets were added, extending the jump radius to 150 meters, as well as one additional single heat sink. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.content: «Шэдоу Хок С» — это клановая модификация классического Shadow Hawk, предназначенная для войск второй линии и соламы. В ней всё вооружение из Внутренней Сферы заменено клановым аналогом. На -C установлены: LB 5-X, LRM-5 с боеприпасами Swarm LRM, Streak SRM-2 и средний ER-лазер. Добавлены два дополнительных прыжковых двигателя, увеличивающих радиус прыжка до 150 метров, а также один дополнительный одинарный охладитель. Особенность: Боевые кулаки Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.03

These OmniMechs are a tad light on available pod space for their weight class and those early structural mounts are not compatible with anything else. content.original: The Thresher is a second-line BattleMech that is all-around average. It excels at nothing, but will rarely turn in a particularly poor showing. It has modest speed for a 'Mech its size, which it compensates for with MASC and enough jump jets to leap up to 150 meters. The Thresher is the result of a joint development project between Clan Sea Fox and Clan Hell's Horses, the result of which was obvious to Inner Sphere observers before they had even encountered the 'Mech in battle.

content.original: The Thug was designed by Maltex Corporation as a direct competitor to the popular Warhammer BattleMech. First seeing production in 2572, the Thug sought to directly address some of the challenges which faced the Warhammer, chief of which was to increase armor protection without sacrificing firepower. The Thugs long range striking power comes from a pair of arm mounted PPC’s. Backing up the PPCs are two SRM-6 launchers mounted in either side torso with one ton of CASE-protected reloads. Eighteen double heat sinks comfortably dissipate the enormous heat generated by the PPC’s while an Endo Steel frame allows it to carry fifteen and a half tons of armor.

content.original: The Thunderbolt started production in 2491 as a planetary-assault 'Mech, and in fact was one of the heaviest 'Mechs that could be produced at that time. Since then the 'Mech, known affectionately as the T-Bolt, has had its classification changed as larger 'Mechs were built but thanks to periodic updates it is still feared and respected by many. With its varied arsenal, the Thunderbolt remains one of the best-armed 'Mechs, making it capable of serving in many roles. It is also an incredibly well-armored 'Mech, rivaling or exceeding the amount of armor carried by some assault 'Mechs. One downside to the Thunderbolt though is poor heat management.

С тех пор классификация меха, ласково называемого T-Bolt, менялась по мере строительства более крупных мехов, но благодаря периодическим обновлениям его по-прежнему боятся и уважают многие. Благодаря своему разнообразному арсеналу Thunderbolt остаётся одним из наиболее вооруженных мехов, что делает его способным выполнять множество ролей. Кроме того, это невероятно хорошо бронированный мех, соперничающий или превосходящий по количеству брони некоторые штурмовые мехи. Однако одним из недостатков Thunderbolt является плохое управление теплом.

The 'Mech is armed with an ER PPC in its right arm as its primary long-range firepower. This is supported at closer ranges by a SRM-6 in the left torso along with the original three medium lasers. While retaining the left arm machine guns, in the right torso it carries a pair of flamers and an anti-missile system, along with one ton of AMS ammo. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: The 9SE variant of the Thunderbolt was introduced in 3050 as the Eridani Light Horse's update to the 5SE, based primarily around an energy weapons arsenal and maneuverability. The 'Mech is armed with a LRM-10 missile launcher for long-range combat. For close to medium ranges, the 'Mech carries a Large Pulse Laser and three medium lasers. Of note is the shifting of the missile launcher and its one ton of reloads from the right torso to the left. The additional mobility of the 9SE comes from its four jump jets, giving it a jumping distance of 120 meters. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: This variant was built by Blackwell Industries for Wolf's Dragoons and it was based on a configuration from the Golden Century. Four jump jets let it cover 120 meters per jump. Fifteen double heat sinks dissipate the heat from various Clan-spec weapons. The right arm carries a Clan-spec Large Pulse Laser, the three torso-mounted lasers are Clan-spec Medium Pulse Lasers, and the LRM-10 is also Clan-spec and equipped with an Artemis IV FCS. Two tons of LRM ammo are carried in the left torso in a CASE-protected bin. Twelve tons of Inner Sphere-spec ferro-fibrous armor provides maximum protection. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: An attempt to create a light long range support fire platform, the Weevil was never a success and is seldom brought out of storage anymore. The main issue is the lack of weight capacity for the proper long range support weapons and cooling, meaning all variants tend to suffer from either being under-gunned or very overheat prone.

content.original: The Black Lanner's F2 loadout is currently only used with the Jade Falcon Clan. It is a general-purpose design, intended to take on recon patrols and disrupt supply lines on an intermittent basis. The choice of weapons suggests a need to minimize the burden on the Jade Falcon support and technical training pipelines. Unfortunately, while it is capable of many routine assignments, the F2 will do none of them well. It is presumed the Jade Falcons will exercise caution, fielding this configuration only when they are sure there are no massed formations of Battlemechs in the target area. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: Named for the demonic wolf of Germanic myth, the Fenrir was less a traditional battle suit and more a mobile fire support platform. The trooper controlling the suit was situated inside a cramped "cockpit" and piloted the Fenrir like a small walking tank. The single, configurable turret mounted on the suit could accept a wide variety of weapon configurations and the Fenrir's sturdy, powerful legs could propel it to much greater speeds than the Sloth. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only mount internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Названный в честь демонического волка из германских мифов, «Фенрир» представлял собой скорее мобильную платформу огневой поддержки, чем традиционный боевой костюм. Управляющий костюмом боец ​​располагался в тесной «кабине» и пилотировал «Фенрир», словно небольшой шагающий танк. Единственная настраиваемая турель, установленная на костюме, могла нести широкий спектр вооружения, а крепкие и мощные ноги «Фенрира» позволяли ему развивать гораздо большую скорость, чем было у Sloth. Особенность: Бронированный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Conceived as a long-range infantry support Mech, the ill-fated Jackrabbit entered prototyping mere weeks before the Amaris Coup. Mass produced without regard for its design flaws, the 25 ton Jackrabbit suffered from anaemic firepower and poor armor; resulting in a bad reputation and the eventual extinction of the design. Powered by a 150-rated Fusion Engine, the Jackrabbit carries 3.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor and has a top speed of 97 km/h. An endosteel skeleton allows the Jackrabbit JKR-8T to carry an AC/2 and a Streak SRM-2, both with a single ton of ammo. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The 5D Marauder was the first updated variant to be designed in the wake of the Helm Memory Core recovery. A direct upgrade of the 3D model, the 5D's engine was replaced with a 300 XL engine, retaining the same speed profile at a much-reduced weight, to allow the entire weapons payload to be stripped out and upgraded. The 5D's primary weapons were two ER PPCs, carried in either arm, supported by a Large Pulse Laser in place of the autocannon. The medium lasers were replaced with two Medium Pulse Lasers, while a Streak SRM-2 launcher was also added to the left torso, along with one ton of CASE-protected ammo, for more close-range firepower. The model was protected by fourteen tons of armor, and carried sixteen double heat sinks for heat management. It also had a jumping capability of up to 120 meters thanks to four jump jets mounted in its legs. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Marauder 5R2 is an export model for the Periphery market. It was constructed on the same line as the 5R, but with much cheaper components, in an attempt to sell based on the relation to the actual 5R alone. Its weapons consist of only three Large and two Medium standard lasers, its cooling is using single heat sinks and the engine is a standard 300 rated core. Overall, the design is pretty much very subpar for a Marauder, but a number of 5R2 were produced and sold before this was fully realized. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

The usual AC/5 was replaced by the newly invented Gauss Rifle. With its smaller range, but a much larger hitting power, this change may be the most important. content.original: This heavy scout variant carries a large laser in the right arm, a pair of medium lasers in each side torso, and a medium pulse laser with a coaxially mounted TAG system in the left arm. The left and right torso carry a Guardian ECM suite and a Beagle active probe, respectively, and a half ton of cargo space is provided in the head, probably for supplies on long reconnaissance missions. The most interesting change, however, is the use of a more powerful 330-rated XL engine that gives a top speed of 97.2 km/h which, when combined with five jump jets allowing 150 meter leaps, allows the 'Mech to get out of tight spots. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

The C mounts an LB 5-X AC, an LRM-5 equipped with Swarm LRM munitions, a Streak SRM-2, and an ER medium laser. content.original: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production. Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units.

content.original: Given to Ross McKinnon upon his father's retirement in 3051, the family 'Mech continued to be upgraded with the latest technology. By the FedCom Civil War the right arm and torso weaponry of Ross's 'Mech was upgraded to extended range models, with the triple strength myomers and hatchet retained. The use of production grade ferro-fibrous and double heat sinks, along with downgrading the large lasers to medium pulse lasers and the left arm medium for an ER Small Laser, freed up enough weight for a Targeting Computer to be added. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12

content.original: The Black Knight was designed both as a front-line combatant and as a command BattleMech at the company and battalion level for the Star League Defense Force. Its advanced communications gear allowed the Black Knight to effortlessly coordinate an entire company of 'Mechs simultaneously, and could easily link together the command frequencies of an entire parent regiment and connect with orbital support satellites. Advanced building materials gave the Black Knight a light but strong chassis able to carry more weapons and armor for less weight. Given the type and amount of firepower the 'Mech carries the only issue facing the Black Knight is heat management.

content.content: «Чёрный рыцарь» был разработан как боевая машина первой линии, так и как командный боевой мех на уровне роты и батальона для Сил обороны Звездной Лиги. Его передовое коммуникационное оборудование позволяло Black Knight без труда координировать действия целой роты мехов одновременно, а также легко соединять командные частоты всего родительского полка и связываться с орбитальными спутниками поддержки. Современные строительные материалы обеспечили Black Knight легким, но прочным шасси, способным нести больше оружия и брони при меньшем весе. Учитывая тип и количество огневой мощи, которую несет мех, единственной проблемой Black Knight является управление тепловыделением.

content.original: Downgraded during the technological decline of the Succession Wars era, the personal 'Mech of the McKinnon family was selected to receive among the first experimental weapons developed from the Helm Memory Core by the New Avalon Institute of Science, thanks to the exploits of Fox's Teeth commander Ian McKinnon. These weight savings, along with the removal of the head-mounted small laser, allowed the 'Mech to carry a Hatchet whose damage was boosted by the addition of Triple Strength Myomer. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12

content.original: Newly developed by Clan Jade Falcon for the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere, the Black Lanner is a fast medium OmniMech that can take on a variety of roles. Intended as a front-line 'Mech, the Black Lanner makes use of all weight-saving technology available to the Clan Jade Falcon scientists who designed it, including an XL engine, endo steel, and eight tons of ferro-fibrous armor. The Black Lanner also includes a MASC system on the base chassis that enables it to run up to 151 km/h in bursts, allowing it to outrun many 'Mechs half its size. The design sacrifices pod space for that speed however, with an engine almost half the Black Lanner's weight leaving a mere 13 tons for offensive weaponry.

content.original: The 'Lone Wolf 2' is inspired by the original Lone Wolf loadout used by Phelan Wolf at his Trial of Position. Downgrading the LRM launchers to only 10 tubes each and removing their Artemis IV FCS, combined with replacing the SRM-6 with an SRM-4 one-shot, allowed adding 5 more heat sinks, greatly improving the heat handling of the 'Mech. Enough weight capacity remained to increase the amount of LB-X ammunition, which could run dry sometimes in the original design. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again.

content.content: «Лютоволк» - один из тех омнимехов, которых стали бояться во Внутренней Сфере во время первого вторжения Кланов, и вполне заслуженно. «Лютоволк» весит внушительные сто тонн и имеет относительно невысокую крейсерскую скорость 54 км/ч, обеспечиваемую двигателем 300 XL. По скорости и бронезащите он не уступает «Атласу», но обладает более высокой потенциальной огневой мощью с 55,5 тонн свободного пространства для оружия и оборудования. Именно за эти качества в криминальных кругах Синдиката Дракона мех окрестили Daishi (псевдояпонское название «Великая смерть»), и это название раз за разом подтверждало свою мрачную правоту.

content.original: The personal 'Mech of the Khan of Clan Blood Spirit, William 'Northwind' Campbell, formally named 'Sanguine Essence'. Each arm of the 'Mech carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and one Extended Range Large Laser. These trios of energy weapons gives the 'Mech great close combat hitters as well as a long reach with good punch. A Gauss rifle is installed in the right torso, which, combined with the hitting power of the ERLLs, provides excellent long-range power. Sixteen shots of ammo is split into two bins, one in the right torso and one in the left. The offensive weapons are rounded out with a torso-mounted Extended Range Small Laser. The Sanguine Essence is also outfitted with a highly advanced battlefield electronics, both en ECM suite in the head and an advanced Clan targeting computer in the left torso. The most surprising feature of the 'Mech, though, are the three installed jump jets providing unexpected mobility. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again.

content.content: «Лютоволк» - один из тех омнимехов, которых стали бояться во Внутренней Сфере во время первого вторжения Кланов, и вполне заслуженно. «Лютоволк» весит внушительные сто тонн и имеет относительно невысокую крейсерскую скорость 54 км/ч, обеспечиваемую двигателем 300 XL. По скорости и бронезащите он не уступает «Атласу», но обладает более высокой потенциальной огневой мощью с 55,5 тонн свободного пространства для оружия и оборудования. Именно за эти качества в криминальных кругах Синдиката Дракона мех окрестили Daishi (псевдояпонское название «Великая смерть»), и это название раз за разом подтверждало свою мрачную правоту.

content.original: The Gargoyle is an extremely fast assault OmniMech developed with the Timber Wolf as replacements for the first-generation Woodsman OmniMech. The Gargoyle is therefore commonly seen among Clan Wolf, and was a featured assault OmniMech during the Clan Invasion. The Gargoyle earned the code name Man O' War from the Inner Sphere forces because of its effectiveness. This dependable design eventually spread throughout the Clans, and can be seen with any of their Galaxies now.

content.original: A multirole BattleMech developed in 2550 during the Golden Age, the Shadow Hawk is a powerful fusion of maneuverability and firepower. With a mix of long-range and short-range weapons, good maneuverability thanks to jump jets, and excellent endurance, the Shadow Hawk has long been regarded as one of the best 'Mechs in its weight class. The Shadow Hawk is equally adept whether commanding a reconnaissance company or serving as a spotter for heavy and assault lances.

content.content: Многоцелевой боевой мех, разработанный в 2550 году во время Золотого века, Shadow Hawk представляет собой мощное сочетание маневренности и огневой мощи. Благодаря сочетанию оружия дальнего и ближнего боя, хорошей маневренности благодаря прыжковым двигателям и отличной выносливости, Shadow Hawk долгое время считался одним из лучших мехов в своей весовой категории. Shadow Hawk одинаково хорош как в роли командира развед роты, так и в качестве засветчика для тяжелых и штурмовых отрядов.

content.original: The Thresher is a second-line BattleMech that is all-around average. It excels at nothing, but will rarely turn in a particularly poor showing. It has modest speed for a 'Mech its size, which it compensates for with MASC and enough jump jets to leap up to 150 meters. The Thresher is the result of a joint development project between Clan Sea Fox and Clan Hell's Horses, the result of which was obvious to Inner Sphere observers before they had even encountered the 'Mech in battle.

content.original: The Thug was designed by Maltex Corporation as a direct competitor to the popular Warhammer BattleMech. First seeing production in 2572, the Thug sought to directly address some of the challenges which faced the Warhammer, chief of which was to increase armor protection without sacrificing firepower. The Thugs long range striking power comes from a pair of arm mounted PPC’s. Backing up the PPCs are two SRM-6 launchers mounted in either side torso with one ton of CASE-protected reloads. Eighteen double heat sinks comfortably dissipate the enormous heat generated by the PPC’s while an Endo Steel frame allows it to carry fifteen and a half tons of armor.

content.original: The personal 'Mech of the Khan of Clan Blood Spirit, William 'Northwind' Campbell, formally named 'Sanguine Essence'. Each arm of the 'Mech carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and one Extended Range Large Laser. These trios of energy weapons gives the 'Mech great close combat hitters as well as a long reach with good punch. A Gauss rifle is installed in the right torso, which, combined with the hitting power of the ERLLs, provides excellent long-range power. Sixteen shots of ammo is split into two bins, one in the right torso and one in the left. The offensive weapons are rounded out with a torso-mounted Extended Range Small Laser. The Sanguine Essence is also outfitted with a highly advanced battlefield electronics, both en ECM suite in the head and an advanced Clan targeting computer in the left torso. The most surprising feature of the 'Mech, though, are the three installed jump jets providing unexpected mobility. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most famous BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower, and electronics. Originally a staple of the SLDF, Phoenix Hawks remained common within the armies of the Successor States after the fall of the Star League. At first Phoenix Hawks were grouped together to form powerful recon lances, but as they started reaching their various deployments, their full potential as command 'Mechs was discovered and many were reassigned to instead lead units of smaller recon 'Mechs.

Этот мех появился, когда Orguss Industries поняли, что могут усилить шасси Stinger, чтобы породить более крупную версию, обладающую той же скоростью и маневренностью, что и Stinger, но с улучшенной броней, огневой мощью и электроникой. Изначально являясь основной рабочей лошадкой СОЗЛ, «Феникс Хоки» оставались распространенными в армиях государств-наследников после падения Звездной Лиги. Сначала «Феникс Хоки» были объединены в мощные разведывательные отряды, но по мере того, как они начали достигать своих различных мест развертывания, был обнаружен их полный потенциал в качестве командирских мехов, и многие из них были переведены на руководство подразделениями малых развед мехов.

content.original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most famous BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower, and electronics. Originally a staple of the SLDF, Phoenix Hawks remained common within the armies of the Successor States after the fall of the Star League. At first Phoenix Hawks were grouped together to form powerful recon lances, but as they started reaching their various deployments, their full potential as command 'Mechs was discovered and many were reassigned to instead lead units of smaller recon 'Mechs.

content.content: Впервые представленный Терранской гегемонией в 2568 году, Phoenix Hawk был одним из самых известных боевых мехов во Внутренней Сфере. Этот мех появился, когда Orguss Industries поняли, что могут усилить шасси Stinger, чтобы породить более крупную версию, обладающую той же скоростью и маневренностью, что и Stinger, но с улучшенной броней, огневой мощью и электроникой. Изначально являясь основной рабочей лошадкой СОЗЛ, «Феникс Хоки» оставались распространенными в армиях государств-наследников после падения Звездной Лиги. Сначала «Феникс Хоки» были объединены в мощные разведывательные отряды, но по мере того, как они начали достигать своих различных мест развертывания, был обнаружен их полный потенциал в качестве командирских мехов, и многие из них были переведены на руководство подразделениями малых развед мехов.

For medium to close range combat, the Akuma has a MRM-30 launcher and two highly accurate short range missile launchers; a Streak SRM-6 and a Streak SRM-4 launcher. Finally, a medium laser and a Medium Pulse Laser round out the Akuma's eclectic and effective weapons payload. content.original: Created in 3058 in response to a call from Kurita to build more cost-effective BattleMechs with which to combat the Clans, the Akuma was designed by Independence Weaponry as a low-cost alternative to their Atlas variant. The Akuma actually shares several components with the Atlas and, much like that design, also features a head design intended to evoke fear in its enemies. The Akuma is built on a Foundation AKU Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a rugged and reliable GM 270 fusion engine that allows the 'Mech to reach a top speed of 54.0 km/h. The 'Mech has thirteen double heat sinks to dissipate waste heat and carries seventeen and a half tons of Durallex Special Heavy armor for protection from enemy fire.

content.original: The Buccaneer is a product of the Word of Blake's voracious appetite for military equipment in its first few years, as the order had far more MechWarriors than they had 'Mechs. The Buccaneer was originally designed to be used by ComStar, but had not begun production. When the schism that created the Word of Blake occurred, the design was modified to accommodate equipment available to the Word of Blake in their temporary home of the Free Worlds League. The Buccaneer is built with a lightweight VOX 330 XL engine giving the 'Mech a top speed of 97.2 km/h. It also carries an impressive ten tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the maximum amount of protection the chassis can carry, and mounts 10 double heat sinks as standard.

content.original: The Álfar, named for the elves of Germanic legend, was developed on Coventry during the reign of Archon Tracial Steiner to improve the Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces performance in mobile BattleMech warfare, and to provide a homegrown competitor to widespread standard designs like the Griffin and Shadow Hawk. Thanks to its good speed, a jumping distance of 90 meters, 10 tons of then-cutting-edge ferro-fibrous armor, and some serious firepower, the design was popular with its pilots. It was, however, liked much less by the technical crews. Ironically, Coventry Metal Works' desire to outdo their competition proved the Álfar's downfall. The design used so many nonstandard parts that repairs and logistics quickly became a big problem. Of all the Star League Defense Force Álfars lost in the war, a full third were scrapped solely because repairing them was deemed too difficult.

content.original: Following the move of Clan Ghost Bear to the Inner Sphere, Khan Bjorn Jorgensson ordered the creation of a new BattleMech. The Arcas was designed as a symbol to mark the beginning of a new era, so Loremaster Laurie Tseng named it after a character in the mythology of the Greeks who eventually became the constellation known as Ursa Minor. First produced in 3061, the Arcas is expensive for a second-line 'Mech. It utilizes an XL engine that enables it to move up to 86 km/h and jump jets for a maximum jump capacity of one hundred fifty meters at a time. The Arcas mounts thirteen and a half tons of standard armor, the most a 'Mech of its size can carry.

content.original: The design of the Arctic Wolf is simple: get close, unleash a torrent of missiles, and get out. To do this, it is armed with six Type 1 SRM Six-Shooters and two Type 1 Cross-Pattern SRM-4 Launchers. Aiding the accuracy of these missiles is the Tracker Series Narc Missile Beacon. The Arctic Wolf also boasts an impressive four tons of ammunition for its launchers. The 'Mech has ten double heat sinks which can be overwhelmed, but only if a MechWarrior insists on staying in the fight or going full-tilt for long periods. The Arctic Wolf is protected by six tons of standard armor.

content.original: The primary weapon on the Beowulf is a highly accurate large pulse laser, supported by two ER medium lasers. To make it easier for the 'Mech to hunt down its targets, the Beowulf also mounts a Beagle active probe, and a TAG target designator allows the 'Mech to designate targets for artillery attacks. To save weight on the 'Mech and still allow for high speeds, the Beowulf is powered by a 270 XL engine that weighs half as much as a standard fusion engine. It also mounts MASC, enhancing its top speed of 129.6 km/h to allow it to keep up with most light 'Mechs. To traverse rough terrain, the Beowulf has six jump jets that allow it to jump up to 180 meters. For protection from enemy fire, the Beowulf carries eight and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

To save weight on the 'Mech and still allow for high speeds, the Beowulf is powered by a 270 XL engine that weighs half as much as a standard fusion engine. It also mounts MASC, enhancing its top speed of 129.6 km/h to allow it to keep up with most light 'Mechs. To traverse rough terrain, the Beowulf has six jump jets that allow it to jump up to 180 meters. For protection from enemy fire, the Beowulf carries eight and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor. Особенность: Расширенный поворот торса Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.03

content.original: Built with the intention of showing solidarity in the spirit of the new Star League, the Black Watch is the culmination of the efforts of Cosara Weaponries, the Northwind Highlanders, and Captain Neil Campbell of the Royal Black Watch. The Black Watch is built on the same chassis as the classic Crockett which served with distinction in the old Star League Defense Force. The 'Mech is powered by the rugged and durable Strand 255 fusion engine, giving the Black Watch a top speed of 54.0 km/h. For added mobility, the Black Watch has three Rawlings 54 jump jets that allow the 'Mech to jump up to ninety meters. The Black Watch has ten double heat sinks that are more than adequate for the needs of the 'mech and has fifteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor with CASE to protect itself from ammunition explosions.

content.original: The Blood Kite is a BattleMech that was designed on the orders of Clan Blood Spirit Khan Ceana Boques following the deployment of the OmniMech by Clan Coyote in 2854. Because Khan Boques expected the Trials for the OmniMech technology to escalate to the point that her small Clan's touman would not be able to compete, she ordered her scientist caste to rethink the way they designed 'Mechs. Boques dictated that this design philosophy was to conform to four points that seem like they would be common sense: be as cheap as is reasonable, have a reasonable chance of surviving an engagement, sustain a steady barrage, and be as efficient as possible. In fact, many prior designs created by the Clan's scientists violated many or all of these principles. The cream of this crop was the Blood Kite, which debuted in the early part of the thirtieth century. The Blood Kite eschews the use of expensive technology and weapons, only making use of an Endo Steel internal structure to save weight. It contains as much standard armor as the engineers could fit onto the eighty-five ton frame, as well as jump jets that propel it up to ninety meters at a time.

content.original: The Bowman utilizes an XL engine to maintain its rapid pace, as well an Endo Steel internal structure to save weight. An ECM Suite protects it from some forms of electronic warfare, while twelve and a half tons of armor protect it from weapons fire. The primary armament on the Bowman is a Class 16 Arrow IV Artillery launcher. Enough ammunition is included to allow for various types to be utilized. Though the original design incorporated two artillery pieces, the modern version accedes to modern demands by utilizing a LRM-20, though it has a limited amount of ammunition. Three ER Medium Lasers are meant for anti-vehicle use, while two Anti-Personnel Pods on each leg keep conventional infantry at bay. Fourteen double heat sinks keep heat levels down for the most part. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper

content.original: The Bowman first saw production in 2960 as Clan Hell's Horses started a crash program to build defensive BattleMechs following the fall of Tokasha MechWorks to Clan Ghost Bear in 2921. Now a rare sight on the battlefield, the Bowman began its life as an artillery platform mounting a pair of Arrow IV artillery systems. However, this configuration never met with success, due mostly to Clan biases against indirect warfare. Therefore, the Bowman was modified to its present "standard" configuration in 2973. Still unpopular with Clan warriors, the Bowman is primarily utilized by Clan Hell's Horses.

content.original: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Colossus was one of the first 'Mechs to use X-Pulse Lasers. Bethel Labs, the developers of the X-Pulse technology, wanted a demonstrator for their new technology. Omnitech Industries brushed off their Colossus design and the rest is history. Using a standard engine, Endo Steel chassis, and armor, the Colossus can take enormous amounts of damage. Though not a particularly fast 'Mech, it does move at the same rate as the Atlas and other assault 'Mechs. In addition it has a 90 meter jump capability which can maneuver it out of trouble.

content.original: The Corvis 1 is built on a Model MH-24 endo steel chassis, protected by seven tons of ferro-fibrous armor; a good thing since it is so slow. This low speed is due to the 160-rated fusion engine that powers the 'Mech. Thankfully this low speed is augmented by four jump jets, giving the Corvis a jump range of 120 meters. The main gun of the Corvis is its UAC/10, backed up by a pair of medium pulse lasers. These guns enable the Corvis to operate effectively in medium to short ranges. Between the generous supply of autocannon ammunition and 10 double heat sinks that keep the 'Mech chilled, the Corvis can operate without resupply for a respectable amount of time. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Corvis was one of the predecessors to the OmniMech, utilizing the same semi-modular ports as the Star League Mercury BattleMech. Clan technicians eventually expanded upon this design to create the Stormcrow, and with the development of that front-line OmniMech, all of the Clans save the Horses lost interest in the Corvis, which was often derided as too slow for its weight class. In fact, the Corvis' only saving grace is its use of jump jets, because they allow the medium-range 'Mech to be useful when on restricting terrain, such as urban environments. The Corvis was often deployed as support for conventional troops, such as combat vehicles and infantry, so it only seems natural that the Horses would want to keep producing it.

content.content: «Корвис» был одним из предшественников омнимехов, используя те же полумодульные слоты, что и боевой мех «Меркурий» Звёздной Лиги. Техники Кланов в конечном итоге расширили эту конструкцию, чтобы создать Stormcrow, и с разработкой этого передового омнимеха все кланы, кроме Лошадей, потеряли интерес к Corvis, который часто высмеивался как слишком медленный для своего весового класса. Фактически, единственным плюсом Corvis является использование прыжковых двигателей, поскольку они позволяют меху средней дальности быть полезным на сложной местности, например, в городских условиях. Corvis часто использовался для поддержки обычных войск, таких как боевая техника и пехота, поэтому кажется вполне естественным, что Лошади хотели продолжать его производство.

content.original: Based on an old Star League design called the Sling, the Duan Gung likely shares its roots with the Koshi OmniMech, as the Sling shared many characteristics with both designs, and it is believed that the Sling was easily upgraded with OmniMech technology. The Duan Gung is a competent light fire support 'Mech, with a ground speed of 119 km/h and the ability to jump up to 180 meters, it is capable of keeping up with most other light 'Mechs. To save weight and allow the Duan Gung to carry as heavy an arsenal as possible, the 'Mech is built on a endo steel chassis and is powered by an 175 XL engine that weighs half as much as its standard fusion counterpart. To handle the heat from its weapons, the Duan Gung has 10 double heat sinks, which are more than adequate for the 'Mech's needs. Finally, for protection from enemy fire, the Duan Gung carries four tons of armor, providing more than enough protection for the 'Mech's intended role.

To save weight and allow the Duan Gung to carry as heavy an arsenal as possible, the 'Mech is built on a endo steel chassis and is powered by an 175 XL engine that weighs half as much as its standard fusion counterpart. To handle the heat from its weapons, the Duan Gung has 10 double heat sinks, which are more than adequate for the 'Mech's needs. Finally, for protection from enemy fire, the Duan Gung carries four tons of armor, providing more than enough protection for the 'Mech's intended role.

content.original: The Eisenfaust was originally designed shortly after the Lyran Commonwealth began building 'Mechs. Based on their experience with the Commando and Ymir, the LCAF tried to build a medium class "siege engine" 'Mech. Though the trials looked promising, the battlefield performance of the early Eisenfaust was poor and the design was canceled. After the recovery of lostech and advanced SLDF technologies, Defiance Industries looked at the early Eisenfaust design again. The updated Eisenfaust entered production after simulations showed it could be an effective battlefield unit if equipped with updated technologies. In fact the Eisenfaust was one of the first designs to enter production after the start of the Jihad

content.original: The Emperor is one of the earliest assault BattleMechs, dating back to 2502. The Emperor also bears the distinction of being the first 90+ ton BattleMech to mount jump jets (the famed Highlander began production in 2592). In 2612, StarCorps introduced an upgraded Emperor, EMP-6A designed for and distributed exclusively to Star League Defense Forces Royal Units. The Emperor was produced continuously until Marik forces destroyed StarCorps Industries facility with nuclear arms on Son Hoa during the Second Succession War. Production of the Emperor resumed in 3057 alongside the legendary Highlander.

content.original: A Succession Wars era downgrade of the original EXT-4D model, the Exterminator 4A model was created in 3007 by Kallon Industries as a potential replacement for their Wolverine line. While packing nearly the same weapons array as the original 4D, engineers were forced to substitute the AMS for a conventional Machine Gun and downgrade the engine to a smaller 325-rated model. Lacking the advanced stealth systems and high speed of its progenitor model, the design was considered a failure and only 25 models were constructed.

content.original: The Falconer was designed at the order of Hanse Davion to create a 'Mech that could tame the Jade Falcons and defeat a Clan OmniMech in one-on-one combat. The Falconer is powered by a 375 XL engine that propels the 'Mech to a top speed of 86.4 km/h. This speed is enhanced with greater mobility by fiv jump jets that allow the Falconer to jump the considerable distance of one hundred and fifty meters. The Falconer also saves weight to carry as many weapons as possible by using a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and carries eleven and a half tons of armor plating, which gives the Falconer a respectable amount of armor protection.

content.original: The Falcon Hawk has what is probably the longest development time of any 'Mech in history. Originally engineered and designed in 2794, the rapid loss of technology during the Succession Wars delayed its production until 3057, and even then only thanks to the recovery of a Star League memory core on Helm by the Gray Death Legion. The Falcon Hawk is powered by an 175 XL engine that provides a top speed of 86.4 km/h, making it relatively slow for its weight class. This is done so the Falcon Hawk could carry the weapons needed for its role as a long-range sniper. The 'Mech carries seven tons of armor to protect it from return fire.

content.original: The Fire Scorpion is a quadrupedal BattleMech designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion scientists to be a totem 'Mech. It is visually similar to a scorpion, complete with a "tail" rising up from the rear of the BattleMech. The claw-like elements near the cockpit are actually armored guards, placed on either side of the head to keep ground troops from sniping at the cockpit. Scientists who designed it apparently believed in a quantity over quality approach, as the Fire Scorpion is rugged, cheap and primarily fielded by second-line forces that defend cities, the role in which it excels.

content.original: The Garm is designed to operate as part of a fire support lance, providing long-range direct fire for other units, and as such, the Garm competes directly with the Valkyrie BattleMech. To make the Garm capable of carrying the weapons needed to carry out its intended mission, it is built on an endo steel chassis that weighs half as much as a standard chassis, while an 175 fusion engine allows it a maximum speed of 86.4 km/h. The mobility enjoyed by the Garm is enhanced with five Rawlings 80-beta jump jets that make the 'Mech capable of jumping up to 150 meters. The Garm does have relatively light armor for a 'Mech of its size, with only three and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor; this is because the Garm depends on its ability to engage an enemy at long range rather than closing to short ranges.

content.original: The original Gladiator used primitive technologies, so it only had a Large Laser and two Medium Lasers. In addition, it could only manage a top speed around 64 km/h. It was protected by sixteen and a half tons of Primitive Armor. The GLD-1R went out of production by 2488. During the Jihad, several companies began producing this primitive design of Gladiator as a part of the appearance of RetroTech on the battlefield, driven by the need for war materiel; companies which produced the primitive Gladiator during this era included Rastaban Agricultural Products, Metals of the Earth and Sword of the Prophet Enterprises although many of these manufacturing lines had closed down by 3079.

content.original: As an early Clan design, the Great Wyrm utilizes less advanced technology compared to later Clan 'Mechs. As such, it is built on a standard chassis, powered by a 225 fusion engine, and is protected by seven tons of armor. A max speed of 86.4 km/h was respectable, and the heat generated was kept under control by the base 10 double heat sinks. The Great Wyrm mounts weaponry that covers all ranges, giving it good engagement flexibility. For long-ranges it makes use of a LRM-10 and a pair of UAC/2s, and uses its speed to stay out of the range of most enemies' guns while peppering them with these. If any enemy manages to close, or if the one ton of ammunition for those weapons is expended, the Great Wyrm also mounts a pair of ER medium lasers and ER small lasers. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper

content.original: The Great Wyrm was one of the first unique Clan BattleMechs ever developed. Clan Mongoose scientists used the specifications for the Dragon as the basis for their new creation, and were able to update it to their liking in a little more than a year. Not only was it designed to Clan specifications, but the Mongoose creators reduced the Dragon's weight by 15 tons. The Great Wyrm first saw action in 2844 against Clan Star Adder, and soon found its way into the touman of every Clan. With the development of the OmniMech, however, the Great Wyrm was reduced to a solahma unit and production finally ceased in 2872.

content.original: A melding of the popular Star League era Thug and the poorly regarded Charger, the samurai-themed Hatamoto-Chi was the first post–Succession Wars Draconis Combine BattleMech constructed utilizing recovered LosTech. Tasked by Kanrei Theodore Kurita to reverse engineer examples of the advanced Star League Defense Force BattleMechs provided by ComStar in 3035 for future production, Luthien Armor Works secretly mated the weaponry of the Thug to the form of the maligned Charger. While initially unable to mass produce the advanced Endo Steel chassis required to match the Thug, the appearance of the early Hatamoto-Chi and their endless variations born of the Charger's spacious torso sent the combined Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth into confusion during the War of 3039.

content.content: Являясь смесью популярного Thug эпохи Звездной Лиги и не пользующегося популярностью Charger, Hatamoto-Chi в стиле самураев был первым боевым мехом Синдиката Дракона, построенным после Наследных войн с использованием восстановленного лостеха. По поручению канреи Теодора Куриты провести обратную разработку образцов передовых боевых мехов СОЗЛ, предоставленных КомСтаром в 3035 году для будущего производства, Luthien Armor Works тайно соединила вооружение Thug с обликом злосчастного Charger. Хотя изначально компания не могла массово производить передовые шасси из эндостали, необходимые для Thug, появление ранних Hatamoto-Chi и их бесконечных вариаций, созданных на основе просторного корпуса Charger, привело к замешательству в объединенных вооруженных силах Федеративного Содружества во время войны 3039 года.

This 'Mech is a powerful long range combat 'Mech and can keep an enemy at range and slowly take the armor off of a 'Mech. By the time an enemy is able to close with the Hatamoto-Mizo it can usually be taken out in physical combat. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

Tasked by Kanrei Theodore Kurita to reverse engineer examples of the advanced Star League Defense Force BattleMechs provided by ComStar in 3035 for future production, Luthien Armor Works secretly mated the weaponry of the Thug to the form of the maligned Charger. While initially unable to mass produce the advanced Endo Steel chassis required to match the Thug, the appearance of the early Hatamoto-Chi and their endless variations born of the Charger's spacious torso sent the combined Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth into confusion during the War of 3039.

content.content: Являясь смесью популярного Thug эпохи Звездной Лиги и не пользующегося популярностью Charger, Hatamoto-Chi в стиле самураев был первым боевым мехом Синдиката Дракона, построенным после Наследных войн с использованием восстановленного лостеха. По поручению канреи Теодора Куриты провести обратную разработку образцов передовых боевых мехов СОЗЛ, предоставленных КомСтаром в 3035 году для будущего производства, Luthien Armor Works тайно соединила вооружение Thug с обликом злосчастного Charger. Хотя изначально компания не могла массово производить передовые шасси из эндостали, необходимые для Thug, появление ранних Hatamoto-Chi и их бесконечных вариаций, созданных на основе просторного корпуса Charger, привело к замешательству в объединенных вооруженных силах Федеративного Содружества во время войны 3039 года.

content.original: The HTM-56K, also known as the Hatamoto-Ni or Hatamoto-Chi II, mounts two ER PPC as the main damage dealers, one in each arm. Four side torso mounted Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-2 act as reserve firepower as needed, while an AMS and a Small Laser provide defensive capabilities. The 'Mech also carries a Guardian ECM and a C3 Slave computer. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14

content.original: Constructed with an Earthwerks VOL Endo Steel chassis, fitted with CASE protected ammo bins and clad in fifteen and a half tons of Mitchell Argon armor, the Hatamoto-Chi shared the features which made its parent design a nearly indestructible zombie 'Mech. The main area that Combine was unable to replicate the Thug was the older design's advanced Double Heat Sinks, eighteen standard Heat Sinks giving the Hatamoto-Chi a high heat curve in heavy combat.

content.original: A melding of the popular Star League era Thug and the poorly regarded Charger, the samurai-themed Hatamoto-Chi was the first post–Succession Wars Draconis Combine BattleMech constructed utilizing recovered LosTech. Tasked by Kanrei Theodore Kurita to reverse engineer examples of the advanced Star League Defense Force BattleMechs provided by ComStar in 3035 for future production, Luthien Armor Works secretly mated the weaponry of the Thug to the form of the maligned Charger. While initially unable to mass produce the advanced Endo Steel chassis required to match the Thug, the appearance of the early Hatamoto-Chi and their endless variations born of the Charger's spacious torso sent the combined Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth into confusion during the War of 3039.

content.content: Являясь смесью популярного Thug эпохи Звездной Лиги и не пользующегося популярностью Charger, Hatamoto-Chi в стиле самураев был первым боевым мехом Синдиката Дракона, построенным после Наследных войн с использованием восстановленного лостеха. По поручению канреи Теодора Куриты провести обратную разработку образцов передовых боевых мехов СОЗЛ, предоставленных КомСтаром в 3035 году для будущего производства, Luthien Armor Works тайно соединила вооружение Thug с обликом злосчастного Charger. Хотя изначально компания не могла массово производить передовые шасси из эндостали, необходимые для Thug, появление ранних Hatamoto-Chi и их бесконечных вариаций, созданных на основе просторного корпуса Charger, привело к замешательству в объединенных вооруженных силах Федеративного Содружества во время войны 3039 года.

Clan Diamond Shark first fielded the cheap 'Mech when they helped Clan Nova Cat evacuate from Clan space in 3060. Clan Jade Falcon merchants were the first to point out that the Ha Otoko name and oriental aspect and style of combat were meant to be sold to the Inner Sphere, being easily modified to accommodate similar Inner Sphere weaponry, in addition to the Oriental styling of the 'Mech's exterior. The Ha Otoko is protected by thirteen tons of armor.

content.original: The Katana began its existence when the Draconis Combine was given several downgraded Crockett BattleMechs by ComStar as part of Operation Rosebud. Independence Weaponry reverse-engineered the weapons so they could produce copies at a nearby facility and closely examined the Crocketts for several months. After making minor modifications these 'Mechs were renamed Katanas and used to replace Chargers in several DCMS units. The Katana quickly become a mainstay in many of the heavier mobile line units, especially after the invention of the C3 Computer. The Katana still shares many of the same features as the Crockett, right down to the serial number.

content.original: The King Crab's primary weapons are two massive Autocannon/20s, among the most powerful BattleMech weapons ever created. Each arm carries one of these massive weapons, and they are fed by two tons of ammo split between the side torsos. The firepower of these weapons is enough to destroy a medium 'Mech in one salvo. To protect the autocannons in combat, engineers designed the King Crab with simple hand actuators. In appearance and movement, the actuators are very similar to pincers or claws found on real crabs, a contributing factor to the 'Mech's name. To back up the autocannons, and provide some long-range capabilities, the King Crab carries a LRM-15 launcher, mounted in the left torso and fed by one ton of reloads in the same location, and a Large Laser in the right torso. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

To protect the autocannons in combat, engineers designed the King Crab with simple hand actuators. In appearance and movement, the actuators are very similar to pincers or claws found on real crabs, a contributing factor to the 'Mech's name. To back up the autocannons, and provide some long-range capabilities, the King Crab carries a LRM-15 launcher, mounted in the left torso and fed by one ton of reloads in the same location, and a Large Laser in the right torso. Особенность: Командирский мех Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.16

content.original: Designed as a replacement to the Timber Wolf, the 65 ton Linebacker entered production in 3052. Built around a 390-rated XL Engine, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel give the OmniMech 17.5 tons of free pod space. The Linebacker LBK-Prime is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s. An LRM-5, Streak SRM-4 and a ER Small Laser fill out the remaining free weight.Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1.

content.original: The Lobo was originally conceived as an inexpensive companion to the Timber Wolf. Khan Vladimir Ward's Clan Wolf was never fond of the Linebacker, the brain child of Khans Natasha Kerensky and Phelan Ward, so Khan Ward directed his scientists to design something smaller. Despite that, Ward was not happy with his options until Clan Coyote developed the Advanced Tactical Missile launcher, which Ward quickly secured the technology and had it incorporated into the Lobo. With that inclusion, the 'Mech ceased to be cheap, however, as the inclusion of endo steel and an extralight engine was necessary to free up space for the desired launchers. Able to out-pace the Timber Wolf, the Lobo is more in line with Clan Wolf's shift to faster, hard-hitting 'Mechs.

content.original: The primary weapon on the Beowulf is a highly accurate large pulse laser, supported by two ER medium lasers. To make it easier for the 'Mech to hunt down its targets, the Beowulf also mounts a Beagle active probe, and a TAG target designator allows the 'Mech to designate targets for artillery attacks. To save weight on the 'Mech and still allow for high speeds, the Beowulf is powered by a 270 XL engine that weighs half as much as a standard fusion engine. It also mounts MASC, enhancing its top speed of 129.6 km/h to allow it to keep up with most light 'Mechs. To traverse rough terrain, the Beowulf has six jump jets that allow it to jump up to 180 meters. For protection from enemy fire, the Beowulf carries eight and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor. content.original: As an early Clan design, the Great Wyrm utilizes less advanced technology compared to later Clan 'Mechs. As such, it is built on a standard chassis, powered by a 225 fusion engine, and is protected by seven tons of armor. A max speed of 86.4 km/h was respectable, and the heat generated was kept under control by the base 10 double heat sinks. The Great Wyrm mounts weaponry that covers all ranges, giving it good engagement flexibility. For long-ranges it makes use of a LRM-10 and a pair of UAC/2s, and uses its speed to stay out of the range of most enemies' guns while peppering them with these. If any enemy manages to close, or if the one ton of ammunition for those weapons is expended, the Great Wyrm also mounts a pair of ER medium lasers and ER small lasers. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper

content.original: The King Crab's primary weapons are two massive Autocannon/20s, among the most powerful BattleMech weapons ever created. Each arm carries one of these massive weapons, and they are fed by two tons of ammo split between the side torsos. The firepower of these weapons is enough to destroy a medium 'Mech in one salvo. To protect the autocannons in combat, engineers designed the King Crab with simple hand actuators. In appearance and movement, the actuators are very similar to pincers or claws found on real crabs, a contributing factor to the 'Mech's name. To back up the autocannons, and provide some long-range capabilities, the King Crab carries a LRM-15 launcher, mounted in the left torso and fed by one ton of reloads in the same location, and a Large Laser in the right torso. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

content.original: Described as a "Warhammer on steroids", the Defiance is visually similar to the original WHM-6R and carries a similar weapons array. Where it differs from the classic design is in the use of digitigrade instead of humanoid legs, and modern construction components such as an endo steel skeleton, light fusion engine, and triple strength myomers. Due in part to the high heat levels required by its specialized myomers, as well as weight constraints, the Defiance carries only twelve double heat sinks, forcing it to rely upon volley fire to avoid shutdown, much like the design upon which it was based.

content.original: The primitive Eisenfaust EFT-2 model was intended to carry the AC/10 into a siege or defensive engagement. This simple design mandate was quickly warped into an entirely different machine. For close work the 'Mech carried two medium lasers while a large laser provided long range and ammunition free firepower. The Coventry Defense Conglomerate was unable to overcome the inherent limitations of primitive technology however, resulting in a thinly armored and clumsy 'Mech that could only reach a top speed of 32 km/h. The single ton of ammunition provided to the Eisenfaust's main weapon didn't help. The CDC only produced one prototype unit for the LCAF. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.83

content.original: The Eisenfaust was originally designed shortly after the Lyran Commonwealth began building 'Mechs. Based on their experience with the Commando and Ymir, the LCAF tried to build a medium class "siege engine" 'Mech. Though the trials looked promising, the battlefield performance of the early Eisenfaust was poor and the design was canceled. After the recovery of lostech and advanced SLDF technologies, Defiance Industries looked at the early Eisenfaust design again. The updated Eisenfaust entered production after simulations showed it could be an effective battlefield unit if equipped with updated technologies. In fact the Eisenfaust was one of the first designs to enter production after the start of the Jihad

Though reducing the 'Mech's maximum ground speed to 50 km/h, this frees up the weight to increase the armor to fifteen and half tons, add a C3 master computer and swap the SRM-4s for a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers, while retaining the same volume of missile and autocannon ammunition. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

content.original: A melding of the popular Star League era Thug and the poorly regarded Charger, the samurai-themed Hatamoto-Chi was the first post–Succession Wars Draconis Combine BattleMech constructed utilizing recovered LosTech. Tasked by Kanrei Theodore Kurita to reverse engineer examples of the advanced Star League Defense Force BattleMechs provided by ComStar in 3035 for future production, Luthien Armor Works secretly mated the weaponry of the Thug to the form of the maligned Charger. While initially unable to mass produce the advanced Endo Steel chassis required to match the Thug, the appearance of the early Hatamoto-Chi and their endless variations born of the Charger's spacious torso sent the combined Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth into confusion during the War of 3039.

content.content: Являясь смесью популярного Thug эпохи Звездной Лиги и не пользующегося популярностью Charger, Hatamoto-Chi в стиле самураев был первым боевым мехом Синдиката Дракона, построенным после Наследных войн с использованием восстановленного лостеха. По поручению канреи Теодора Куриты провести обратную разработку образцов передовых боевых мехов СОЗЛ, предоставленных КомСтаром в 3035 году для будущего производства, Luthien Armor Works тайно соединила вооружение Thug с обликом злосчастного Charger. Хотя изначально компания не могла массово производить передовые шасси из эндостали, необходимые для Thug, появление ранних Hatamoto-Chi и их бесконечных вариаций, созданных на основе просторного корпуса Charger, привело к замешательству в объединенных вооруженных силах Федеративного Содружества во время войны 3039 года.

The left torso also holds six medium pulse lasers. The right arm carries a large sword. Triple-Strength Myomer greatly increase the damage done by the blade. Only ten double heat sinks are used, allowing the TSM to remain active. Quirk: Way of the Samurai Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

content.original: Trading the Hermes II's AC/5, medium laser and flamer for missile racks and an upgraded laser, the Liberator offered a harder punch. Carrying an LRM-5 in each arm as primary weapons supported by a center torso mounted large laser, an SRM-2 rack fitted to the 'Mech's left torso provided close-range backup. A single ton of LRM and SRM reloads gave the design reasonable endurance in the field, with designers determining on paper that volley fire alternating between the missile launchers with the laser to easily manage the 'Mech's heat load. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.original: The primitive Eisenfaust EFT-2 model was intended to carry the AC/10 into a siege or defensive engagement. This simple design mandate was quickly warped into an entirely different machine. For close work the 'Mech carried two medium lasers while a large laser provided long range and ammunition free firepower. The Coventry Defense Conglomerate was unable to overcome the inherent limitations of primitive technology however, resulting in a thinly armored and clumsy 'Mech that could only reach a top speed of 32 km/h. The single ton of ammunition provided to the Eisenfaust's main weapon didn't help. The CDC only produced one prototype unit for the LCAF. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.83

content.original: Paying tribute to other highly successful Clan Wolf designs, the Blood Reaper is a symbolic and straightforward second-line BattleMech in heavy use in the post-Jihad Clan Wolf touman. Seeking to standardize his forces and weed out non-Wolf designs, Khan Vlad Ward ordered his scientists to develop a rugged yet symbolic 'Mech for warriors of Clan Wolf to rally around. A standard BattleMech in the mold of the successful Tundra Wolf, the Blood Reaper first entered service in 3079 and went on to form a large part of the Wolves' post-Jihad touman. Khan Ward overcame the stigma of a second-line machine with classic Clan posturing; by insisting that warriors truly worthy of the spirit of the Wolf would win even while being hobbled by such a design.

content.original: The No-Dachi was designed by Cosby as a test bed for two new technologies. The first was the Sword. The seven-meter long katana that the 'Mech wields was designed to counter the Hatchet used by some Federated Commonwealth 'Mechs. Because the samurai mindset had been so successfully drilled into the warriors of the Draconis Combine, they were loathe to use a ''barbaric'' ax. The second new technology was the Triple Strength Myomer that had been pioneered by the Federated Suns. The new melee weapon, combined with the improved myomers, make the No-Dachi a dangerous in-fighter.

content.original: The Scarabus is a 'Mech that was designed to be faster than the Locust, with more firepower. The 'Mech achieves this with a massive 300 XL engine, built on a endo steel chassis. These lightweight technologies allow it to move at a maximum speed of 162 km/h and still have weight left over for heavier weaponry and equipment. To protect its internals and save even more weight, the 'Mech is armored with five and a half tons of Valiant Gauntlet ferro-fibrous armor.

content.original: The 9B variant of the Scarabus is built using Triple Strength Myomer to enhance the 'Mech's speed and strength once in the proper heat range. This enhances the 'Mech's top speed to a maximum of 183.6 km/h and also increases the sheer amount of damage that the Scarabus is capable of doing with its hatchet. The only other change is the conversion to use double heat sinks for improved cooling, something that can be seen as counterproductive for the added TSM. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The Screamer LAM is a prototype Land-Air 'Mech which was produced during the reign of Emperor Stefan Amaris when his forces were occupying the Terran Hegemony in late Star League Era. The design shares the same tonnage as the Shadow Hawk LAM. The 'Mech was built as a harasser and quick strike machine. Unlike the original prototype LAM, the Screamer was able to transition into a fighter, 'Mech, or AirMech modes. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

content.original: The 2K variant has been altered to be even more dangerous in close quarters. The advantages are at the expense of its long-range weaponry, however. The ER PPC is downgraded to an ER Large Laser and the MRM-20s to MRM-10s. The resulting weight savings are used to upgrade the medium laser to a Medium Pulse Laser and add four more of the same. The remaining tonnage is devoted to an additional double heat sink, a Guardian ECM Suite, a single Small Laser, and more armor. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper

content.original: The Scarabus is equipped with a close range weapons arsenal, with the primary weapons being a pair of medium lasers backed up by a pair of small lasers. To defend itself when the 'Mech gets into extremely close range combat, the Scarabus carries a two ton hatchet, which allows it to cleave into an enemy's armor. The 'Mech is also equipped with a Guardian ECM suite to protect itself from advanced electronic detection equipment when scouting against an enemy, and mounts a TAG to designate targets for Arrow IV artillery attacks. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The Achileus was jointly designed by scientists from the Free Worlds League and Word of Blake with the goal of creating a light battle armor suit that could be mass produced. Inspired by the Federated Commonwealth's ultimately flawed Infiltrator Mk. I, the research team used the Blakist Tornado PA(L) as the basis for the new suit while seeking to overcome some of its defects. The resulting Achileus manages to add armoring, weaponry and integrated jump jets while still maintaining its stealth aspects. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Ахиллес» был разработан совместно учеными из Лиги Свободных Миров и Слова Блейка с целью создания легкой боевой брони, которую можно было бы производить серийно. Вдохновленные по итогу ставшим неудачным проектом Infiltrator Mk.I от ФедСода, исследователи использовали Tornado PA(L) блейкистов в качестве основы для новой брони, стремясь устранить некоторые из его недостатков. В результате Achileus получил дополнительную защиту, вооружение и встроенные прыжковые двигатели, сохранив при этом свои стелс-характеристики. Особенность: Налётчик Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.886 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

В результате Achileus получил дополнительную защиту, вооружение и встроенные прыжковые двигатели, сохранив при этом свои стелс-характеристики. Особенность: Налётчик Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.886 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Khan Marthe Pryde decided to upgrade the 'Mechs her Clan fielded. Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. The design the scientists chose to modify was the Adder. Though the two 'Mechs are visually similar and share the same weight, the Cougar is slower and better armed.
content.prevOriginal: Khan Marthe Pryde decided to upgrade the 'Mechs her Clan fielded. Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. The design the scientists chose to modify was the Adder. Though the two 'Mechs are visually similar and share the same weight, the Cougar is slower and better armed.
content.content: Хан Марта Прайд решила модернизировать мехи, которые использовал ее клан. Вместо того, чтобы тратить драгоценные ресурсы на разработку нового омнимеха с нуля, она поручила своим ученым усовершенствовать существующие конструкции. Ученые решили модифицировать Adder. Хотя эти два меха визуально похожи и имеют одинаковый вес, Cougar более медленный и лучше вооружен.

content.original: A prototype LAM, the Ajax was a next generation Star League design. Following relatively successful initial trials, the Amaris Civil War rendered the design extinct, with production and testing ceasing due to the war. Designed to be easy to maintain, the Ajax uses pod mounted weapons similar to the modular weapons designed for the Mercury scout 'Mech. Though able to switch modes faster than standard LAM designs, particularly heavy loadouts still hinder the Ajax's speed and versatility. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.content: Прототипный LAM, Ajax, был разработан Звёздной Лигой как модель нового поколения. После относительно успешных первых испытаний, гражданская война Амариса привела к прекращению производства и испытаний этой модели. Ajax был разработан с учетом простоты обслуживания и оснащён оружием, установленным в модулях, аналогичных модульному оружию, разработанному для развед меха Mercury. Несмотря на то, что Ajax может переключаться между режимами быстрее, чем стандартные модели LAM, тяжелый обвес все же снижает его скорость и универсальность. Особенность: Мех «земля-воздух» Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05
