content.content: «Игорь» — это название универсальной сверхтяжёлой транспортной платформы, распространённой по всей Внутренней Сфере. Изначально разработанная для быстрой перевозки тяжёлой бронетехники в условиях боя, эта конструкция с тех пор породила множество подражателей и клонов, и практически в каждом развитом мире Внутренней Сферы и Периферии есть хотя бы один «Игорь» или его клон. Боевая модель 60-тонного VTOL «Игорь» (L-Gauss) в версии FWL оснащена парой лёгких пушек Гаусса и блоком C3 Slave. Сочетание двигателя XL и ферроволоконной брони повышает скорость и защиту VTOL. content.original: Initially produced by the Quikscell Company in 2807, the Scorpion Light Tank is famously easy to repair, available in numbers, and best of all, cheap. Only marginally effective on it's merits, the Scorpion has proven effective in mass numbers. Swarms of Scorpions, easily procured due to their low cost, are an often-encountered danger on poorer worlds. The vehicle is produced on many planets within the Inner Sphere. Many local variations, upgrades, and downgrades as required by circumstance are in use. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: Armor (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 140 15 Left 80 15 Right 80 15 Rear 60 15 Turret 120 15 Total 480 75 Quirk: Protected Mechanisms

content.content: Первоначально произведенный компанией Quicsell в 2807 году, легкий танк «Скорпион» известен тем, что его легко ремонтировать, он доступен в большом количестве и, что самое главное, дешев. Мало эффективный сам по себе, «Скорпион» хорошо показывает себя в группе. Рои «Скорпионов», которые легко достать из-за их низкой стоимости, часто представляют опасность для небогатых миров. Машина производится на многих планетах Внутренней Сферы. Используется множество местных вариаций, апгрейдов и даунгрейдов в зависимости от обстоятельств. Ограничения биома: нет. Made obsolete by the development of the Mackie and other new weapons, surviving Stalkers can very rarely be found serving in deep periphery defence units. The Stalker is a 75 ton tank powered by a 300 rated Fuel Cell and armed with a pair of AC/5s and a Mortar. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. content.original: The Achileus was jointly designed by scientists from the Free Worlds League and Word of Blake with the goal of creating a light battle armor suit that could be mass produced. Inspired by the Federated Commonwealth's ultimately flawed Infiltrator Mk. I, the research team used the Blakist Tornado PA(L) as the basis for the new suit while seeking to overcome some of its defects. The resulting Achileus manages to add armoring, weaponry and integrated jump jets while still maintaining its stealth aspects. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
content.prevOriginal: The Achileus was jointly designed by scientists from the Free Worlds League and Word of Blake with the goal of creating a light battle armor suit that could be mass produced. I, the research team used the Blakist Tornado PA(L) as the basis for the new suit while seeking to overcome some of its defects. The resulting Achileus manages to add armoring, weaponry and integrated jump jets while still maintaining its stealth aspects. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
content.content: «Ахиллес» был разработан совместно учеными из Лиги Свободных Миров и Слова Блейка с целью создания легкой боевой брони, которую можно было бы производить серийно. Вдохновленные по итогу ставшим неудачным проектом Infiltrator Mk.I от ФедСода, исследователи использовали Tornado PA(L) блейкистов в качестве основы для новой брони, стремясь устранить некоторые из его недостатков. В результате Achileus получил дополнительную защиту, вооружение и встроенные прыжковые двигатели, сохранив при этом свои стелс-характеристики. Особенность: Налётчик Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.886 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

В результате Achileus получил дополнительную защиту, вооружение и встроенные прыжковые двигатели, сохранив при этом свои стелс-характеристики. Особенность: Налётчик Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.886 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Achileus was jointly designed by scientists from the Free Worlds League and Word of Blake with the goal of creating a light battle armor suit that could be mass produced. Inspired by the Federated Commonwealth's ultimately flawed Infiltrator Mk. I, the research team used the Blakist Tornado PA(L) as the basis for the new suit while seeking to overcome some of its defects. The resulting Achileus manages to add armoring, weaponry and integrated jump jets while still maintaining its stealth aspects. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.889 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: A prototype LAM, the Ajax was a next generation Star League design. Following relatively successful initial trials, the Amaris Civil War rendered the design extinct, with production and testing ceasing due to the war. Designed to be easy to maintain, the Ajax uses pod mounted weapons similar to the modular weapons designed for the Mercury scout 'Mech. Though able to switch modes faster than standard LAM designs, particularly heavy loadouts still hinder the Ajax's speed and versatility. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.content: Прототипный LAM, Ajax, был разработан Звёздной Лигой как модель нового поколения. После относительно успешных первых испытаний, гражданская война Амариса привела к прекращению производства и испытаний этой модели. Ajax был разработан с учетом простоты обслуживания и оснащён оружием, установленным в модулях, аналогичных модульному оружию, разработанному для развед меха Mercury. Несмотря на то, что Ajax может переключаться между режимами быстрее, чем стандартные модели LAM, тяжелый обвес все же снижает его скорость и универсальность. Особенность: Мех «земля-воздух» Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

content.original: The Cavalier is a battle armor suit built in response to sagging morale in the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth, due in large part to the secession of the Lyran state from the Federated Commonwealth. Although originally heavily based on the Inner Sphere Standard, the redesign turned out to be more than cosmetic: the redistribution of armor plating had increased leg protection at the expense of upper body protection. While there were some misgivings, in the final analysis it was discovered these alterations also gave superior dexterity to the trooper compared to that of the Standard. Reluctantly the officers in charge agreed that the benefits outweighed the drawbacks and approved mass production of the suit, which started in June of that same year. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Кавалер» — это боевой доспех, созданный в ответ на падение морального духа в Вооружённых силах Федеративного Содружества, во многом вызванное отделением Лиранской части государства от Федеративного Содружества. Хотя изначально он был в значительной степени основан на «Стандарте Внутренней Сферы», переделка оказалась более чем косметической: перераспределение броневых пластин увеличило защиту ног за счёт защиты верхней части тела. Хотя были некоторые опасения, в конечном итоге было обнаружено, что эти изменения также дали солдату превосходную ловкость по сравнению со «Стандартом». С неохотой ответственные офицеры согласились, что преимущества перевешивают недостатки, и одобрили массовое производство костюма, которое началось в июне того же года. Особенность: Шустрый Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Corona is a battle armor design that was created by Clan Star Adder following the Trials to determine which Clans would take part in Operation REVIVAL. The idea was to build the battlesuit around a weapon that could threaten 'Mechs from a distance. The mass necessary to mount such a heavy weapon resulted in a twenty percent armor decrease and the removal of the jump pack, despite a fifty percent overall increase in mass. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: «Корона» — это проект боевой брони, созданный кланом Звёздного Ужа после серии испытаний, определивших, какие кланы получат право на участие в операции «Возрождение». Идея заключалась в том, чтобы создать боекостюм с оружием, способным поражать мехи на расстоянии. Масса, необходимая для установки столь тяжёлого оружия, привела к снижению брони на 20% и удалению прыжкового ранца, несмотря на общее увеличение массы на 50%. Особенность: Устрашающий Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.935 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

Это было чудо инженерной мысли Кланов, позволившее небольшой группе воинов в броне уничтожить большие мехи и выжить. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
content.content: Боевая броня Elemental, являющаяся стандартом, по которому измеряется вся боевая броня, была впервые представлена в 2868 году кланом Волка в ходе испытания владения против Нова Котов. Это было чудо инженерной мысли Кланов, позволившее небольшой группе воинов в броне уничтожить большие мехи и выжить. Хотя боевая броня может использоваться и людьми нормального роста, их конструкция разработана специально для гигантских воинов-элементалей Кланов, и только они могут раскрыть их потенциал в полной мере. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.93 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Named for the demonic wolf of Germanic myth, the Fenrir was less a traditional battle suit and more a mobile fire support platform. The trooper controlling the suit was situated inside a cramped "cockpit" and piloted the Fenrir like a small walking tank. The single, configurable turret mounted on the suit could accept a wide variety of weapon configurations and the Fenrir's sturdy, powerful legs could propel it to much greater speeds than the Sloth. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.original: Created during the Golden Century by Clan Sea Fox, the CS-1 Fox had few equals. The 50-ton Mech was powered by a 300-rated cXL engine, that propelled the Mech to speeds of 97 km/h. Protected by 10 tons of armor, the CS-1 Fox was armed with a pair of Improved LRM-15’s. At closer ranges, a trio of Medium Lasers, a pair of Streak SRM-2’s and a pair of Machine Guns provided additional firepower. Production of the Fox mysteriously stopped partway through the Golden Century as the Mech was dropped from use in the Sea Fox Touman. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

Защищенный 10 тоннами брони, CS-1 Fox был вооружен парой усовершенствованных LRM-15. На ближних дистанциях дополнительную огневую мощь обеспечивали три средних лазера, пара Streak SRM-2 и пара пулеметов. content.original: Though Gray Death Scout armor has no integral weapons, its Armored Gloves allow soldiers to wield standard small arms and perform other functions as normal. While this does not allow for very much damage potential against hardened targets, a scout squad can be a serious threat to unarmored infantry. The armored gloves, in combination with the suit's strength enhancements, allows the trooper to ride on OmniMechs via their handholds or perform anti-'Mech attacks. That the trooper's natural dexterity is otherwise unaffected by the suit is an added bonus for placing Satchel Charges in exposed 'Mech joints. Quirk: Information Gatherer Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Gray Death Standard battle armor was developed by the technicians of the Gray Death Legion after the New Avalon Institute of Science sent them prototype battle armor suits, the progenitors of what eventually became the Inner Sphere Standard, for field testing. Using what was learned from these tests, the Legion decided to remove the suits' jump jets to make room for dedicated anti-infantry firepower, superior sensor systems, and reinforced myomer bundles to improve ground speed. While losing the ability to leap over obstacles, these changes made the suit easier to maintain and cheaper to build than the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня Gray Death Standard была разработана техниками Gray Death Legion после того, как Институт науки Нового Авалона отправил им для полевых испытаний костюмы боевой брони, ставших предвестниками того, что впоследствии стало «Стандартом Внутренней Сферы». Используя результаты этих испытаний, Легион решил убрать прыжковые двигатели, чтобы освободить место для вооружения конкретно против пехоты, усовершенствованных сенсорных систем и усиленных пучков миомеров для повышения скорости движения. Несмотря на потерю способности перепрыгивать через препятствия, эти изменения сделали доспех более простым в обслуживании и более дешевым в производстве, чем «Стандарт Внутренней Сферы». Особенность: Intuitive Controls Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: A Nova Cat design, the 50 ton Huntsman was designed for Operation Revival and the invasion of the Inner Sphere; first entering production in 3049. An OmniMech, the Huntsman is built around a 250-rated XL Engine with an Endo Steel Skeleton and Ferro-Fibrous armor giving the OmniMech, 21.5 tons of pod space. 5 Jump Jets are fixed to the chassis, giving the Huntsman additional flexibility. The Huntsman Prime is armed with a UAC/2 and an Artemis IV enhanced LRM-10. 4 ER Medium Lasers, a Streak SRM-6, Flamer and a pair of A-Pods provide additional firepower at close range. A combination of a TAG and an Active Probe allow the Huntsman to scout or spot for allied units. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The original prototype Icarus was developed at the Happen Military Reservation on Xanthe III in 2466, and was first deployed on Alula Australis in 2469. Its premiere date in official documents is listed as 2470. The prototype used primitive equipment and lacked jump jets. It had a Large Laser to complement the Small Laser. Two SRM-2s and twin Machine Guns could prove devastating to conventional troops. Only six of these were ever produced and they are all long gone. The primitive engine drove it to a maximum of 64 km/h. Ten and a half tons of Primitive Armor provided protection. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: Created in the late twenty-ninth century, the Icestorm is an incredibly fast BattleMech that is used as a scout and a spotter. It is based on the Cameroon, a Star League design that was modified by Clan Ice Hellion Khan Stephan Cage. Its speed is its defense, not its paltry three and a half tons of standard armor, and its meager weapons do not tax the ten single heat sinks. The Icestorm still sees use in the majority of Hellion Galaxies, though Clan Wolf also maintains a fair number in their garrison Clusters. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.original: The Infiltrator Mk. II is a battle armor suit designed as a replacement for the earlier Infiltrator Mk. I. With better armament and protection than its predecessor, the Mk. II was superior in all ways except cost. A battle armor-scale Magshot rifle provides firepower while an anti-infantry SMG provides light defense. A suite of stealth armor keeps the suit protected on the field. The only serious downside is the slow ground speed of the Mk. II, though jump jets help keep the suit semi-mobile. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Инфильтратор Mk II» - это боевая броня, разработанная в качестве замены более ранней модели Infiltrator Mk I. Обладая лучшим вооружением и защитой, Mk II превзошёл своего предшественника по всем параметрам, кроме стоимости. Боевая винтовка Magshot обеспечивает огневую мощь, а противопехотный SMG - легкую защиту. Защиту на поле боя обеспечивает и комплект стелс-брони. Единственным серьезным недостатком Mk II является низкая скорость передвижения по земле, хотя прыжковые двигатели позволяют поддерживать какую-никакую мобильность. Особенность: Налётчик Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The only weapon on the Infiltrator is a Grenade Launcher carried in the left arm. Firing a burst of five grenades at once, the launcher has limited offensive value against most combat units. The right arm ends in a Basic Manipulator, however the Infiltrator is not set up for making anti-'Mech attacks or being transported via OmniMech. While it can achieve a top speed of 21.6 km/h, the suit has an ungainly gait, likened to a "waddling toy robot", and hence its nickname of the "Waddler". Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Стандарт Внутренней Сферы был разработан после вторжения Кланов, когда державы Внутренней Сферы спешили воспроизвести технологию боевой брони Кланов. Однако, не имея никаких частей с полей сражений, инженеры были вынуждены работать на основе древних слухов о ранних силовых бронекостюмах типа Nighthawk, больше похожих на бронированные экзоскелеты, чем на тех «жаб», что встречались им в настоящее время, и их прототипы плохо показывали себя во время испытаний. Настоящий толчок в изучении боевой брони дали трофеи с первых побед над Кланами. Научный институт Нового Авалона первым частично воспроизвел броню элементалей в виде Стандарта Внутренней Сферы. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Kage (translating to "shadow" in japanese) light battle armor was one of the first battle armor designs produced by the Draconis Combine after the Truce of Tukayyid. Built for reconnaissance and battlefield infiltration, development of the Kage was a joint operation between Internal Security Force scientists and Draconis Elite Strike Team advisers. Indeed the Kage was meant to provide an alternative to the much-respected DEST Infiltration Suit for missions in which DEST teams could expect heavy opposition, and since production started in 3056 the battle armor has virtually replaced the older Sneak Suit. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Лёгкая боевая броня «Каге» (что в переводе с японского означает «тень») была одним из первых образцов боевой брони, созданных Синдикатом Дракона после Туккаидского перемирия. Разработанная для разведки и проникновения на поле боя, «Каге» стала совместной операцией учёных Сил Внутренней Безопасности и советников Элитной ударной группы Дракона (DEST). «Каге» задумывался как альтернатива высоко ценимому Infiltration бронекостюму DEST для миссий, в которых отряды DEST могли ожидать серьёзного сопротивления, и с начала производства в 3056 году эта боевая броня фактически заменила устаревший Sneak Suit. Особенность: Налётчик Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.886 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

Built around a 390-rated XL Engine, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel give the OmniMech 17.5 tons of free pod space. The Linebacker LBK-Prime is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s. content.original: The Nighthawk Mk. XXI is a PA(L) design and the progenitor of modern battle armor. The original Nighthawk was based upon exoskeletons originally used for commercial purposes during the Star League. It took fifteen years and twenty prototypes before the SLDF finally perfected the design that would eventually be produced. A working prototype was first introduced in 2718, which was followed by two years of field testing and, finally, full production, entering service with the Special Forces Command. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8832 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: Reconfigured for greater speed, the 9FC variant of the Nightstar replaces the two Gauss Rifles with a pair of LB-X Autocannon/10s that are not as destructive as the weapons they replace, but can use both standard and cluster ammunition, making them effective in a variety of roles. The Small Laser has also been upgraded and the Medium Pulse Lasers downgraded, giving the Nightstar a total of three medium lasers. To make the 'Mech fit better into the mobile warfare doctrine of the Federated Suns and Federated Commonwealth, the 9FC model has used the saved weight to upgrade its engine, giving it a top speed of 64.8 km/h. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17

content.original: The Pack Hunter is the first new design produced by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal. It also represents a new partnership between Phelan's Wolves and the Kell Hounds, as the armor and communications gear are Kell Hound products, traded to the Wolves in exchange for Endo Steel. Reflecting their Khan's bias towards light, fast designs, Wolf scientists designed the Pack Hunter to be fast and have a sharp bite. Though its four tons of armor are light, the BattleMech is supposed to use its speed and maneuverability to stay out of trouble. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.content: «Пак Хантер» — первый новый проект, созданный кланом Волка-в-изгнании на Арк-Ройяле. Он также представляет собой результат нового партнёрства между Волками Фелана и Гончими Келла, поскольку броня и средства связи изготовлены Гончими и были переданы Волкам в обмен на эндосталь. Следуя за стремлением их хана к лёгким и быстрым конструкциям, учёные Волка разработали Pack Hunter таким образом, чтобы он был быстрым и обладал болючим укусом. Несмотря на лёгкость четырёхтонной брони, этот боевой мех должен использовать свою скорость и манёвренность, чтобы оставаться в стороне от неприятностей. Особенность: Укреплённые ноги Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

content.original: The Phoenix Hawk LAM was the largest Land-Air 'Mech produced during the Star League. Allied Aerospace reworked their designs for conversion equipment and the size of the LAM, learning from their mistake with the Shadow Hawk LAM and the success of the Stinger LAM. The resulting LAM was the largest LAM ever constructed capable of remaining in AirMech mode. Unfortunately, large Land-Air 'Mech conversion technology was not fully researched before the fall of the Star League, and the Phoenix Hawk LAM frequently met its end due to the occasional glitch. The end of the Star League and destruction of the Allied Aerospace facilities at the beginning of the First Succession War prevented further development and refinement. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04

content.original: The Piranha's main threat is its twelve Series XII Rotary Machine Guns. These are a serious threat to any foe on such a speedy 'Mech, especially if a Star of Piranhas operate in a pack, and such a large array allows the 'Mech to chew through an opponent's rear armor almost instantly. They are most deadly, however, to unarmored infantry, capable of wiping out an entire company in seconds. For work against hardened targets, the Piranha mounts a pair of Mk. 3 ER Medium Lasers and a single Series 1 ER Small Laser. Since the design only uses ten single heat sinks, the MechWarrior must still manage heat levels. The ammunition dependency of the Machine Guns ensure that Piranhas must stay close to supply lines, so most have been relegated to solahma or garrison roles. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01

Not only can the lasers keep the symmetrical design in the fight after its autocannon ammunition runs out, they do not create a burden on the 'Mech's ability to control heat under normal circumstances. content.original: As a BattleMech design the Reconquista was a mixed-bag. Its numerous faulty components included the internal combustion engine, myomer, chassis, spare parts, controls and software. The Reconquista's slow speed and limited agility were also severe weaknesses exploited by Umayyad artillery and tanks. On the other hand, the armor, heat sinks and mix of weaponry (autocannon, machine gun and long-range missiles) proved adequate, and the 'Mech could be built in (relatively) large enough numbers at a critical time of the invasion. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Rhino was an early attempt made by Clan Hell's Horses to develop true battle armor during the Golden Century. The Rhino's weapons layout and equipment was similar to the Elemental (Battle Armor), but was not as capable as the later machine. Its weapons ranges were shorter and it lacked maneuverability and speed. However, the armor was greater than what the Elemental battlesuit would carry. In addition, while the suit's SRM 2 was easy to use and reload, it had a significant jamming issue. This issue would cause catastrophic ammo explosions dealing major damage to the suit and the pilot (for an example, see Bertram). Engineers tried to resolve the issue, but the Rhino was shelved before the issue could be rectified. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.original: The Sarissa MN1-K was armed simply. It carried a battery of lasers, one large and several medium, and mounted as much armor as could be fi tted with the remaining weight budget. Though truly a BattleMech, it drew heavily on a century of IndustrialMech construction experience and was often assembled in civilian facilities. The result was a mechanically reliable and durable machine ideal for Marik militias with little BattleMech training, but otherwise not terribly impressive. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.82

content.original: The Shadow Hawk IIC is a second-line Clan BattleMech based upon the Shadow Hawk that was first fielded by the Star League. The first version of the Shadow Hawk IIC is meant for close-range fighting, and appears to be designed with urban warfare in mind. It is armed with a Medium Pulse Laser in each arm, two Streak SRM-2 launchers in each side torso, an ER Medium Laser in the head, and an ER Small Laser in the torso. Ten double heat sinks take care of most heat, especially since the Streaks will build no heat if they do not achieve a lock and fire. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

Первая версия Shadow Hawk IIC предназначена для ближнего боя и, по всей видимости, разработана с учётом городских условий. Она вооружена средним импульсным лазером в каждой руке, двумя пусковыми установками Streak SRM-2 в каждом полуторсе, средним ER-лазером в голове и малым ER-лазером в торсе. Десять двойных охладителей отводят большую часть тепла, особенно учитывая, что Streak не нагреваются, если не захватят цель и не откроют огонь. Особенность: Боевые кулаки Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.07

content.original: The Shadow Hawk IIC is a second-line Clan BattleMech based upon the Shadow Hawk that was first fielded by the Star League. A newer variant that dates to the late 3050s, the IIC 3's primary weapon is a Heavy Large Laser, supplemented by a Medium Pulse Laser. The 'Mech carries paired ER Micro Lasers and Micro Pulse Lasers should it find itself in a close range fight. Four additional double heat sinks keep down the heat generated by the all-laser complement. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: The Shadow Hawk IIC is a second-line Clan BattleMech based upon the Shadow Hawk that was first fielded by the Star League. First fielded in 3060, the IIC 4 was a joint effort by Clan Nova Cat and Clan Diamond Shark to upgrade their second-line forces. The result was a 'Mech that is visually very different from the design it is considered a variant of. This 'Mech carries a ATM 6 System with three tons of varied ammunition to allow for flexibility of choice. The missile launcher is backed up by two Medium Pulse Lasers and an ER Medium Laser. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

content.original: The original and considerably flawed prototypes were completed in 2680. Based on the Shadow Hawk SHD-2H, the 'Mech carried a Class 2 Autocannon in place of the Class 5. The SHD-X1 carried only 6.5 tons of armor for protection. Only one chassis survived multiple crashes caused by its faulty schematics. It had a top ground speed of 86.4 km/h like its progenitor, the SHD-2H, and used ten single heat sinks. Field refits to increase firepower with wing-mounted weapons were common, but often caused more problems than they solved. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.content: Оригинал и имеющие некоторые недостатки прототипы были завершены в 2680 году. Созданный на основе Shadow Hawk SHD-2H, мех нёс автопушку АС2 вместо АС5. SHD-X1 нес всего 6,5 тонн брони. Только одно шасси выжило после ряда аварий, вызванных неисправной схемой. Как и SHD-2H, его предшественник, он развивал максимальную скорость 86,4 км/ч и оснащался десятью одинарными охладителями. Полевые модификации для увеличения огневой мощи за счёт установки крыльевого вооружения были обычным явлением, но зачастую создавали больше проблем, чем решали. Особенность: Мех «земля-воздух» Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

content.original: Allied Aerospace won the SLDF's contract to produce a series of Land-Air mechs with a design based on the venerable Shadow HawkBattleMech. Allied gave their new Land-Air 'Mech the ability to convert directly into an Aerospace Fighter. While construction was completed in 2680, thanks to the chassis' numerous flaws, lackluster performance and a number of ill-fated and publicly witnessed test-flights disasters during SLDF reviews in 2682, Allied Aerospace was forced to go back to the drawing board. The more refined X2 variant faced considerable scrutiny by SLDF evaluators in 2684, successfully meeting the SLDF's requirements but still rejected thanks to its high fuel consumption and the bad press generated by the earlier X1. Twenty SHD-X2 were built for trials with potential customers, but failed to attract any interest. Ultimately Allied scrapped the Shadow Hawk LAM program in favor of what became the considerably more successful Phoenix Hawk LAM. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The 2D2 is an upgrade of the -2D Shadow Hawk introduced in 3049, born of the Federated Commonwealth buying original-model 2Hs from Majesty Metals and refitting them for use by militia forces or for sale to mercenaries. Like the 2D this upgrade adds another SRM launcher to the center torso and a medium laser to the left arm, however both center torso and head launchers are Federated SuperStreak Streak SRM-2s. Besides carrying slightly more armor, a total of six and a half tons, and one ton of Streak ammo in the right torso, it is otherwise identical to the 2D Shadow Hawk. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

Built on the standard SHD-2H chassis, the original 275-rated Fusion Core is retained along with the pair of arm mounted Medium Lasers. Replacing the AC/5 is a Large Laser, while 5 Streak SRM-2’s and a ton of ammo replace the original missile launchers. Created as cover for the 2Hb program, the SHD-3H is a stock Shadow Hawk refitted for anti-insurgent work. A pair of Machine Guns and a ton of ammo replace the original SRM-2. The design can still be seen well into the 31st century with units lacking supplies often being forced to convert damaged 2H models to the 3H standard. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: An offshoot of the SHD-3H design, the Shadow Hawk SHD-3H2 is a full redesign of the 3H model. Intended for Terran Hegemony militia units, the 3H2 is optimised for anti-vehicle and anti-insurgent warfare. Somewhat slower then a standard Shadow Hawk due to the replacement of the 275 rated engine with a 220 rated one, the 3H2 uses the extra weight to pack in a pair of Small Lasers, 3 SRM-4 launchers and a Vehicular Grenade Launcher. Leftover Ferro-Fibrous armour from the Royal SHD-2Hb production line is used to improve armour protection. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The 5M Shadow Hawk is the first complete overhaul and upgrade of the design, unveiled in 3048 by Earthwerks for the Free Worlds League. The chassis has been upgraded to an Earthwerks SHD II Endo Steel frame, an additional ton of armor was added, two additional jump jets were fitted for a total jumping distance of 150 meters, the engine replaced with an extralight version of the Hermes 275, and the weapons load has undergone an almost complete renovation. The original autocannon has been updated to an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5, the LRM launcher to a Doombud LRM-20, and the head-mounted SRM launcher to a Hovertec Streak SRM-2. The amount of ammunition carried and the left-arm medium laser are maintained, and while the number of heat sinks was reduced to ten these were upgrade to double-strength models. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: This heavy scout variant carries a large laser in the right arm, a pair of medium lasers in each side torso, and a medium pulse laser with a coaxially mounted TAG system in the left arm. The left and right torso carry a Guardian ECM suite and a Beagle active probe, respectively, and a half ton of cargo space is provided in the head, probably for supplies on long reconnaissance missions. The most interesting change, however, is the use of a more powerful 330-rated XL engine that gives a top speed of 97.2 km/h which, when combined with five jump jets allowing 150 meter leaps, allows the 'Mech to get out of tight spots. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Inner Sphere adapted to battle armor quickly after being introduced to the concept by the Clan Elemental suit, so much so that the IS started innovating and testing the limits of what was possible almost immediately. In the 3050s the Lyran Commonwealth led the charge with this, the Sloth, the first quadruped battle armor. The Lyrans armed each suit with two Small Lasers and a BA-scale Pop-Up Mine, a weapon designed to penetrate armor and deal direct internal damage. The Sloth proved dangerous but unwieldy to control, making it unpopular with pilots. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

This version used an Extra-light Engine to mount a pair of Thunderstroke Series 2b Gauss Rifles along the top of the 'Mech. Each arm carried a Series 4D-2 Heavy Large Laser, a Series 22a Heavy Medium Laser, and a General Systems Heavy Small Laser. It retained the shock-absorbing cowls of the original. Another pair of Heavy Mediums protected the rear of the 'Mech. A head-mounted Shield-3 Anti-Missile System defended against missiles, while an Anti-Personnel Pod in each leg discouraged unarmored infantry. This design had jump jets, nineteen tons of armor, and a meager sixteen double heat sinks. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Sylph was created by Clan Cloud Cobra to augment their vast aerospace forces with a fully-airborne battle armor suit. Naming it after elemental spirits representing air, development of the suit was driven as much by the Cloud Cobra's faith as it was by Khan Din Steiner's orders. Despite their scientist caste's vast knowledge of aircraft, the Clan had a great deal of trouble getting the VTOL capabilities of the Sylph to function, with a number of test pilots dying during its secretive development. As it is, the Sylph only possesses limited flight capabilities, but even this remains an impressive accomplishment. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.9475 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Tornado is a Power Armor (Light) suit, created by ComStar in the late twenty-ninth century to equip their special forces units with added protection. The Tornado is based on the Star League Defense Force Nighthawk suit which, though they had acquired several, ComStar at the time was unable to produce. It incorporates stealth armor and an adaptive Camo System which mimics the effects of a combination Camo/IR/ECM Sneak Suit, hiding the Tornado from all types of sensors. The armor is also good enough to stop small-arms fire and even heavy weapons like a Flamer from hurting the wearer. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8832 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Торнадо» — это легкая боевая броня, созданная КомСтаром в конце XXIX века для обеспечения дополнительной защиты юнитов специального назначения. Tornado основан на костюме Nighthawk от СОЗЛ, который, хотя КомСтар и приобрели несколько экземпляров, в то время не могли производить. Он включает в себя стелс-броню и адаптивную систему камуфляжа, которая имитирует эффект комбинированного камуфляжного/инфракрасного/электронного противодействия Sneak Suit, скрывая Tornado от всех типов датчиков. Броня также достаточно хороша, чтобы остановить огонь из стрелкового оружия и даже тяжелого оружия, такого как огнемет, и не дать ему повредить носителя. Особенность: Power Armor Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.8832 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

Its weakness is in its lack of long-range capability, though the ER Large Laser and LRM-10 are respectable for a 'Mech its size. For closer work, it uses two ER Medium Lasers, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and a SRM-6 launcher. This blistering hail of weapons fire is generally effective for an Inner Sphere heavy 'Mech, so the Ursus compares favorably to the designs that it is expected to stand up against. content.original: Jade Falcon commanders were shocked to find themselves suffering losses from an unknown LAM that resembled a small Warhammer. Insulted that the Inner-Sphere forces disgraced the Warhammer lineage with a half-baked LAM, and being a bit more open minded on units, Jade Falcon scientists went to work, producing a 70t version loaded with Clan tech. Fielding the same powerful combo of twin ER PPCs, as well as a pair of Arrow Anti-Air missiles, these Warhammer LAMs provide withering fire on ground targets, and are able to defend themselves from modest aerospace defenses. Coupled with the improved maneuverability of a LAM, these units are finding themselves to be the backbone of quick-response anti-militia garrisons across Jade Falcon territory. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Developed as part of Project Thor's Hammer, the Warhammer LAM aims to merge the effectiveness of the Warhammer's twin PPCs, with the mobility of a LAM, in hopes of aiding the fight against the Clans. While weight requirements forced the PPCs to be downsized to Light PPCs, they are equipped with PPC Capacitors for that extra punch, and the expansion of SRMs to twin SRM4's, as well as a sizable bomb bay, provide devastating short range firepower. This allows the Warhammer LAM to inflict serious damage on a flyover, then pepper the target at range with the Light PPCs from the rear, until enough gaps open up for the SRMs to exploit. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Developed as part of Project Thor's Hammer, the Warhammer LAM aims to merge the effectiveness of the Warhammer's twin PPCs, with the mobility of a LAM, in hopes of aiding the fight against the Clans. The B variant replaces the bomb bay and SRMs for MMLs, providing 16 tubes in total, and was marketed towards Mercenary groups. The lack of PPC Capacitors aids in repairs, and the loss of damage is replaced by the MMLs providing long range fire support with the LRMs. For close range combat, the quadrupling of SRMs fired offsets the loss of the bomb bay, but allows for a few more short range passes as the MMLs can fire multiple times. content.original: The Warlord carries its main damage dealers on the right side of the 'Mech, a Gauss rifle in the arm and an ER PPC in the side torso. A center torso mounted ER Large Laser is able to provide extra damage at range as needed, but needs to be overused due to the limited cooling from the 'Mechs twelve double heat sinks. At closer ranges the 'Mech can switch to use its seven Medium Lasers, with an SRM-6 as an extra punch. The final weapon is an Artemis IV-enabled LRM-20, able to provide accurate missile fire at most ranges. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18

content.original: The Wolf Trap carries as its main weapon an LB-X autocannon/10, which allows it to fire both standard solid shells or cluster shells that act like a shotgun and cause damage all over the enemy. content.original: Manufactured on Kwangjong-ni by Defiance, the Zeus X was both a poster child for excellence in production engineering and an innovative high-technology platform. The first of what became commonly referred to as the Zeus X series, the ZEU-X was a variant of the venerable Zeus BattleMech developed using Experimental Technology to push the envelope of the original design. The 'Mech was armed with an LB-X Autocannon/20 as its primary weapon, backed up by an MRM-30 launcher. The ZEU-X carried three tons of ammunition for the LB-X AC/20 and two tons for the MRM-30, stored in the right torso and protected by CASE II. For close combat, the Zeus had two Medium X-Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: This simple 3060's refit of the classic model upgrades the cannons to LBX and adds CASE. Introduced in 2952, the Behemoth was designed for increased firepower and heavy armor rather than speed or manoeuvrability. The design allowed the Behemoth to engage both distant and short-range targets, while allowing it to stand up to almost any type of unit possible. The two turret-mounted AC-10s enable the Behemoth to deal out a great deal of damage at a long distance. The four front-mounted LRM-5’s increase this damage potential. For closer targets, two SRM-6 packs are mounted on the turret and the Behemoth boasts two ball turrets, each mounting one SRM-2 and two Machine Guns. The final two SRM-2 packs are mounted in a half-turret on the front of tank. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. content.original: The AS7 'Boar's Head' is a little-seen trial Atlas run that attempted to make a more mobile striker assault 'Mech while still maintaining the dreaded reputation of the Atlas. Among Defiance's changes included routing all the energy weapon power couplings to the arms - 3 in each - and a massive XL engine. Ultimately, the AS7-BH proved too fragile and vulnerable to weapons loss for it's weight and altogether excessive cost. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2

content.original: Danielle Peterson's Awesome, the 'Pretty Baby' Hero 'Mech has some unexpected speed, achieved through the use of an 340-rated Extralight Engine. The Pretty Baby (serial number AWS8V99TG-2957) also features a unique weapon loadout as well - mounting a standard PPC in the right arm, a LRM-15 in the right torso, a Medium Laser in the head, Large Laser in the left torso and an SRM-4 in the left arm. 19 Double Heat Sinks, two tons of LRM and three of SRM missiles keep it in the thick of battle. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: Given to Ross McKinnon upon his father's retirement in 3051, the family 'Mech continued to be upgraded with the latest technology. By the FedCom Civil War the right arm and torso weaponry of Ross's 'Mech was upgraded to extended range models, with the triple strength myomers and hatchet retained. The use of production grade ferro-fibrous and double heat sinks, along with downgrading the large lasers to medium pulse lasers and the left arm medium for an ER Small Laser, freed up enough weight for a Targeting Computer to be added. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13

Its advanced communications gear allowed the Black Knight to effortlessly coordinate an entire company of 'Mechs simultaneously, and could easily link together the command frequencies of an entire parent regiment and connect with orbital support satellites. Его передовое коммуникационное оборудование позволяло Black Knight без труда координировать действия целой роты мехов одновременно, а также легко соединять командные частоты всего родительского полка и связываться с орбитальными спутниками поддержки. Современные строительные материалы обеспечили Black Knight легким, но прочным шасси, способным нести больше оружия и брони при меньшем весе. Учитывая тип и количество огневой мощи, которую несет мех, единственной проблемой Black Knight является управление тепловыделением.

content.original: Downgraded during the technological decline of the Succession Wars era, the personal 'Mech of the McKinnon family was selected to receive among the first experimental weapons developed from the Helm Memory Core by the New Avalon Institute of Science, thanks to the exploits of Fox's Teeth commander Ian McKinnon. When piloted by Ian during the War of 3039, the 'Mech was clad in prototype ferro-fibrous armor and the standard heat sinks outside the engine were replaced with corrosive 3039-era double heat sinks. These weight savings, along with the removal of the head-mounted small laser, allowed the 'Mech to carry a Hatchet whose damage was boosted by the addition of Triple Strength Myomer. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13

content.original: A field refit given popularity after repeated sightings in combat piloted by MechWarrior Leigh Voss, the CLPT-Jester typically begins life as a refit kit for a CPLT-K2 or similar variant. Stripping out the PPCs, the Jester manages to run enough power couplings to cram a laser into each arm, each side torso, and two in the center torso, with additional fittings for support weapons if available. It also mounts an AMS system and advanced TTS systems, allowing for lethally accurate fire even beyond traditional weapon ranges. The only major advanced piece of kit is its Endo-Steel structure; the engine and armor are both standard, making the Jester quite tough. With a plethora of double heat sinks keeping its weapons cool and the ability to lay down volley after pinpoint volley of fire, the Jester is simple, but not to be underestimated. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: A field refit given popularity after repeated sightings in combat piloted by MechWarrior Leigh Voss, the CLPT-Jester typically begins life as a refit kit for a CPLT-K2 or similar variant. Stripping out the PPCs, the Jester manages to run enough power couplings to cram a laser into each arm, each side torso, and two in the center torso, with additional fittings for support weapons if available. It also mounts an AMS system and advanced TTS systems, allowing for lethally accurate fire even beyond traditional weapon ranges. The only major advanced piece of kit is its Endo-Steel structure; the engine and armor are both standard, making the Jester quite tough. With a plethora of double heat sinks keeping its weapons cool and the ability to lay down volley after pinpoint volley of fire, the Jester is simple, but not to be underestimated.

content.original: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: «Лютоволк» - один из тех омнимехов, которых стали бояться во Внутренней Сфере во время первого вторжения Кланов, и вполне заслуженно. «Лютоволк» весит внушительные сто тонн и имеет относительно невысокую крейсерскую скорость 54 км/ч, обеспечиваемую двигателем 300 XL. По скорости и бронезащите он не уступает «Атласу», но обладает более высокой потенциальной огневой мощью с 55,5 тонн свободного пространства для оружия и оборудования. Именно за эти качества в криминальных кругах Синдиката Дракона мех окрестили Daishi (псевдояпонское название «Великая смерть»), и это название раз за разом подтверждало свою мрачную правоту. Особенность: Улучшенное наведение - Long Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.21 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: Designed after the personal ‘Mech of Elle Bennett of the 5th Donegal Guards, the GRF-1E 'Sparky' is a radical departure from standard Griffin design ethos. In place of its typical missile rack, the 1E features enough power couplings to mount a cluster of Medium Lasers - five of them, in fact - alongside the typical PPC. In a curious design decision, the engineers behind the Sparky opted for an innovative radiator pattern instead of more sophisticated heat sinks, likely as a cost-saving experiment. While this does give the 'Mech above-average heat dissipation, it's provided complement of standard heat sinks is still woefully inadequate for such a high heat load. This means that, while powerful, this 'Mech needs an equally disciplined pilot to avoid cooking alive. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: Reportedly piloted by Star Colonel Hazel of Clan Star Adder, this Highlander IIC is armed with a Gauss Rifle in the right arm and left torso, supported at short-range by a pair of Streak SRM-4 launchers in left arm and right torso. In case the four tons of Gauss rounds and five tons of Streak reloads run out, the left-arm also carries an ER Large Laser. Keeper is built around an 280-rated XL engine and an Endo Steel frame, fitted with three jump jets and twelve double heat sinks and clad in fourteen and a half tons of standard armor. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.content: По сообщениям, пилотируемый звёздным полковником Хейзелом из клана Звёздного Ужа, этот Highlander IIC вооружен пушками Гаусса в правой руке и левом торсе, а для ближних дистанций имеет пару Streak SRM-4. На случай, если четыре тонны патронов для Гаусса и пять тонн для SRM закончатся, левая рука также несет большой ER-лазер. Keeper построен на базе двигателя XL 280-го рейтинга и рамы из эндостали, оснащён тремя прыжковыми двигателями и двенадцатью двойными охладителями и покрыт четырнадцатью с половиной тоннами стандартной брони. Особенность: Укреплённые ноги Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.24 Лимит приводов рук: Right Lower

Keeper построен на базе двигателя XL 280-го рейтинга и рамы из эндостали, оснащён тремя прыжковыми двигателями и двенадцатью двойными охладителями и покрыт четырнадцатью с половиной тоннами стандартной брони.

content.original: When House Liao requested proposals for a more powerful BattleMech than the Vindicator, then the backbone of its military, part of Earthwerks' bid was an assault 'Mech named the "Mauler." The  new creation aimed for combat effectiveness at ranges where targets could not respond. Anemic arm-mounted lasers offered only token protection, with their huge baffles intended not as battering rams, but to  accommodate future upgrades. However, Earthwerks’ other entry, the Cataphract, was more effective at conventional ranges, much cheaper, and easier on logistics, literally reusing parts from other BattleMechs. Deemed the worse alternative, this first variant of Maulers never saw production beyond a half dozen custom prototypes.

content.original: The genesis of the Nightstar lies in the Amaris Civil War. The 'Mech itself was only produced until the the First Succession War, when both of the factories and engineers capable of producing the Nightstar were destroyed or killed. The Nightstar is armed to keep an enemy at standoff ranges. The primary weapons carried are a pair of Gauss Rifles, each of which can strip almost a ton of armor off an enemy unit. These are backed up by a ER PPC that is capable of hitting a target at six hundred and ninety meters. For defense at short ranges, the 'Mech has two Medium Pulse Lasers and an Small Laser.

These are backed up by a ER PPC that is capable of hitting a target at six hundred and ninety meters. For defense at short ranges, the 'Mech has two Medium Pulse Lasers and an Small Laser.

content.original: The personally built 'Mech of Cranston Snord's Irregulars member 'Shorty' Sneede, his Rifleman is a FrankenMech featuring a Phoenix Hawk head, Warhammer right arm and the left torso and arm from an Archer, with only the center and right torsos and both legs left from the parent design. Built around the 3N's standard 240-rated engine, much of the weapons and ammunition from the donor 'Mechs was retained, Sneede's custom being armed with a right-arm mounted PPC, left-torso mounted LRM-20 with two tons of ammo, and three Medium Lasers - one fitted to the right torso and two to the left arm. Carrying a total of fourteen single heat sinks, Sneede's patchwork Rifleman is clad in nine tons of armor. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to its notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 1N is powered by a 330-rated Fusion Core giving it a top speed of 97 km/h. A PPC and an SRM-6 form the Mechs weapons load.

Несмотря на то, что большинство мехвоинов избегали его из-за его известной нестабильности, Scorpion тем не менее использовался без перерыва на протяжении всех Наследных войн и после них. Scorpion 1N оснащён термоядерным двигателем рейтинга 330, что обеспечивает ему максимальную скорость 97 км/ч. Боевая нагрузка меха включает в себя РРС и SRM-6.

content.original: A multirole BattleMech developed in 2550 during the Golden Age, the Shadow Hawk is a powerful fusion of maneuverability and firepower. With a mix of long-range and short-range weapons, good maneuverability thanks to jump jets, and excellent endurance, the Shadow Hawk has long been regarded as one of the best 'Mechs in its weight class. The Shadow Hawk is equally adept whether commanding a reconnaissance company or serving as a spotter for heavy and assault lances.

content.content: Многоцелевой боевой мех, разработанный в 2550 году во время Золотого века, Shadow Hawk представляет собой мощное сочетание маневренности и огневой мощи. Благодаря сочетанию оружия дальнего и ближнего боя, хорошей маневренности благодаря прыжковым двигателям и отличной выносливости, Shadow Hawk долгое время считался одним из лучших мехов в своей весовой категории. Shadow Hawk одинаково хорош как в роли командира развед роты, так и в качестве засветчика для тяжелых и штурмовых отрядов.

content.original: While feared by the Inner Sphere, the Supernova design was born out of necessity in an attempt to address ammunition shortages by changing the original King Crab design to an all-energy loadout. The Boiler is a customized Supernova variant that seeks to re-engineer the Supernova back to the original King Crab loadout using Clan technology, essentially making the Boiler a 'King Crab IIC'. It mounts an Ultra AC/20 in each arm supported by a Large Pulse Laser in the right torso and an LRM-15 rack in the left. As it was built upon the frame of the standard Supernova, it retains the jump jets but mounts only seventeen double heat sinks. Like its progenitor, the Boiler lacks field endurance, carrying only two tons of Ultra Autocannon rounds and one ton of LRM reloads. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Timber Wolf is a fast, heavy OmniMech. A signature design of the Clans' military might, it was arguably the first Clan OmniMech encountered by Inner Sphere forces. Vaguely resembling a cross between the Marauder and Catapult series, the Timber Wolf was tagged with the Inner Sphere reporting name Mad Cat on first contact. The Timber Wolf is however vastly more powerful than either the Marauder or the Catapult. It uses its speed and firepower to engage an enemy at the range of its choosing.

Отдалённо напоминающий нечто среднее между Marauder и Catapult, Timber Wolf при первом контакте во Внутренней Сфере был помечен как Mad Cat. Однако Timber Wolf значительно мощнее Marauder и Catapult. Он использует свою скорость и огневую мощь для поражения противника на выбранной им дистанции.

content.original: Standing at 14 meters tall, the Victor approaches the concept of support in an unorthodox way for a 'Mech of its weight class. While only possessing a ground speed of 64.8 km/h, the Victor achieves a high degree of mobility instead through the use of four jump jets, allowing it to jump up to one hundred and twenty meters. A Victor can therefore "support" friendly units by jumping directly into the fray and bringing its deadly close range arsenal to bear, an ability which can surprise inexperienced MechWarriors and prove advantageous in mountainous terrain.

A Victor can therefore "support" friendly units by jumping directly into the fray and bringing its deadly close range arsenal to bear, an ability which can surprise inexperienced MechWarriors and prove advantageous in mountainous terrain.

content.original: Piloted by Henrik Cole and his grandfather, who attempted to overthrow the then head of House Cole but failed and was forced to flee quickly. Basilisk was built upon an XL engine and is armed with two medium lasers in the left arm, three Streak SRM-2s in the left torso (with two tons of reloads), two LB 10-X AC mounted in the right arm (with two tons of reloads), and a Guardian ECM mounted in the right torso. The 'Mech is equipped with three jump jets, one in each leg along with one in the center torso. Thirteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cold. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Vindicator is one of the most well-known Capellan Confederation BattleMechs. This workhorse of the CCAF was built in 2826 between the First and Second Succession War to maximize the effectiveness of the Confederation's surviving production capabilities and fulfill as many roles as possible. Designed by committee, the Vindicator's 'jack-of-all-trades' nature means it does not excel in any one role but fulfills them all adequately. With almost all of its components produced on Capella, the Vindicator is also cheap, easy to mass produce, and quick to repair with a ready supply of spare parts.

content.original: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Werewolf was introduced in 3056. Designed as an ambush 'Mech, the Werewolf was a huge hit with pilots who favored the dense jungle or industrial scrapyard arenas because it mounted a Null Signature System. This system allows a skilled pilot to hide in plain sight, striking an opponent quickly and often fatally. The eight tons of armor provide decent protection against most foes and the Werewolf's speed allows it to evade anything it can't outfight. The Werewolf mounts Jump Jets, which provide it with a limited jump capability. This capability is most frequently used by arena MechWarriors to launch a Death From Above attack, but it is also useful when evading a foe.

The design retained the 'Mech's two medium lasers and LRM 10 Launcher, while adding an extended-range PPC in place of the autocannon. content.original: The Wolf Trap is a BattleMech that the Draconis Combine designed to be used as a long-range combat 'Mech. Originally called the Tora, Luthien Armor Works hastily rechristened it the Wolf Trap, the name Federated Commonwealth analysts had given it, to downplay its association with the Combine. The 'Mech is built on an endo steel chassis and protects any ammunition stores that it carries onboard with CASE that redirects the force of the explosion when an ammunition bin is hit by enemy fire. The 'Mech has a very respectable speed of 97.2 km/h, which it achieves through the use of a 270 XL engine.

The Wolverine was eventually found there by Lawrence Helmund Nelson, who claimed it as his personal 'Mech from that point forwards.

Among Defiance's changes included routing all the energy weapon power couplings to the arms - 3 in each - and a massive XL engine. Ultimately, the AS7-BH proved too fragile and vulnerable to weapons loss for it's weight and altogether excessive cost. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2

content.original: Given to Ross McKinnon upon his father's retirement in 3051, the family 'Mech continued to be upgraded with the latest technology. By the FedCom Civil War the right arm and torso weaponry of Ross's 'Mech was upgraded to extended range models, with the triple strength myomers and hatchet retained. The use of production grade ferro-fibrous and double heat sinks, along with downgrading the large lasers to medium pulse lasers and the left arm medium for an ER Small Laser, freed up enough weight for a Targeting Computer to be added. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13

content.original: A field refit given popularity after repeated sightings in combat piloted by MechWarrior Leigh Voss, the CLPT-Jester typically begins life as a refit kit for a CPLT-K2 or similar variant. Stripping out the PPCs, the Jester manages to run enough power couplings to cram a laser into each arm, each side torso, and two in the center torso, with additional fittings for support weapons if available. It also mounts an AMS system and advanced TTS systems, allowing for lethally accurate fire even beyond traditional weapon ranges. The only major advanced piece of kit is its Endo-Steel structure; the engine and armor are both standard, making the Jester quite tough. With a plethora of double heat sinks keeping its weapons cool and the ability to lay down volley after pinpoint volley of fire, the Jester is simple, but not to be underestimated. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Dire Wolf is one of the OmniMechs that became feared throughout the Inner Sphere during the initial Clan Invasion and rightly so. The Dire Wolf weighs in at an impressive one hundred tons and has a relatively slow cruising speed of 54 km/h provided by a 300 XL engine. Its speed and armor protection matches that of an Atlas, but it has superior potential firepower with fifty and a half tons of free pod space for weapons and equipment. It is these traits which saw the 'Mech christened Daishi (pseudo-Japanese for 'Great Death') by the criminal underbelly of the Draconis Combine, a name that would be proven grimly accurate time and time again. content.original: Designed after the personal ‘Mech of Elle Bennett of the 5th Donegal Guards, the GRF-1E 'Sparky' is a radical departure from standard Griffin design ethos. In place of its typical missile rack, the 1E features enough power couplings to mount a cluster of Medium Lasers - five of them, in fact - alongside the typical PPC. In a curious design decision, the engineers behind the Sparky opted for an innovative radiator pattern instead of more sophisticated heat sinks, likely as a cost-saving experiment. While this does give the 'Mech above-average heat dissipation, it's provided complement of standard heat sinks is still woefully inadequate for such a high heat load. This means that, while powerful, this 'Mech needs an equally disciplined pilot to avoid cooking alive. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

This customized Highlander features a number of recently reintroduced Lostech technologies. content.original: Reportedly piloted by Star Colonel Hazel of Clan Star Adder, this Highlander IIC is armed with a Gauss Rifle in the right arm and left torso, supported at short-range by a pair of Streak SRM-4 launchers in left arm and right torso. In case the four tons of Gauss rounds and five tons of Streak reloads run out, the left-arm also carries an ER Large Laser. Keeper is built around an 280-rated XL engine and an Endo Steel frame, fitted with three jump jets and twelve double heat sinks and clad in fourteen and a half tons of standard armor. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.content: По сообщениям, пилотируемый звёздным полковником Хейзелом из клана Звёздного Ужа, этот Highlander IIC вооружен пушками Гаусса в правой руке и левом торсе, а для ближних дистанций имеет пару Streak SRM-4. На случай, если четыре тонны патронов для Гаусса и пять тонн для SRM закончатся, левая рука также несет большой ER-лазер. Keeper построен на базе двигателя XL 280-го рейтинга и рамы из эндостали, оснащён тремя прыжковыми двигателями и двенадцатью двойными охладителями и покрыт четырнадцатью с половиной тоннами стандартной брони. Особенность: Укреплённые ноги Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.24 Лимит приводов рук: Right Lower

Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

Stolen by the notorious Professor Burke Kale, the Prometheus was fitted with an illegal Direct Neural Interface and a Virtual Reality Piloting Pod; allowing the Professor to control the Mech as easily as if it were his own body. Powered by a 375-rated XL Engine and built around a clan made Endo Steel skeleton, the Prometheus had a top speed of 80km/h and nearly 12 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The Prometheus's weapons were all ClanTech and consisted of an ER PPC and Large Pulse Laser paired with 2 LRM-15's. For close range combat, it mounted a Medium Pulse Laser, 2 SRM-6's and 6 Machine Guns. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: While feared by the Inner Sphere, the Supernova design was born out of necessity in an attempt to address ammunition shortages by changing the original King Crab design to an all-energy loadout. The Boiler is a customized Supernova variant that seeks to re-engineer the Supernova back to the original King Crab loadout using Clan technology, essentially making the Boiler a 'King Crab IIC'. It mounts an Ultra AC/20 in each arm supported by a Large Pulse Laser in the right torso and an LRM-15 rack in the left. As it was built upon the frame of the standard Supernova, it retains the jump jets but mounts only seventeen double heat sinks. Like its progenitor, the Boiler lacks field endurance, carrying only two tons of Ultra Autocannon rounds and one ton of LRM reloads. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Phoenix Hawk 1bC was a Comstar refit built with damaged Phoenix Hawk 1b’s inherited from the 112th Royal Hussar regiment of the SLDF. Powered by a 270 XL Engine and possessing an Endo Steel chassis, the PHX-1bC is armed with an ER Large Laser and a pair of Medium Lasers. A Narc Beacon and 4 tons of ammo allow the Mech to spot for allied artillery and support assets, while a Flamer gives the Mech some anti-infantry capability. The 1b’s CASE and Guardian ECM are retained. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most famous BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower, and electronics. Originally a staple of the SLDF, Phoenix Hawks remained common within the armies of the Successor States after the fall of the Star League. At first Phoenix Hawks were grouped together to form powerful recon lances, but as they started reaching their various deployments, their full potential as command 'Mechs was discovered and many were reassigned to instead lead units of smaller recon 'Mechs.

content.content: Впервые представленный Терранской гегемонией в 2568 году, Phoenix Hawk был одним из самых известных боевых мехов во Внутренней Сфере. Этот мех появился, когда Orguss Industries поняли, что могут усилить шасси Stinger, чтобы породить более крупную версию, обладающую той же скоростью и маневренностью, что и Stinger, но с улучшенной броней, огневой мощью и электроникой. Изначально являясь основной рабочей лошадкой СОЗЛ, «Феникс Хоки» оставались распространенными в армиях государств-наследников после падения Звездной Лиги. Сначала «Феникс Хоки» были объединены в мощные разведывательные отряды, но по мере того, как они начали достигать своих различных мест развертывания, был обнаружен их полный потенциал в качестве командирских мехов, и многие из них были переведены на руководство подразделениями малых развед мехов.

Introduced in 2856, it removes both of the machine guns and the ammunition and replaces them with two additional heat sinks. While removing a small amount of the 'Mech's short-range firepower and a powerful set of weapons against infantry, the additional heat sinks made the 1D's heat load more manageable. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01

content.original: A Blue Shot Weapons special, the Phoenix Hawk 1GS is a custom order variant based on the STR-3G Stinger. Popular among rookie pilots, the 1GS trades range and firepower for increased survivability and an easier heat curve. Built from salvaged PHX-1D’s, the 1GS strips out the XL Engine and extra DHS. The weapons are replaced with a Large Laser and a Small Laser in each arm, the additional range of the ER’s not being needed in the close quarter fighting of the Arena. Both the primary lasers are mounted in gunpods giving the variant its "Gunslinger" nickname. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most famous BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower, and electronics. Originally a staple of the SLDF, Phoenix Hawks remained common within the armies of the Successor States after the fall of the Star League. At first Phoenix Hawks were grouped together to form powerful recon lances, but as they started reaching their various deployments, their full potential as command 'Mechs was discovered and many were reassigned to instead lead units of smaller recon 'Mechs.

content.content: Впервые представленный Терранской гегемонией в 2568 году, Phoenix Hawk был одним из самых известных боевых мехов во Внутренней Сфере. Этот мех появился, когда Orguss Industries поняли, что могут усилить шасси Stinger, чтобы породить более крупную версию, обладающую той же скоростью и маневренностью, что и Stinger, но с улучшенной броней, огневой мощью и электроникой. Изначально являясь основной рабочей лошадкой СОЗЛ, «Феникс Хоки» оставались распространенными в армиях государств-наследников после падения Звездной Лиги. Сначала «Феникс Хоки» были объединены в мощные разведывательные отряды, но по мере того, как они начали достигать своих различных мест развертывания, был обнаружен их полный потенциал в качестве командирских мехов, и многие из них были переведены на руководство подразделениями малых развед мехов.

content.original: The Phoenix Hawk 2L was one of the first new mechs to be produced under the Long Road initiative. A compete overhaul designed to be compatible with the myriad PXH-1 variants found throughout the Periphery, the redesign takes advantage of Lushan Industries production license for the new ER Large Laser. Mounting this in place of the original Large Laser, the weapons increased heat is balanced by the inclusion of 2 extra heat sinks; with an Endo steel chassis providing the necessary free weight. Retaining the medium lasers and the Guardian ECM suite, the 2L is a cheap upgrade for anyone fielding a PXH-1 design. Available for export throughout the Periphery, the only constraint to production is the lack of a production facility for the PXH chassis, though Alliance Mech Works has plans to build a dedicated PHX line should the design prove popular. Until then the current output is limited to in-situ conversions of existing mechs and the restoration of battlefield salvage. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The 3D variant of this 'Mech was introduced in 3048, based on the 1D used by Davion forces. It was built out of New Avalon by Archenar BattleMechs as one of a slew of redesigns using recovered lostech. The 'Mech utilized Endo Steel construction techniques and a Extra-Light engine to free up weight and space for a number of improvements, particularly its weaponry. The 'Mech carried a pair of ER Large Lasers and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers split between both arms. With the machine guns and their ammunition removed, this allowed two additional heat sinks to be added, and all single heat sinks were exchanged for double strength models. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

The 'Mech utilized Endo Steel construction techniques and a Extra-Light engine to free up weight and space for a number of improvements, particularly its weaponry. The 'Mech carried a pair of ER Large Lasers and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers split between both arms. With the machine guns and their ammunition removed, this allowed two additional heat sinks to be added, and all single heat sinks were exchanged for double strength models.

content.original: The 3K Phoenix Hawk was another upgrade of the design that used rediscovered technologies, built by Alshain Weapons and GKT Enterprises for House Kurita and the Free Rasalhague Republic respectively. Introduced in 3050, the engine was upgraded to an XL model, with the saved weight used to upgrade the weapons payload on the 'Mech, taking its cues from the 1K variant. Like the PXH-3D model the 3K carries carries two ER large lasers and two medium Lasers. It also carried twelve double heat sinks to manage the additional waste heat, and the eight tons of standard armor were replaced with the same amount of New Samarkand Royal Ferro-Fibrous armor, improving its survivability. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The 3M variant of the 'Mech was also introduced in 3048, built by Earthwerks Incorporated from their Keystone factory and using upgrades based on rediscovered Star League technology. First, the internal structure of the 'Mech has been redesigned to utilize a 1A Type7 Endo Steel chassis. The engine was then replaced with a GM 270 XL and the heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks. This allowed the weapons payload to be changed extensively, with all of the original weapons being stripped from the chassis. In their place the 'Mech carried two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers as its primary weapons and two Martell Medium Pulse Lasers for close in work, with one of each mounted in either arm. Finally, a MainFire Point Defense Anti-Missile System replaced the right-arm machine gun, with two tons of both AMS and machine gun reloads carried in the CASE-protected left torso. The electronic systems were also replaced with an Achernar Electronics HID-8 comm system and Federated Hunter target-tracking system. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
