content.original: The 3S model of this 'Mech, first deployed in 3042, was another upgrade using rediscovered technology that attempted to make the Phoenix Hawk even more effective for reconnaissance. The engine was upgraded to an ExtraLight version and ten double heat sinks improved heat management. The overall armor protection was increased by one ton and replaced with Lexington Ltd. High Grade Ferro-Fibrous armor. The primary weapon on the 'Mech was a Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Laser built into the right arm, though it still retained the two medium lasers and machine guns of the original. Additionally an anti-missile system was mounted on the right arm, with its two tons of ammo (along with two tons of machine gun ammo) protected by CASE in the left torso. Its primary difference from other variants introduced during the time period was the addition of a MASC system, which allowed the 'Mech to reach speeds of up to 129.6 in short bursts. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most famous BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower, and electronics. Originally a staple of the SLDF, Phoenix Hawks remained common within the armies of the Successor States after the fall of the Star League. At first Phoenix Hawks were grouped together to form powerful recon lances, but as they started reaching their various deployments, their full potential as command 'Mechs was discovered and many were reassigned to instead lead units of smaller recon 'Mechs.

Этот мех появился, когда Orguss Industries поняли, что могут усилить шасси Stinger, чтобы породить более крупную версию, обладающую той же скоростью и маневренностью, что и Stinger, но с улучшенной броней, огневой мощью и электроникой. Изначально являясь основной рабочей лошадкой СОЗЛ, «Феникс Хоки» оставались распространенными в армиях государств-наследников после падения Звездной Лиги. Сначала «Феникс Хоки» были объединены в мощные разведывательные отряды, но по мере того, как они начали достигать своих различных мест развертывания, был обнаружен их полный потенциал в качестве командирских мехов, и многие из них были переведены на руководство подразделениями малых развед мехов.

content.original: For long range firepower, the Tempest TMP-3M carries a Gauss rifle, which provides a devastating long-range punch. For medium to long ranges, the 'Mech has a Large Pulse Laser. When the 'Mech closes to short ranges, it brings its three medium lasers and its SRM-6 to bear on an enemy. To make the most of the Tempest's available weight, the 'Mech is built on a Endo Steel chassis and is propelled to its top speed of 64.8 km/h by a 260 XL engine. The 'Mech's mobility has also been enhanced with four jump jets that make the Tempest capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty meters. Finally, the Tempest carries twelve tons of armor which is a respectable amount of protection for a 65 ton 'Mech. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Designed during the early years of the Golden Century, the Wakazashi (the sister sword of the katana) allowed Clan Jade Falcon the time to rebuild their then weakened touman. Never intended as a long-term production design, the durable Wakazashi was relatively easy to build but was difficult to repair or modify. Subsequently, the Wakazashi's reputation suffered with the appearance of the OmniMech. When the Falcon's fortunes improved in the early thirtieth century, Wakazashi production was shut down in favor of other designs.

content.original: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Phoenix Hawk 1bC was a Comstar refit built with damaged Phoenix Hawk 1b’s inherited from the 112th Royal Hussar regiment of the SLDF. Powered by a 270 XL Engine and possessing an Endo Steel chassis, the PHX-1bC is armed with an ER Large Laser and a pair of Medium Lasers. A Narc Beacon and 4 tons of ammo allow the Mech to spot for allied artillery and support assets, while a Flamer gives the Mech some anti-infantry capability. The 1b’s CASE and Guardian ECM are retained. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: A Blue Shot Weapons special, the Phoenix Hawk 1GS is a custom order variant based on the STR-3G Stinger. Popular among rookie pilots, the 1GS trades range and firepower for increased survivability and an easier heat curve. Built from salvaged PHX-1D’s, the 1GS strips out the XL Engine and extra DHS. The weapons are replaced with a Large Laser and a Small Laser in each arm, the additional range of the ER’s not being needed in the close quarter fighting of the Arena. Both the primary lasers are mounted in gunpods giving the variant its "Gunslinger" nickname. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The Phoenix Hawk 2L was one of the first new mechs to be produced under the Long Road initiative. A compete overhaul designed to be compatible with the myriad PXH-1 variants found throughout the Periphery, the redesign takes advantage of Lushan Industries production license for the new ER Large Laser. Mounting this in place of the original Large Laser, the weapons increased heat is balanced by the inclusion of 2 extra heat sinks; with an Endo steel chassis providing the necessary free weight. Retaining the medium lasers and the Guardian ECM suite, the 2L is a cheap upgrade for anyone fielding a PXH-1 design. Available for export throughout the Periphery, the only constraint to production is the lack of a production facility for the PXH chassis, though Alliance Mech Works has plans to build a dedicated PHX line should the design prove popular. Until then the current output is limited to in-situ conversions of existing mechs and the restoration of battlefield salvage. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The 3D variant of this 'Mech was introduced in 3048, based on the 1D used by Davion forces. It was built out of New Avalon by Archenar BattleMechs as one of a slew of redesigns using recovered lostech. The 'Mech utilized Endo Steel construction techniques and a Extra-Light engine to free up weight and space for a number of improvements, particularly its weaponry. The 'Mech carried a pair of ER Large Lasers and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers split between both arms. With the machine guns and their ammunition removed, this allowed two additional heat sinks to be added, and all single heat sinks were exchanged for double strength models. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The 3K Phoenix Hawk was another upgrade of the design that used rediscovered technologies, built by Alshain Weapons and GKT Enterprises for House Kurita and the Free Rasalhague Republic respectively. Introduced in 3050, the engine was upgraded to an XL model, with the saved weight used to upgrade the weapons payload on the 'Mech, taking its cues from the 1K variant. Like the PXH-3D model the 3K carries carries two ER large lasers and two medium Lasers. It also carried twelve double heat sinks to manage the additional waste heat, and the eight tons of standard armor were replaced with the same amount of New Samarkand Royal Ferro-Fibrous armor, improving its survivability. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The 3M variant of the 'Mech was also introduced in 3048, built by Earthwerks Incorporated from their Keystone factory and using upgrades based on rediscovered Star League technology. First, the internal structure of the 'Mech has been redesigned to utilize a 1A Type7 Endo Steel chassis. The engine was then replaced with a GM 270 XL and the heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks. This allowed the weapons payload to be changed extensively, with all of the original weapons being stripped from the chassis. In their place the 'Mech carried two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers as its primary weapons and two Martell Medium Pulse Lasers for close in work, with one of each mounted in either arm. Finally, a MainFire Point Defense Anti-Missile System replaced the right-arm machine gun, with two tons of both AMS and machine gun reloads carried in the CASE-protected left torso. The electronic systems were also replaced with an Achernar Electronics HID-8 comm system and Federated Hunter target-tracking system. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The 3S model of this 'Mech, first deployed in 3042, was another upgrade using rediscovered technology that attempted to make the Phoenix Hawk even more effective for reconnaissance. The engine was upgraded to an ExtraLight version and ten double heat sinks improved heat management. The overall armor protection was increased by one ton and replaced with Lexington Ltd. High Grade Ferro-Fibrous armor. The primary weapon on the 'Mech was a Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Laser built into the right arm, though it still retained the two medium lasers and machine guns of the original. Additionally an anti-missile system was mounted on the right arm, with its two tons of ammo (along with two tons of machine gun ammo) protected by CASE in the left torso. Its primary difference from other variants introduced during the time period was the addition of a MASC system, which allowed the 'Mech to reach speeds of up to 129.6 in short bursts. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: For long range firepower, the Tempest TMP-3M carries a Gauss rifle, which provides a devastating long-range punch. For medium to long ranges, the 'Mech has a Large Pulse Laser. When the 'Mech closes to short ranges, it brings its three medium lasers and its SRM-6 to bear on an enemy. To make the most of the Tempest's available weight, the 'Mech is built on a Endo Steel chassis and is propelled to its top speed of 64.8 km/h by a 260 XL engine. The 'Mech's mobility has also been enhanced with four jump jets that make the Tempest capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty meters. Finally, the Tempest carries twelve tons of armor which is a respectable amount of protection for a 65 ton 'Mech. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most famous BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower, and electronics. Originally a staple of the SLDF, Phoenix Hawks remained common within the armies of the Successor States after the fall of the Star League. At first Phoenix Hawks were grouped together to form powerful recon lances, but as they started reaching their various deployments, their full potential as command 'Mechs was discovered and many were reassigned to instead lead units of smaller recon 'Mechs.

content.content: Впервые представленный Терранской гегемонией в 2568 году, Phoenix Hawk был одним из самых известных боевых мехов во Внутренней Сфере. Этот мех появился, когда Orguss Industries поняли, что могут усилить шасси Stinger, чтобы породить более крупную версию, обладающую той же скоростью и маневренностью, что и Stinger, но с улучшенной броней, огневой мощью и электроникой. Изначально являясь основной рабочей лошадкой СОЗЛ, «Феникс Хоки» оставались распространенными в армиях государств-наследников после падения Звездной Лиги. Сначала «Феникс Хоки» были объединены в мощные разведывательные отряды, но по мере того, как они начали достигать своих различных мест развертывания, был обнаружен их полный потенциал в качестве командирских мехов, и многие из них были переведены на руководство подразделениями малых развед мехов.

content.original: The Grotesque is an 80 ton Clan OmniMech designed by Clan Diamond Shark. An offshoot of the Gargoyle program, it was an attempt to branch out into more varied designs. Besides using the same basic setup of a 400 XL engine and ferro-fibrous armor as the Gargoyle, the Grotesque further attempts to free up more pod capacity by using an Endo Steel structure. As the original production run of the 'Mech never saw much success, its production was not continued for very long before the project was abandoned.

content.original: The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The Perseus shares much with the venerable Orion, a staple of Free Worlds League Military, both broadly resembling the older design visually and using a number of the same components. This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: «Персей» является продуктом программы, начатой ​​Центральным координационным и командным управлением Лиги, для создания омнимеха собственного производства Лиги Свободных Миров, от концепции до производства. Perseus во многом похож на почтенный Orion, основной продукт вооружённых сил Лиги Свободных Миров, оба в целом напоминают старый дизайн визуально, достаточно, чтобы техники ЛСМ прозвали его «Омни-Орионом», и развертывание Perseus в основном осуществлялось в передовых частях, которые имели большие концентрации его предшественника, заменяя старые Orion по принципу один к одному. Созданный на лёгком шасси из эндостали, Perseus оснащён двигателем Hermes 300 XL, что помогает ещё больше снизить вес и даёт меху максимальную скорость 64,8 км/ч. Усовершенствованная структура и двигатель значительно экономят вес оружия и оборудования. «Персей» защищён четырнадцатью тоннами брони Valiant Lamellor, что обеспечивает ему среднюю броневую защиту для меха такого размера. Кроме того, в шасси установлены 12 двойных охладителей. Особенность: Противовоздушное наведение Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.06 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.prevOriginal: Direct Fire Support
content.content: Поддержка с открытых позиций

content.original: The primary configuration of the Perseus shares a great deal with the Orion. For long range direct and indirect fire support, the Perseus carries an LRM-20 with Artemis IV for increased missile accuracy. For long range direct fire, the Perseus carries a powerful Ultra Autocannon/10 that is capable of firing at twice the rate as a standard autocannon. The Perseus has a devastating short range arsenal with a highly accurate Medium Pulse Laser, four ER Medium Lasers , an ER Small Laser, and finally an SRM-4 launcher that is linked to an Artemis IV FCS. The primary configuration mounts two tons each of both Ultra Autocannon and LRM munitions as well as single ton of SRM reloads in CASE protected ammunition bays in both its side torsos.

content.original: Configured for long range fire support, the A configuration carries a pair of LRM-20 launchers in its arm, both of which are linked to an Artemis IV FCS for increased accuracy. For close range defense, the 'Mech carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and has an SRM-6 launcher linked to an Artemis IV FCS. The 'Mech also has a leg-mounted TAG laser designator, allowing it to call in Semi-Guided LRM and Arrow IV attacks from friendly units and has an ECM Suite to defend itself from enemy electronic warfare systems.

This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

content.original: The Quasit was an Industrial Mech armed with military-grade weapons, created in 2517 by Concordat Telecom and the TransStellar Company. Initially, the design was sold to unsuspecting settlements in the Periphery as a BattleMech, but once the new owners had the Quasit face a proper BattleMech, the truth was revealed by its limitations. After a brief setback, once the CTT decided to sell it as a MilitiaMech to support militia troops, the design worked well in this role.

content.original: After winning the design to the Timberwolf legs from Clan Wolf during a Trial of Possession, Clan Snow Raven quickly combined the legs with the torso  of a Hellbringer. The result was the 70 ton OmniMech called the Starhawk. It sports a 350 XL engine to carry, making it adequately agile for the Clan's needs, but not much of the design made it stand out compared to other already established 'Mechs. The Starhawk was never seen as a success and are now rare to spot outside of garrison duties.

content.original: The Ferret Light Scout VTOL was first introduced to House Davion troops in 2901 and later adopted by House Marik, House Steiner and certain Periphery powers. The vehicle serves as an advanced scout with the ability to monitor enemy troop movements and radio in artillery strikes. Thanks to its speed, a single Ferret can patrol a front of up to twenty kilometers long, moving quickly from one area to the next. The vehicle is lightly armored and a hit from nearly any kind of 'Mech weaponry will destroy the Ferret. However, the Ferret's job is to avoid combat, and its agility allows it to remain outside the effective range of the enemy's weapons until reinforcements arrive. Besides reconnaissance and artillery spotting, the Ferret's cargo capacity also makes it suitable for transport and rescue operations. content.original: The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The Perseus shares much with the venerable Orion, a staple of Free Worlds League Military, both broadly resembling the older design visually and using a number of the same components. This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: «Персей» является продуктом программы, начатой ​​Центральным координационным и командным управлением Лиги, для создания омнимеха собственного производства Лиги Свободных Миров, от концепции до производства. Perseus во многом похож на почтенный Orion, основной продукт вооружённых сил Лиги Свободных Миров, оба в целом напоминают старый дизайн визуально, достаточно, чтобы техники ЛСМ прозвали его «Омни-Орионом», и развертывание Perseus в основном осуществлялось в передовых частях, которые имели большие концентрации его предшественника, заменяя старые Orion по принципу один к одному. Созданный на лёгком шасси из эндостали, Perseus оснащён двигателем Hermes 300 XL, что помогает ещё больше снизить вес и даёт меху максимальную скорость 64,8 км/ч. Усовершенствованная структура и двигатель значительно экономят вес оружия и оборудования. «Персей» защищён четырнадцатью тоннами брони Valiant Lamellor, что обеспечивает ему среднюю броневую защиту для меха такого размера. Кроме того, в шасси установлены 12 двойных охладителей. Особенность: Противовоздушное наведение Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.06 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

Усовершенствованная структура и двигатель значительно экономят вес оружия и оборудования. «Персей» защищён четырнадцатью тоннами брони Valiant Lamellor, что обеспечивает ему среднюю броневую защиту для меха такого размера. Кроме того, в шасси установлены 12 двойных охладителей. Особенность: Противовоздушное наведение Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.06 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The Perseus shares much with the venerable Orion, a staple of Free Worlds League Military, both broadly resembling the older design visually and using a number of the same components. This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The BJ-2 was introduced in 3052 by the Federated Suns as the new production model of the Blackjack, based on earlier experimental designs. It upgrades the 'Mech with two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers in place of the autocannons and removes the medium lasers for four Hovertec Streak SRM-2 launchers, two each in the left and right sides of the torso. One ton of ammo for the launchers is kept in the left torso while the standard heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks.

content.original: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to its notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 1N is powered by a 330-rated Fusion Core giving it a top speed of 97 km/h. A PPC and an SRM-6 form the Mechs weapons load.

content.original: The STL-7CE Stiletto was one of very few ultralight BattleMechs designed for a specific combat role: to fight short-range delaying actions and to engage the Lyran Commonwealth's new COM-2D Commando reconnaissance 'Mech. During the 2460s and 2470s, quantities of Commandos began appearing in regiments along the Steiner/Kurita border, a situation that concerned Lord Kurita greatly. Deciding to assume the offensive, he ordered a new BattleMech design constructed, cheaper than its intended adversary and available in quantity. The result, the Stiletto, entered full-scale production in 2473. This Variant of the Stiletto has been Used in Solaris for Exclusive Use in Ultralight Mech Combat. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97

content.original: Forgotten by history, the Condor IIC was a Clan Nova Cat upgrade of the venerable Condor hover tank; and likely inspired the SM series of tank destroyers. Nova Cat technicians swapped the ICE engine for a surplus 165 rated Fusion Engine sourced from a scrapped Tyre aerospace fighter. An LB-20X AC and 3 tons of ammo take up the bulk of the weight savings. The Medium Lasers are replaced with Pulse variants and the Machine Gun is replaced with an SPL. Ferro Fibrous armour adds additional protection to the tank. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Armor (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 160 25 Left 100 25 Right 100 25 Rear 85 25 Turret 130 25 Total 575 125 Quirk: Quick Off The Line

content.original: The STL-7CE Stiletto was one of very few ultralight BattleMechs designed for a specific combat role: to fight short-range delaying actions and to engage the Lyran Commonwealth's new COM-2D Commando reconnaissance 'Mech. During the 2460s and 2470s, quantities of Commandos began appearing in regiments along the Steiner/Kurita border, a situation that concerned Lord Kurita greatly. Deciding to assume the offensive, he ordered a new BattleMech design constructed, cheaper than its intended adversary and available in quantity. The result, the Stiletto, entered full-scale production in 2473. This Variant of the Stiletto has been Used in Solaris for Exclusive Use in Ultralight Mech Combat. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97

Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.01

content.original: Created by the Golden Star Entertainment conglomerate, the PXH-1VC was a stealth marketing campaign for their newest holovid series. Using an experimental blazer and a salvaged PXH-1D chassis, GSE bankrolled a minor Solaris gladiator in the months before their show launched. A near perfect copy of the ''Gothic'' model used by the shows antagonist, the mech went survived longer than the holovid show; which was cancelled after the 2nd season. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01

Используя экспериментальный лазер и восстановленное шасси PXH-1D, GSE спонсировали выступления малоизвестного гладиатора с Соляриса в период, предшествовавший премьере шоу. Мех — практически точная копия модели «Готик» (Gothic), на которой сражался антагонист сериала, — просуществовал дольше самого шоу, закрытого после второго сезона. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.01

content.original: The Rifleman RFL-3B is a strange beast. Its only two weapons are two Binary Lasers, one in each arm, which made it very unwieldy to use in longer engagements due its lack of flexibility to quickly adapt to the ever-changing dynamics of the battlefield. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

Особенность: Противовоздушное наведение Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.06 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: An early prototype of the Axman, the AXM-1X paved the road for the large investments into the project by the AFFC that eventually led to its large success. Besides its large hatchet it mounts a Autocannon/10, a Large Laser and two Medium Lasers. It also used a standard size engine and single heat sinks, making it quite inferior to many production run Axmans. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

content.original: The CRH-2B distinguishes itself through an unusual density of reinforced components, including an armored cockpit, armored engine shielding, a defensive-rated gyro, and reinforced leg and arm actuators that resist crippling damage. Ferro-Fibrous armor plating keeps weight manageable despite this added bulk, while internal spall liners reduce the risk of catastrophic crew or component loss from penetrating hits. Armed with twin PPCs and three Medium Lasers, and fitted with assault-class jump jets for repositioning, the CRH-2B remains a stubbornly difficult mech to put down for good. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14

content.original: Designed in the waning years of the Star League to bolster SLDF garrisons amid mounting civil unrest, the Cockroach prioritized survivability above all else, trading offensive punch for unmatched resilience under fire. Following the Amaris Civil War, production blueprints scattered across the Inner Sphere, picked up intermittently by various manufacturers ever since. Now an uncommon but unsurprising sight in garrison forces of nearly every major faction, with scattered units even reaching Periphery militias.

Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

content.original: The CRH-4H represents a significant rework of the original CRH-2B, upgrading its twin PPCs to ER PPCs for greater range and replacing single heat sinks with double heat sinks throughout to support them. A Guardian ECM Suite has been added for electronic protection, and Reinforced Internal Structure further bolsters the chassis's already formidable durability. These additions come at a slight cost to armor coverage, though the CRH-4H remains every bit as difficult to bring down as its predecessor. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

content.original: The CRH-4H2 builds directly on the CRH-4H, upgrading all three Medium Lasers to Medium Pulse Lasers and adding a fourth in the center torso for substantially improved close-range accuracy and output. An Advanced Targeting Computer and additional energy and heat tracking systems further sharpen its weapons' effectiveness, supported by extra heat sinks in both arms. To accommodate this expanded and refined arsenal, the CRH-4H2 sacrifices its jump jets entirely — a trade-off that grounds the design but leaves its renowned armor and defensive systems fully intact. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

content.original: The Dragon is a heavy BattleMech originally designed in a bid to replace the Shadow Hawk. A close assault 'Mech, its versatile design allows it to be used in both offensive and defensive operations. It boasts above-average firepower and plenty of ammunition for extended combat, while having a high top speed for a heavy 'Mech. Armor coverage for the Dragon is thick around the torso, and especially the rear, for when it is surrounded by opponents, while the squat design gives it a smaller profile and makes it harder to knock over. The Dragon's only major problem is it requires frequent maintenance and/or overhaul of its hip actuator

content.original: The Hermes II was first produced in 2798, based on the original Hermes BattleMech that had been used by the Star League. A heavy scout, the Hermes II boasted respectable weaponry, armoring, and speed, allowing it to easily brawl with lighter 'Mechs or survive an encounter with heavier 'Mechs and retreat. Out of all medium-weight 'Mechs at the time the Hermes II was the easiest to perform field maintenance on, leading to its nickname 'old reliable.' As combination scout and light strike platforms, Hermes II 'Mechs often operated alone, employed for missions for which lighter 'Mechs were too fragile and heavier 'Mechs too clumsy. The Hermes II was in its element when operating in a restrictive environment like a forest or city, where it could employ a most unusual tactic of setting its surroundings on fire to escape pursuit. Since most 'Mech pilots would naturally avoid a fire to prevent overheating and the flames interfered with most thermal scanners, starting a blaze allowed the Hermes II to more easily slip away.

content.original: Originally developed by Luthien Armor Works as a cheap but durable garrison unit, the Kumazemi entered production after a brief test period showing promising results. Its name, meaning "bear cicada", is a nod to both its imposing bulk and to some borrowed design elements from the venerable Cicada chassis. Initially fielded exclusively within Combine garrison units, limited export agreements have made the Kumazemi an increasingly more common sight among both Inner Sphere and Periphery garrisons, as well as the occasional mercenary command.

content.original: The KUZ-C3 refines the original Kumazemi's loadout with a trio of practical upgrades. The head-mounted Machine Gun has been replaced with a Small Laser for ammunition independent close defense, an SRM-6 has been added to the left torso for additional short range punch, and single heat sinks have given way to double heat sinks throughout. Together, these changes allow the KUZ-C3 to sustain heavier fire from its AC/20 and LRM-15 while adding a meaningful close-combat option its predecessor lacked. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The KUZ-D5 represents a large rework of the original Kumazemi. Endo Steel internal structure frees enough tonnage to replace the head-mounted Machine Gun with an ER Large Laser and add a centrally-mounted SRM-4, while Artemis IV fire control systems on both the LRM-15 and new SRM-4 dramatically improve missile accuracy. Double heat sinks support this expanded arsenal, though the added equipment comes at the cost of reduced armor coverage compared to earlier variants, a trade the KUZ-D5 makes in pursuit of substantially greater firepower. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Daimyo HQ was a heavy theater command unit utilized by the Draconis Combine. The first Daimyo was fielded in 2796 at the beginning of the Succession Wars by Jinjiro Kurita, who used the vehicle during the Kentares Massacre. While the Coordinator attended executions in person, the Daimyo HQ's crew transmitted the data to ComStar representatives on the planet who then sent the data through the whole Inner Sphere. When Jinjiro discovered the treason, the whole crew was executed. Daimyo production ceased between the years 3027 and 3063 because the unit's communication system technology become a form of Lostech. When Jinjiro discovered the treason, the whole crew was executed. Daimyo production ceased between the years 3027 and 3063 because the unit's communication system technology become a form of Lostech. content.original: A durable and expensive APC, the 30 ton Trident Tracked Transport was developed by Aldis Industries, during the First Succession War and it has seen constant production ever since. Built around a military grade Fuel Cell and 7 tons of armor; the Trident has a maximum speed of 84km/h. Armed with a pair of LRM-5’s and a pair of Machine Guns; the Trident can ferry a full squad of troops in relative comfort and support them once they disembark. Ironically the combination of durability and high cost limits the potential market for the vehicle and only 200 are produced each year. Despite that, it can be found all around the Inner Sphere and occasionally the Periphery with a wide variety of buyers. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. БМП способен перевозить целый отряд пехоты в относительно комфортных условиях, а после высадки — оказывать бойцам огневую поддержку. По иронии судьбы, сочетание высокой надежности и большой стоимости ограничивает рыночный потенциал этой техники: ежегодно выпускается лишь 200 единиц. Тем не менее, Trident можно встретить по всей Внутренней Сфере и даже в Периферии — у самых разных владельцев. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 5/8 гексов / 150/240 метров. content.original: The Turhan was first built for the Terran Hegemony in 2530 by Dieron's Buhallin Military Products. The company, known for its wheeled vehicles, built the Turhan to answer the HAF's need for an urban assault vehicle to support its infantry in urban environments. The vehicle acted as an Armored Personnel Carrier, deploying troops from its large infantry transport bay. content.original: Full production of this version, known as the Goblin II Infantry Support Vehicle, began in 3053. Though the Goblin remained a capable tank during its time in the Inner Sphere, the Clan Invasion prompted Johnston Industries to redesign it. A 180 FireHeart fusion engine replaces the ICE, enabling the infantry bay to be expanded. The large laser is replaced with a Large Pulse Laser and a SRM-6 is added to increase its firepower. The redesign mounts two Johnston miniguns, providing even more defense against infantry. Finally, an anti-missile system was installed to increase its survivability. The armor protection was increased from 8 tons to 9.5 tons of ferro-fibrous. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. content.content: Полномасштабное производство этой версии, известной как машина поддержки пехоты «Гоблин II», началось в 3053 году. Хотя «Гоблин» оставался эффективной боевой машиной во время службы во Внутренней Сфере, вторжение Кланов побудило компанию Johnston Industries провести его модернизацию. Двигатель внутреннего сгорания был заменен на термоядерный реактор FireHeart рейтинга 180, что позволило увеличить размер отсека пехоты. Вместо большого лазера установили большой импульсный лазер, и для усиления огневой мощи добавили пусковую установку SRM-6. Модернизированный вариант оснастили двумя миниганами Johnston, обеспечивающими еще более надежную защиту от пехоты. Наконец, для повышения живучести была установлена ​​система противоракетной обороны. Бронирование было усилено: вместо прежних 8 тонн использовано 9,5 тонны ферроволоконной брони. Хотя массового производства так и не было налажено, вооруженные силы всех государств-наследников в эпоху после падения Звездной Лиги продолжали использовать эти машины в боевых действиях на самых суровых и непригодных для жизни планетах. content.original: The CRH-2B distinguishes itself through an unusual density of reinforced components, including an armored cockpit, armored engine shielding, a defensive-rated gyro, and reinforced leg and arm actuators that resist crippling damage. Ferro-Fibrous armor plating keeps weight manageable despite this added bulk, while internal spall liners reduce the risk of catastrophic crew or component loss from penetrating hits. Armed with twin PPCs and three Medium Lasers, and fitted with assault-class jump jets for repositioning, the CRH-2B remains a stubbornly difficult mech to put down for good. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14

An Advanced Targeting Computer and additional energy and heat tracking systems further sharpen its weapons' effectiveness, supported by extra heat sinks in both arms. To accommodate this expanded and refined arsenal, the CRH-4H2 sacrifices its jump jets entirely — a trade-off that grounds the design but leaves its renowned armor and defensive systems fully intact. content.original: The KUZ-D5 represents a large rework of the original Kumazemi. Endo Steel internal structure frees enough tonnage to replace the head-mounted Machine Gun with an ER Large Laser and add a centrally-mounted SRM-4, while Artemis IV fire control systems on both the LRM-15 and new SRM-4 dramatically improve missile accuracy. Double heat sinks support this expanded arsenal, though the added equipment comes at the cost of reduced armor coverage compared to earlier variants, a trade the KUZ-D5 makes in pursuit of substantially greater firepower. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Daimyo HQ was a heavy theater command unit utilized by the Draconis Combine. The first Daimyo was fielded in 2796 at the beginning of the Succession Wars by Jinjiro Kurita, who used the vehicle during the Kentares Massacre. While the Coordinator attended executions in person, the Daimyo HQ's crew transmitted the data to ComStar representatives on the planet who then sent the data through the whole Inner Sphere. When Jinjiro discovered the treason, the whole crew was executed. Daimyo production ceased between the years 3027 and 3063 because the unit's communication system technology become a form of Lostech. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. content.original: A durable and expensive APC, the 30 ton Trident Tracked Transport was developed by Aldis Industries, during the First Succession War and it has seen constant production ever since. Built around a military grade Fuel Cell and 7 tons of armor; the Trident has a maximum speed of 84km/h. Armed with a pair of LRM-5’s and a pair of Machine Guns; the Trident can ferry a full squad of troops in relative comfort and support them once they disembark. Ironically the combination of durability and high cost limits the potential market for the vehicle and only 200 are produced each year. Despite that, it can be found all around the Inner Sphere and occasionally the Periphery with a wide variety of buyers. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. content.content: «Трезубец» — прочный и дорогостоящий 30-тонный гусеничный бронетранспортер, разработанный компанией Aldis Industries в период Первой войны за Наследство и с тех пор находящийся в постоянном производстве. Машина оснащена топливной ячейкой военного класса и защищена 7 тоннами брони; её максимальная скорость составляет 84 км/ч. Вооружение «Трезубца» состоит из двух пусковых установок LRM-5 и пары пулеметов. БМП способен перевозить целый отряд пехоты в относительно комфортных условиях, а после высадки — оказывать бойцам огневую поддержку. По иронии судьбы, сочетание высокой надежности и большой стоимости ограничивает рыночный потенциал этой техники: ежегодно выпускается лишь 200 единиц. Тем не менее, Trident можно встретить по всей Внутренней Сфере и даже в Периферии — у самых разных владельцев. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 5/8 гексов / 150/240 метров. content.original: The Turhan was first built for the Terran Hegemony in 2530 by Dieron's Buhallin Military Products. The company, known for its wheeled vehicles, built the Turhan to answer the HAF's need for an urban assault vehicle to support its infantry in urban environments. The vehicle acted as an Armored Personnel Carrier, deploying troops from its large infantry transport bay. The vehicle is protected by seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, which ensured its cargo arrived at the designation intact. The Turhan's principal weaponry was its twin Large Lasers which were mounted in its turret. Mounted with the lasers were a pair of Machine Guns. Biome Restrictions: None. Each of the three basic types of APCs has its own individual function on the battlefield. Wheeled APCs tend to be cheaper to build, and they carry more armor than their Tracked or Hover counterparts. The wheeled APC is used mostly in city fighting, because wheels are best-suited for roads and light cross-country movement. content.original: Full production of this version, known as the Goblin II Infantry Support Vehicle, began in 3053. Though the Goblin remained a capable tank during its time in the Inner Sphere, the Clan Invasion prompted Johnston Industries to redesign it. A 180 FireHeart fusion engine replaces the ICE, enabling the infantry bay to be expanded. The large laser is replaced with a Large Pulse Laser and a SRM-6 is added to increase its firepower. The redesign mounts two Johnston miniguns, providing even more defense against infantry. Finally, an anti-missile system was installed to increase its survivability. The armor protection was increased from 8 tons to 9.5 tons of ferro-fibrous. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. content.content: Полномасштабное производство этой версии, известной как машина поддержки пехоты «Гоблин II», началось в 3053 году. Хотя «Гоблин» оставался эффективной боевой машиной во время службы во Внутренней Сфере, вторжение Кланов побудило компанию Johnston Industries провести его модернизацию. Двигатель внутреннего сгорания был заменен на термоядерный реактор FireHeart рейтинга 180, что позволило увеличить размер отсека пехоты. Вместо большого лазера установили большой импульсный лазер, и для усиления огневой мощи добавили пусковую установку SRM-6. Модернизированный вариант оснастили двумя миниганами Johnston, обеспечивающими еще более надежную защиту от пехоты. Наконец, для повышения живучести была установлена ​​система противоракетной обороны. Бронирование было усилено: вместо прежних 8 тонн использовано 9,5 тонны ферроволоконной брони. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 4/6 гексов / 120/180 метров. content.content: Разработанный в 2611 году компанией Vitesse Vehicles (Терра), вездеход Prowler стал самым распространенным военным разведывательным транспортным средством, предназначенным для действий в условиях враждебной среды и на планетах с экстремальными природными условиями. Prowler практически не имел равных в своей нише; его конструкция оказалась настолько удачной, что Vitesse прекратила собственное производство, перейдя к передаче лицензий на выпуск этой машины производителям по всей Внутренней Сфере и Периферии. Хотя массового производства так и не было налажено, вооруженные силы всех государств-наследников в эпоху после падения Звездной Лиги продолжали использовать эти машины в боевых действиях на самых суровых и непригодных для жизни планетах. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 4/6 гексов / 120/180 метров.
